```pycon
2020-01-03  2.0  2.0  2.0
2020-01-04  NaN  NaN  NaN
2020-01-05  NaN  NaN  NaN

>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.hslice("2020-01-02", "2020-01-04"): 2
... }))
              a    b    c
2020-01-01  NaN  NaN  NaN
2020-01-02  2.0  2.0  2.0
2020-01-03  2.0  2.0  2.0
2020-01-04  NaN  NaN  NaN
2020-01-05  NaN  NaN  NaN

>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     ((0, 2), (3, 5)): [[1], [2]]
... }))
              a    b    c
2020-01-01  1.0  1.0  1.0
2020-01-02  1.0  1.0  1.0
2020-01-03  NaN  NaN  NaN
2020-01-04  2.0  2.0  2.0
2020-01-05  2.0  2.0  2.0

>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     ((0, 2), (3, 5)): [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
... }))
              a    b    c
2020-01-01  1.0  2.0  3.0
2020-01-02  1.0  2.0  3.0
2020-01-03  NaN  NaN  NaN
2020-01-04  4.0  5.0  6.0
2020-01-05  4.0  5.0  6.0
```

Set rows using index points:


Set column indices:

```pycon
>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.colidx("a"): 2
... }))
              a   b   c
2020-01-01  2.0 NaN NaN
2020-01-02  2.0 NaN NaN

2020-01-04  2.0 NaN NaN
2020-01-05  2.0 NaN NaN

>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({

              a    b   c

2020-01-02  1.0  2.0 NaN
2020-01-03  1.0  2.0 NaN
2020-01-04  1.0  2.0 NaN
2020-01-05  1.0  2.0 NaN

>>> multi_columns = pd.MultiIndex.from_arrays(
...     [["a", "a", "b", "b"], [1, 2, 1, 2]],
...     names=["c1", "c2"]
... )
>>> multi_wrapper = vbt.ArrayWrapper(index, multi_columns)

>>> multi_wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.colidx(("a", 2)): 2
... }))
c1           a        b
c2           1    2   1   2
2020-01-01 NaN  2.0 NaN NaN
2020-01-02 NaN  2.0 NaN NaN
2020-01-03 NaN  2.0 NaN NaN
2020-01-04 NaN  2.0 NaN NaN
2020-01-05 NaN  2.0 NaN NaN

>>> multi_wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.colidx("b", level="c1"): [3, 4]
... }))
c1           a        b
c2           1   2    1    2
2020-01-01 NaN NaN  3.0  4.0
2020-01-02 NaN NaN  3.0  4.0
2020-01-03 NaN NaN  3.0  4.0
2020-01-04 NaN NaN  3.0  4.0
2020-01-05 NaN NaN  3.0  4.0
```

Set row and column indices:

```pycon
>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({

2020-01-04 NaN NaN  NaN
2020-01-05 NaN NaN  NaN

...     vbt.idx(("2020-01-01", "2020-01-03"), 2): [1, 2]

2020-01-02 NaN NaN  NaN
2020-01-03 NaN NaN  2.0
2020-01-04 NaN NaN  NaN
2020-01-05 NaN NaN  NaN

>>> wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.idx(("2020-01-01", "2020-01-03"), (0, 2)): [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
... }))
              a   b    c
2020-01-01  1.0 NaN  2.0
2020-01-02  NaN NaN  NaN
2020-01-03  3.0 NaN  4.0
2020-01-04  NaN NaN  NaN
2020-01-05  NaN NaN  NaN

>>> multi_wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.idx(
...         vbt.pointidx(every="2d"),
...         vbt.colidx(1, level="c2")
...     ): [[1, 2]]
... }))
c1            a        b
c2            1   2    1   2
2020-01-01  1.0 NaN  2.0 NaN
2020-01-02  NaN NaN  NaN NaN
2020-01-03  1.0 NaN  2.0 NaN
2020-01-04  NaN NaN  NaN NaN
2020-01-05  1.0 NaN  2.0 NaN

>>> multi_wrapper.fill_and_set(vbt.index_dict({
...     vbt.idx(
...         vbt.pointidx(every="2d"),
...         vbt.colidx(1, level="c2")

... }))
c1            a        b
c2            1   2    1   2
2020-01-01  1.0 NaN  1.0 NaN
2020-01-02  NaN NaN  NaN NaN
2020-01-03  2.0 NaN  2.0 NaN
2020-01-04  NaN NaN  NaN NaN
2020-01-05  3.0 NaN  3.0 NaN
```

### ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L1178-L1464)

```python
ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta(
    pd_indexing_func,
    index=None,
    columns=None,
    column_only_select=None,
    range_only_select=None,
    group_select=None,
    return_slices=True,
    return_none_slices=True,
    return_scalars=True,
    group_by=None,
    wrapper_kwargs=None
)
```

Perform indexing on an [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper") and return updated metadata.

Indexing respects column grouping and various indexing options without flipping
rows and columns. When indexing a Series, selecting one row always returns a Series;
when indexing a DataFrame, it returns a DataFrame.

Set `column_only_select` to True to treat the array wrapper as a Series of columns/groups,
avoiding selection along the index (axis 0). Use `range_only_select` to restrict row
selection to slices. If `group_select` is True and grouping is enabled, selection is
performed based on groups; otherwise, indexing is applied to columns.

!!! note
    If `column_only_select` is True, ensure that the array wrapper is indexed as a Series
    of columns rather than a DataFrame. For example, use `.iloc[:2]` instead of `.iloc[:, :2]`.
    Operations are not allowed if the instance already contains a single column/group.

__Args__

**```pd_indexing_func```** :&ensp;`PandasIndexingFunc`
:   Function to perform Pandas-style indexing.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Index for selecting rows.

**```columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Index for selecting columns.

**```column_only_select```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, index the wrapper as a Series of columns/groups.

**```range_only_select```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, allow row selection only by slicing.

**```group_select```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, enable group-based selection when grouping is active.

**```return_slices```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return indices as slice objects when they represent a continuous range.

**```return_none_slices```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return a slice `(None, None, None)` if an axis remains unchanged.

**```return_scalars```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return scalar values for single integer selections.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Dictionary containing:

    * `new_wrapper`: Updated [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper") after applying indexing.

    * `row_idxs`: Selected row indices, possibly returned as a slice if identified as a range.

    * `rows_changed`: Boolean indicating whether the row axis was changed in any way.

    * `col_idxs`: Selected column indices, possibly returned as a slice if identified as a range.

    * `columns_changed`: Boolean indicating whether the column axis was changed in any way.

    * `group_idxs`: Selected group indices, or the same as column indices if grouping is disabled.

    * `groups_changed`: Boolean indicating whether the group axis was changed in any way.

### ArrayWrapper.row_stack | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L839-L982)

```python
ArrayWrapper.row_stack(
    *wrappers,
    index=None,
    columns=None,
    freq=None,
    group_by=None,
    stack_columns=True,
    index_concat_method='append',
    keys=None,
    clean_index_kwargs=None,
    verify_integrity=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack multiple [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper") instances along rows.

Concatenates indexes using [concat_indexes](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/indexes/#vectorbtpro.base.indexes.concat_indexes "vectorbtpro.base.indexes.concat_indexes").
All wrappers must share the same frequency unless a custom frequency is provided via `freq`.
If the column levels differ among wrappers, they are stacked together if `stack_columns` is True;
otherwise, an error is raised. When `group_by` is not provided, all wrappers must be uniformly
grouped or ungrouped and have consistent group labels. Furthermore, all wrappers are expected
to have compatible configuration values, except where explicitly overridden via `kwargs`.

__Args__

**```*wrappers```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[ArrayWrapper]`
:   (Additional) [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper") instances to stack.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Custom index for the stacked result.

    If not provided, indexes are concatenated.

**```columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Custom columns for the stacked result.

    If not provided, columns are derived from the wrappers.

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Custom frequency for the stacked result
    (e.g., "daily", "15 min", "index_mean").

    If not provided, frequency is derived from the wrappers.
    See [infer_index_freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.infer_index_freq "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.infer_index_freq").

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```stack_columns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to stack differing column levels from wrappers.

**```index_concat_method```** :&ensp;`MaybeTuple[Union[str, Callable]]`
:   Method used for concatenating indexes.

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Keys used during index concatenation.

**```clean_index_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for cleaning MultiIndex levels.

    See [clean_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/indexes/#vectorbtpro.base.indexes.clean_index "vectorbtpro.base.indexes.clean_index").

**```verify_integrity```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to verify the integrity of the concatenated index.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

__Returns__

[ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper")
:   New [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper") instance representing the row-stacked result.

### ArrayWrapper.row_stack_arrs | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L2264-L2303)

```python
ArrayWrapper.row_stack_arrs(
    *objs,
    group_by=None,
    wrap=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack arrays along rows and wrap the resulting object.

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[ArrayLike]`
:   Arrays to stack.

### ArrayWrapper.wrap | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L1956-L2103)

```python
ArrayWrapper.wrap(
    arr,
    group_by=None,
    index=None,
    columns=None,
    zero_to_none=None,
    force_2d=False,
    fillna=None,
    dtype=None,
    min_precision=None,
    max_precision=None,
    prec_float_only=None,
    prec_check_bounds=None,
    prec_strict=None,
    to_timedelta=False,
    to_index=False,
    silence_warnings=None
)
```

Wrap the input array using stored metadata and configuration.

The function performs the following steps:

* Convert the input to a NumPy array.

* Replace NaN values if a fill value is provided.

* Adjust the array shape to match the stored index and columns.

* Apply minimum and maximum precision casting if configured.

* Create a Pandas Series or DataFrame based on the array's dimensionality.

* Optionally map output values to the original index.

* Optionally convert data to timedelta using [ArrayWrapper.arr_to_timedelta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.arr_to_timedelta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.arr_to_timedelta").

!!! info
    For default settings, see [wrapping](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.wrapping "vectorbtpro._settings.wrapping").

__Args__

**```arr```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Array to be wrapped.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Index to assign to the wrapped object.

    Uses the stored index if not provided.

**```columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Column labels for the wrapped object.

    May be adjusted if a single zero-valued column is detected.

**```zero_to_none```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, converts a zero column name to None
    when a single column is present.

**```force_2d```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, force the output to be two-dimensional.

**```fillna```** :&ensp;`Optional[Scalar]`
:   Value to replace missing data (NaN).

**```dtype```** :&ensp;`Optional[PandasDTypeLike]`
:   Data type for converting the output.

**```min_precision```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, str]`
:   Minimum precision for numerical conversion.

**```max_precision```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, str]`
:   Maximum precision for numerical conversion.

**```prec_float_only```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, apply precision conversion only to floating point numbers.

**```prec_check_bounds```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, enforce bounds checking during precision conversion.

**```prec_strict```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, apply strict checking during precision conversion.

**```to_timedelta```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to convert the output to timedelta format.

**```to_index```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, map output values to the original index.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

__Returns__

`SeriesFrame`
:   Wrapped Pandas Series or DataFrame with applied metadata.

### HasWrapper.chunk | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L380-L437)

```python
HasWrapper.chunk(
    axis=None,
    min_size=None,
    n_chunks=None,
    chunk_len=None,
    chunk_meta=None,
    select=False,
    wrap=None,
    return_chunk_meta=False
)
```

Divide the instance into chunks.

This method splits the instance into smaller segments along a specified axis.
If `axis` is not provided, it defaults to 0 for one-dimensional instances and 1
for multi-dimensional instances.

__Args__

**```axis```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Axis along which to split the instance.

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of elements to split.

**```n_chunks```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, str]`
:   Specification for the number of chunks.

**```chunk_len```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, str]`
:   Specification for the length of each chunk.

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[ChunkMeta]]`
:   Iterable containing metadata for each chunk.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```select```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to select chunks using [ArraySelector](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ArraySelector "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ArraySelector").

**```wrap```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to specify whether to wrap the result.

**```return_chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to yield chunk metadata alongside each chunk.

__Yields__

`Union[HasWrapper, Tuple[ChunkMeta, HasWrapper]]`
:   Chunk of the instance,
    or a tuple containing the chunk metadata and the chunk if `return_chunk_meta` is True.

### HasWrapper.chunk_apply | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L439-L487)

```python
HasWrapper.chunk_apply(
    apply_func,
    *args,
    chunk_kwargs=None,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Apply a function to each chunk of the instance.

This method first divides the instance into chunks and then applies the specified
function to each chunk. If `apply_func` is a string, it is treated as the name of
the method to invoke on each chunk.

__Args__

**```apply_func```** :&ensp;`Union[str, Callable]`
:   Function or method name to apply to each chunk.

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for `apply_func`.

**```chunk_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the chunking handler.

    See [HasWrapper.chunk](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.chunk "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.chunk").

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `apply_func`.

__Returns__

`MergeableResults`
:   Aggregated results obtained from applying the function to each chunk.

### HasWrapper.items | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L511-L598)

```python
HasWrapper.items(
    group_by=None,
    apply_group_by=False,
    keep_2d=False,
    key_as_index=False,
    wrap=None
)
```

Iterate over columns or groups of the instance.

This method yields key-item pairs where keys represent column or group identifiers
and items are the corresponding sub-instances. The iteration behavior is determined
by the provided `group_by` and `apply_group_by` parameters, as well as whether the
instance is grouped with group selection enabled.

__Args__

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```apply_group_by```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, applies the grouping to both iteration and the final output.

    If False, `group_by` is used solely as an iteration instruction.

**```keep_2d```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to maintain the output data in a two-dimensional format.

**```key_as_index```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the yielded key as an index.

**```wrap```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to wrap the yielded items
    with additional functionality.

__Yields__

`Items`
:   Tuple where the first element is a key (column or group identifier)
    and the second element is the corresponding sub-instance.

### HasWrapper.select_col_from_obj | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/wrapping.py#L220-L310)

Select one column or group from a Pandas object.

# vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/grouping/base.py)

Module providing base classes and functions for grouping.

The [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper") class encapsulates metadata related to grouping an index. It provides details such as the number
of groups, the starting indices of groups, and other information useful for grouping reduction operations.
It also supports dynamically enabling, disabling, or modifying groups while enforcing allowed operations.

## Grouper | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/grouping/base.py#L41-L747)

```python
Grouper(
    index,
    group_by=None,
    def_lvl_name='group',
    allow_enable=True,
    allow_disable=True,
    allow_modify=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for grouping indices and managing group metadata.

This class stores metadata and offers methods to create and manipulate groupings for a Pandas Index.
It provides information such as the number of groups, the starting indices for each group, and other details
that are useful for grouping reduction operations.

__Args__

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Original Pandas Index to group.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    Accepts:

    * boolean (False for no grouping, True for one group).

    * integer (MultiIndex level by position).

    * string (MultiIndex level by name).

    * sequence of integers or strings that is shorter than `index` (multiple MultiIndex levels).

    * any other sequence such as Pandas Index that has the same length as `index`.

    * [ExceptLevel](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/indexes/#vectorbtpro.base.indexes.ExceptLevel "vectorbtpro.base.indexes.ExceptLevel") object (to exclude levels).

    * [CustomTemplate](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/template/#vectorbtpro.utils.template.CustomTemplate "vectorbtpro.utils.template.CustomTemplate") object with `index` as context (to substitute levels).

**```def_lvl_name```** :&ensp;`Hashable`
:   Default level name for groups.

**```allow_enable```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if enabling grouping is permitted when `group_by` is None.

**```allow_disable```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if disabling grouping is permitted when `group_by` is not None.

**```allow_modify```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if modifying groups is allowed.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured").

__Superclasses__

Check the provided `group_by` object against grouping restrictions.

:   Grouping specification.

    If not provided, uses [Grouper.group_by](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.group_by "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.group_by").

**```allow_enable```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether enabling grouping is allowed.

**```allow_disable```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether disabling grouping is allowed.

**```allow_modify```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether modifying groups is allowed.

__Returns__

None

### Grouper.select_groups | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/grouping/base.py#L712-L747)

```python
Grouper.select_groups(
    group_idxs,
    jitted=None
)
```

Select groups using provided indices while automatically choosing the selection method.

!!! note
    If [Grouper.is_sorted](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.is_sorted "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.is_sorted") returns True, selection is performed using group lengths (faster).
    Otherwise, selection is performed using a group map for greater flexibility.

__See__

* [group_lens_select_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/nb/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.nb.group_lens_select_nb "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.nb.group_lens_select_nb") if [Grouper.is_sorted](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.is_sorted "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.is_sorted") returns True.

* [group_map_select_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/nb/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.nb.group_map_select_nb "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.nb.group_map_select_nb") if [Grouper.is_sorted](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.is_sorted "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper.is_sorted") returns False.

__Args__

**```group_idxs```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of group indices to be selected.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array1d, Array1d]`
:   Tuple containing:

    * New group indices after selection.

    * New group array corresponding to the selected indices.

### Resampler.map_bounds_to_source_ranges | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/base.py#L482-L551)

```python
Resampler.map_bounds_to_source_ranges(
    source_index=None,
    target_lbound_index=None,
    target_rbound_index=None,
    closed_lbound=True,
    closed_rbound=False,
    skip_not_found=False,
    jitted=None
)
```

Return the mapping from target index bounds to source index ranges.

Either `target_lbound_index` or `target_rbound_index` must be provided.

__See__

[map_bounds_to_source_ranges_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/resampling/nb/#vectorbtpro.base.resampling.nb.map_bounds_to_source_ranges_nb "vectorbtpro.base.resampling.nb.map_bounds_to_source_ranges_nb")

__Args__

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Source datetime index.

**```target_lbound_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Left bound of the target index.

    Set to "pandas" to use [Resampler.get_lbound_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/resampling/base/#vectorbtpro.base.resampling.base.Resampler.get_lbound_index "vectorbtpro.base.resampling.base.Resampler.get_lbound_index").

**```target_rbound_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Right bound of the target index.

    Set to "pandas" to use [Resampler.get_rbound_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/resampling/base/#vectorbtpro.base.resampling.base.Resampler.get_rbound_index "vectorbtpro.base.resampling.base.Resampler.get_rbound_index").

**```closed_lbound```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if the left bound is inclusive.

**```closed_rbound```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if the right bound is inclusive.

## index_difference_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/nb.py#L127-L164)

```python
index_difference_nb(
    source_index,
    target_index
)
```

Return the positions in `source_index` whose values are not present in `target_index`.

The function iterates over `source_index` and identifies indices that are absent from
`target_index`. Both arrays must be strictly increasing.

__Args__

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of source indices, expected to be strictly increasing.

**```target_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target indices, which must be strictly increasing.

__Returns__

`Array1d`
:   Array of integer positions from `source_index` that do not appear in `target_index`.

## last_before_target_index_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/nb.py#L410-L460)

```python
last_before_target_index_nb(
    source_index,
    target_index,
    incl_source=True,
    incl_target=False
)
```

Return an array of positions representing the last valid source index within each range
defined by `source_index` and `target_index`.

For each element in `source_index`, the function finds the last index in `source_index`
that lies between the original value and the corresponding value in `target_index`. The
inclusivity of the endpoints is controlled by `incl_source` and `incl_target`.

__Args__

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of source indices, sorted in increasing order.

**```target_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target indices, which must be strictly increasing.

**```incl_source```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to include the original source index in the result.

**```incl_target```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to include the target index if it matches a source index.

__Returns__

`Array1d`
:   Array containing the position of the last valid source index for each element.

## map_bounds_to_source_ranges_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/nb.py#L251-L337)

```python
map_bounds_to_source_ranges_nb(
    source_index,
    target_lbound_index,
    target_rbound_index,
    closed_lbound=True,
    closed_rbound=False,
    skip_not_found=False
)
```

Return the source bounds corresponding to the target bound indices.

Each target range defined by `target_lbound_index` and `target_rbound_index` is mapped
to a contiguous range in `source_index`. If no valid mapping is found for a target range,
both the start and end indices are set to -1.

!!! note
    Both index arrays must be increasing. Repeating values are allowed.

__Args__

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of source indices, sorted in increasing order.

**```target_lbound_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target left-bound indices, sorted in increasing order.

**```target_rbound_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target right-bound indices, sorted in increasing order.

**```closed_lbound```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if the left bound is inclusive.

**```closed_rbound```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if the right bound is inclusive.

**```skip_not_found```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to drop indices that are -1 (not found).

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array1d, Array1d]`
:   Tuple where the first array contains inclusive start indices and the

second array contains exclusive end indices corresponding to the source ranges.

## map_index_to_source_ranges_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/nb.py#L167-L248)

```python
map_index_to_source_ranges_nb(
    source_index,
    target_index,
    target_freq=None,
    before=False
)
```

Map each element of `target_index` to a range of indices in `source_index`.

For each target index, determine the corresponding range in `source_index`. The start index
is inclusive and the end index is exclusive. If `target_freq` is provided, the right bound is limited
by the frequency interval; otherwise, it extends to the next target index. If no valid mapping is
found, both start and end are set to -1.

!!! note
    Both index arrays must be increasing. Repeating values are allowed.

__Args__

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of source indices in increasing order.

**```target_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target indices, which must be strictly increasing.

**```target_freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Scalar]`
:   Frequency offset for the target index.

**```before```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, include source indices preceding or equal to the target;
    otherwise, include those following or equal.

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array1d, Array1d]`
:   Tuple containing:

    * Inclusive start indices in `source_index`.

    * Exclusive end indices in `source_index`.

## map_to_target_index_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/nb.py#L61-L124)

```python
map_to_target_index_nb(
    source_index,
    target_index,
    target_freq=None,
    before=False,
    raise_missing=True
)
```

Map each element of `source_index` to its corresponding index in `target_index`.

The mapping is determined by the provided `target_freq` and `before` flag. When
`target_freq` is specified, the function restricts the mapping to a given frequency interval.
If no valid mapping is found and `raise_missing` is True, a `ValueError` is raised; otherwise,
the source element is mapped to -1.

__Args__

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of source indices.

**```target_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target indices, which must be strictly increasing.

**```target_freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Scalar]`
:   Frequency offset for the target index.

**```before```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, include source indices preceding or equal to the target;
    otherwise, include those following or equal.

**```raise_missing```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, raise an error when a source index cannot be mapped; otherwise, assign -1.

__Returns__

`Array1d`
:   Array of integer indices from `target_index` corresponding to each element of `source_index`.

## resample_source_mask_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/base/resampling/nb.py#L340-L407)

```python
resample_source_mask_nb(
    source_mask,
    source_index,
    target_index,
    source_freq=None,
    target_freq=None
)
```

Return a resampled source mask aligned with the target index.

Each element in the output becomes True only if the target bar, defined by `target_index`
(and optionally adjusted with `target_freq`), is fully contained within a source bar.
A source bar is represented by a contiguous sequence of True values in `source_mask` derived
from `source_index` (and optionally adjusted with `source_freq`).

__Args__

**```source_mask```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Boolean array representing the source mask.

**```source_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of source indices, sorted in increasing order.

**```target_index```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   Array of target indices, which must be strictly increasing.

**```source_freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Scalar]`
:   Frequency offset for the source index.

**```target_freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Scalar]`
:   Frequency offset for the target index.

__Returns__

`Array1d`
:   Boolean array indicating whether each target bar is fully covered by a source bar.

Prepare a key by normalizing it.

Transforms string keys to lowercase, strips whitespace, and replaces spaces with underscores.
Tuples are processed recursively.

__Args__

## Data | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L762-L7184)

```python
Data(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for downloading, updating, and managing data from a data source.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__Args__

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`ArrayWrapper`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```data```** :&ensp;`Union[feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Data dictionary structured as feature-oriented
    ([feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict")) or symbol-oriented ([symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict")).

**```single_key```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Specifies whether the instance should be treated as having a single key.

    Automatically set to False when multiple keys are present.

**```classes```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Class definitions for keys.

**```level_name```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, MaybeIterable[Hashable]]`
:   Name(s) of levels for keys.

**```fetch_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Additional parameters for data fetching.

**```returned_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Keyword arguments returned from data fetching.

**```last_index```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Container to record
    the last datetime index for each key.

**```delisted```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Container to track
    delisted status for each key.

**```tz_localize```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone localization.

    Set to False to disable localization. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```tz_convert```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone conversion.

    Set to False to disable conversion. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```missing_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing indices when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index").

**```missing_columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing columns when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_columns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Analyzable](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/analyzable/#vectorbtpro.generic.analyzable.Analyzable "vectorbtpro.generic.analyzable.Analyzable").

### Data.add | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L3474-L3511)

```python
Data.add(
    key,
    data=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Create a new [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance with a new feature or symbol based on the data's orientation.

Depending on the data orientation, delegates to either [Data.add_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.add_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.add_symbol") or [Data.add_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.add_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.add_feature").
The orientation is automatically determined by comparing data columns with existing features and symbols.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```data```** :&ensp;`Union[None, SeriesFrame, CustomTemplate]`
:   Data corresponding to the key.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for the delegated function.

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   New [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance with the added feature or symbol.

__Raises__

`ValueError`
:   If the orientation cannot be determined from the data.

### Data.align_data | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L2695-L2793)

```python
Data.align_data(
    data,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    silence_warnings=None
)
```

Align data by preparing indices and columns.

Removes duplicate indices, prepares timezone-aware datetime indices,
and aligns both indices and columns.

__Args__

**```data```** :&ensp;`dict`
:   Data dictionary.

**```last_index```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Container to record
    the last datetime index for each key.

**```delisted```** :&ensp;`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Container to track
    delisted status for each key.

**```tz_localize```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone localization.

    Set to False to disable localization. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```tz_convert```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone conversion.

    Set to False to disable conversion. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```missing_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing indices when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index").

**```missing_columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing columns when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_columns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns").

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Aligned data dictionary with cleaned and ordered indices and columns.

### Data.column_stack | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L1487-L1568)

```python
    *objs,

    **kwargs
)
```

Stack multiple [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instances along columns.

This method concatenates multiple [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instances by stacking their underlying arrays
along the column axis. It relies on [ArrayWrapper.column_stack](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.column_stack "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.column_stack")
to merge the wrappers.

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Data]`
:   (Additional) [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instances to stack.

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   New [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance created by stacking the given instances.

### Data.feature_config | property | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L1306-L1323)

Feature configuration for [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

```python
HybridConfig()
```

This property returns `Data._feature_config`, which is (hybrid-) copied during instance
creation. Modifying this configuration does not affect the class-level configuration.

To change fields, modify the configuration in-place, override this property, or replace the
instance variable `Data._feature_config`.

__Returns__

`Config`
:   Feature configuration for the class.

### Data.from_data | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L2795-L2929)

```python
Data.from_data(
    data,
    columns_are_symbols=False,
    invert_data=False,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    wrapper_kwargs=None,

    **kwargs
)
```

Create a new [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance from provided data.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__Args__

**```data```** :&ensp;`Union[dict, SeriesFrame]`
:   Dictionary or DataFrame/Series used to construct the instance.

**```columns_are_symbols```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the columns represent symbols.

**```invert_data```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Determines if the data dictionary should be inverted using [Data.invert_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.invert_data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.invert_data").

**```single_key```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Specifies whether the instance should be treated as having a single key.

    Automatically set to False when multiple keys are present.

**```classes```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   Mapping defining classes for data handling.

    See [Data.classes](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.classes "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.classes").

**```level_name```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, MaybeIterable[Hashable]]`
:   Level name(s) for indexing.

    See [Data.level_name](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.level_name "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.level_name").

**```tz_localize```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone localization.

    Set to False to disable localization. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```tz_convert```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone conversion.

    Set to False to disable conversion. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```missing_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing indices when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index").

**```missing_columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing columns when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_columns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns").

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```fetch_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   Additional keyword arguments
    initially passed to [Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol").

**```returned_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   Additional keyword arguments
    returned by [Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol").

**```last_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   Last fetched index per symbol.

**```delisted```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   Indicator dictionary for delisted symbols.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.replace](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured.replace "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.replace").

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   New [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance constructed from the provided data.

**```features```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeFeatures]`
:   Feature identifier(s).

    If not provided, uses [Data.features](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.BaseDataMixin.features "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.features").

**```symbols```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeSymbols]`
:   Symbol identifier(s).

    If not provided, uses [Data.symbols](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.BaseDataMixin.symbols "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.symbols").

**```feature```** :&ensp;`Optional[Feature]`
:   Feature identifier.

    Cannot be used with `features`.

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Optional[Symbol]`
:   Symbol identifier.

    Cannot be used with `symbols`.

**```squeeze_features```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to squeeze the features when only one element is present.

**```squeeze_symbols```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to squeeze the symbols when only one element is present.

**```per```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Grouping specification for data concatenation,
    such as "feature", "symbol", "column", or "key".

**```as_dict```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the data as a dictionary mapping keys to the data.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.concat](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.concat "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.concat").

__Returns__

`Union[MaybeTuple[SeriesFrame], dict]`
:   Retrieved data as a tuple or dictionary
    based on the provided parameters.

Perform indexing on the [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance.

This method applies positional and keyword arguments to index the underlying data.
It retrieves indexing metadata via [ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta"),
applies the specified indexing to each element in the data, and then constructs a new
[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance with an updated wrapper and modified data.

__Args__

:   Positional arguments for [ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.indexing_func_meta").

### Data.items | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L1656-L1742)

```python
Data.items(
    over='symbols',
    group_by=None,
    apply_group_by=False,
    keep_2d=False,
    key_as_index=False
)
```

Iterate over specific aspects of the [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance.

Depending on the value of `over`, this method iterates over different components of the data:

* If `over` is "columns", "symbols", or "features" (depending on data orientation),
    it yields pairs of key and corresponding [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") subsets.

* If `over` is "keys", it iterates over keys with optional grouping.

__Args__

**```over```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Iteration mode.

    Allowed values include "columns", "symbols", "features", or "keys".

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```apply_group_by```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, applies the grouping to both iteration and the final output.

    If False, `group_by` is used solely as an iteration instruction.

    !!! note
        Grouping is not supported when iterating over keys.

**```keep_2d```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to maintain the output data in a two-dimensional format.

**```key_as_index```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the yielded key as an index.

__Returns__

`Items`
:   Iterator yielding pairs of key and corresponding [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") subsets.

__Overridden methods__

* [HasWrapper.items](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.items "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.items")

### Data.merge | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L3762-L3864)

```python
    *datas,
    rename=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Merge multiple [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instances into a single instance.

Data from later instances overrides earlier instances. This method supports
merging both symbols and features.

__Args__

**```*datas```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Data]`
:   (Additional) data instances to merge.

**```rename```** :&ensp;`Optional[Dict[Key, Key]]`
:   Optional mapping for renaming keys during merging.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Configured.resolve_merge_kwargs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured.resolve_merge_kwargs "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.resolve_merge_kwargs") and then [Data.from_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.from_data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.from_data").

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   Merged [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance.

### Data.metrics | property | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L7021-L7023)

Metrics configuration for [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

This property returns a copy of `Data._metrics` created during instance initialization.
Modifications to the returned configuration do not affect the class-level settings.

```python
HybridConfig(
    start_index=dict(
        title='Start Index',
        calc_func=<function Data.<lambda>>,
        agg_func=None,
        tags='wrapper'
    ),
    end_index=dict(
        title='End Index',
        calc_func=<function Data.<lambda>>,
        agg_func=None,
        tags='wrapper'
    ),
    total_duration=dict(
        title='Total Duration',
        calc_func=<function Data.<lambda>>,
        apply_to_timedelta=True,
        agg_func=None,
        tags='wrapper'
    ),
    total_features=dict(
        title='Total Features',
        check_is_feature_oriented=True,
        calc_func=<function Data.<lambda>>,
        agg_func=None,
        tags='data'
    ),
    total_symbols=dict(
        title='Total Symbols',
        check_is_symbol_oriented=True,
        calc_func=<function Data.<lambda>>,
        tags='data'

    null_counts=dict(
```

__Returns__

### Data.plot | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L7027-L7112)

```python
    column=None,
    feature=None,
    symbol=None,
    feature_map=None,
```

Plot one feature across multiple symbols or generate an OHLC(V) chart for a single symbol.

__Args__

**```column```** :&ensp;`Column`
:   Column identifier.

    Used depending on the data orientation.

**```feature```** :&ensp;`Feature`

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```feature_map```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Dictionary mapping feature names to OHLCV components.

    Applied only when generating an OHLC(V) chart.

**```plot_volume```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to plot volume below.

    Applied only when generating an OHLC(V) chart.

**```base```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Initial base value for rebasing the feature series.

    !!! note
        The feature must contain price data.

        Applied only when plotting lines.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for
    [GenericAccessor.plot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/accessors/#vectorbtpro.generic.accessors.GenericAccessor.plot "vectorbtpro.generic.accessors.GenericAccessor.plot") for lines and to
    [OHLCVDFAccessor.plot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/ohlcv/accessors/#vectorbtpro.ohlcv.accessors.OHLCVDFAccessor.plot "vectorbtpro.ohlcv.accessors.OHLCVDFAccessor.plot") for OHLC(V).

__Returns__

`Union[BaseFigure, TraceUpdater]`
:   Plot figure or trace updater instance.

__Examples__

Plot the lines of one feature across all symbols:

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> start = '2021-01-01 UTC'  # crypto is in UTC
>>> end = '2021-06-01 UTC'
>>> data = vbt.YFData.pull(['BTC-USD', 'ETH-USD', 'ADA-USD'], start=start, end=end)
```

[=100% "100%"]{: .candystripe .candystripe-animate }

```pycon
>>> data.plot(feature='Close', base=1).show()
```

Plot OHLC(V) of one symbol (only if data contains the respective features):

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/data_plot.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

```pycon
>>> data.plot(symbol='BTC-USD').show()
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/data_plot_ohlcv.light.svg#only-light){: .iimg loading=lazy }
![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/data_plot_ohlcv.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

### Data.prepare_dt | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L2360-L2450)

```python
Data.prepare_dt(
    obj,
    parse_dates=True,
    to_utc=True,
    remove_utc_tz=False
)
```

Prepare datetime index and columns.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`SeriesFrame`
:   Pandas Series or DataFrame.

**```parse_dates```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, Sequence[str]]`
:   Specifies whether to parse dates.

    If True, converts any index or column with an object data type to datetime.
    If a sequence of strings, converts only fields whose name is in the sequence.

**```to_utc```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, str, Sequence[str]]`
:   Specifies whether to localize or convert
    datetime fields to UTC.

    If True, converts both index and columns.
    If a string equal to "index" or "columns", converts only the corresponding field.
    If a sequence, converts fields whose names are in the sequence.

**```remove_utc_tz```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates whether to remove the timezone after converting to UTC.

__Returns__

`Frame`
:   Pandas DataFrame or Series with prepared datetime indices and columns.

### Data.pull | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L4072-L4324)

```python
Data.pull(
    keys=None,
    *,
    keys_are_features=None,
    features=None,
    symbols=None,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    wrapper_kwargs=None,
    skip_on_error=None,
    silence_warnings=None,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    return_raw=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Pull data.

Fetch each feature or symbol using [Data.fetch_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature")/[Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol")
and prepare it with [Data.from_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.from_data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.from_data").

Iteration over features or symbols is performed using [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute")
to allow parallelized execution.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__Args__

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Union[None, dict, MaybeKeys]`
:   Feature or symbol identifier(s).

    Depending on `keys_are_features`, these keys will be treated as features or symbols.

**```keys_are_features```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether the keys represent features.

**```features```** :&ensp;`Union[None, dict, MaybeFeatures]`
:   Feature identifier(s).

    If provided as a dictionary, keys are treated as features and values as keyword arguments.

    !!! note
        Tuple is interpreted as a single feature.

**```symbols```** :&ensp;`Union[None, dict, MaybeSymbols]`
:   Symbol identifier(s).

    If provided as a dictionary, keys are treated as symbols and values as keyword arguments.

    !!! note
        Tuple is interpreted as a single symbol.

**```classes```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeSequence[Union[Hashable, dict]]]`
:   See [Data.classes](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.classes "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.classes").

    Can be a single hashable, a dictionary with class names as keys, or a sequence of such.

    !!! note
        Tuple is interpreted as a single class.

**```level_name```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, MaybeIterable[Hashable]]`
:   Used as in [Data.level_name](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.level_name "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.level_name").

**```tz_localize```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone localization.

    Set to False to disable localization. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```tz_convert```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, TimezoneLike]`
:   Flag or specification for timezone conversion.

    Set to False to disable conversion. See [Data.prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt_index").

**```missing_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing indices when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_index").

**```missing_columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies how to handle missing columns when aligning data.

    See [Data.align_columns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_columns").

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```skip_on_error```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to skip pulling a feature or symbol if an exception occurs.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

    This flag is also forwarded to [Data.fetch_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature")/[Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol") if applicable.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```return_raw```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Return the raw outputs if True.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.fetch_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature")/[Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol").

    For features or symbols that require distinct keyword arguments, pass [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict") or
    [feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict")/[symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict") for each.

__Returns__

`PullOutput`
:   [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance or a list of execution outputs if `return_raw` is True.

### Data.realign | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L5062-L5126)

```python
Data.realign(
    rule=None,
    *args,
    wrapper_meta=None,
    ffill=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Perform realignment on [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

This method realigns features based on a specified rule or the frequency defined in the wrapper.
It checks for a `realign_func` in [Data.feature_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.feature_config "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.feature_config") for each feature, which should handle the
realignment with a resampler and an option to forward-fill missing values. If no function is provided,
it realigns the "open" feature using [GenericAccessor.realign_opening](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/accessors/#vectorbtpro.generic.accessors.GenericAccessor.realign_opening "vectorbtpro.generic.accessors.GenericAccessor.realign_opening") and
applies [GenericAccessor.realign_closing](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/accessors/#vectorbtpro.generic.accessors.GenericAccessor.realign_closing "vectorbtpro.generic.accessors.GenericAccessor.realign_closing") to other features.

__Args__

**```rule```** :&ensp;`Optional[AnyRuleLike]`
:   Time rule for realignment.

    If not provided, uses [ArrayWrapper.freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.freq "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.freq").

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for [ArrayWrapper.resample_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta").

**```wrapper_meta```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Metadata from the resampling operation on the wrapper.

**```ffill```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to forward-fill missing values during realignment.

**```**kwargs```**

### Data.resample | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L4978-L5060)

```python
Data.resample(
    *args,
    wrapper_meta=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Perform resampling on [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

This method automatically resamples features such as "open", "high", "low", "close",
"volume", "trade count", and "vwap" (case-insensitive). It searches for a `resample_func`
in [Data.feature_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.feature_config "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.feature_config") for each feature, which should accept the [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance, the feature
object, and a resampler. If a feature-specific function is not provided, default resampling
methods are used based on the feature name.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for [ArrayWrapper.resample_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta").

**```wrapper_meta```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Metadata from the resampling operation on the wrapper.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ArrayWrapper.resample_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta").

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   New data instance with resampled features.

__Overridden methods__

* [Wrapping.resample](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.Wrapping.resample "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.Wrapping.resample")

### Data.resolve_keys_meta | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L3989-L4070)

```python
Data.resolve_keys_meta(
    keys=None,
    keys_are_features=None,
    features=None,
    symbols=None
)
```

Resolve metadata for keys.

The method validates that only one of `keys`, `features`, or `symbols` is provided and
determines whether the keys represent features. It also sets the corresponding dictionary type.
The resolved metadata is returned as a dictionary with the keys, a flag for features, and the
determined dictionary type.

__Args__

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Union[None, dict, MaybeKeys]`
:   Feature or symbol identifier(s).

    Depending on `keys_are_features`, these keys will be treated as features or symbols.

**```keys_are_features```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether the keys represent features.

**```features```** :&ensp;`Union[None, dict, MaybeFeatures]`
:   Feature identifier(s).

    If provided as a dictionary, keys are treated as features and values as keyword arguments.

    !!! note
        Tuple is interpreted as a single feature.

**```symbols```** :&ensp;`Union[None, dict, MaybeSymbols]`
:   Symbol identifier(s).

    If provided as a dictionary, keys are treated as symbols and values as keyword arguments.

    !!! note
        Tuple is interpreted as a single symbol.

__Returns__

`Kwargs`
:   Dictionary with metadata:

    * `keys`: Mapping of keys to use.

    * `keys_are_features`: Flag indicating whether the keys represent features.

    * `dict_type`: Dictionary type.
