### Data.row_stack | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L1412-L1485)

```python
Data.row_stack(
    *objs,
    wrapper_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack multiple [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instances along rows.

This method uses [ArrayWrapper.row_stack](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.row_stack "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.row_stack") to combine
the wrappers from each instance, validates that all instances share consistent data
keys and dictionary types, and merges their data along with related attributes.

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Data]`
:   (Additional) [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instances to stack.

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   New [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance created by stacking the given instances.

### Data.run | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L5251-L5717)

```python
Data.run(
    func,
    *args,
    on_features=None,
    on_symbols=None,
    func_name=None,
    func_args=None,
    func_kwargs=None,
    indicator_kwargs=None,
    name_numbering=None,
    magnet_kwargs=None,
    ignore_args=None,
    rename_args=None,
    location=None,
    prepend_location=None,
    unpack=False,
    concat=True,
    data_kwargs=None,
    silence_warnings=False,
    raise_errors=False,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    filter_results=True,
    raise_no_results=True,
    merge_func=None,
    merge_kwargs=None,
    template_context=None,
    return_keys=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run a function on data.

This method applies a function or a collection of functions to the data contained in the
current object. It automatically inspects the signature of the provided function and fills in
parameters using object attributes (e.g., substituting `open` with [Data.open](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.OHLCDataMixin.open "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.open")).

The `func` parameter can be one of the following:

* Location to compute all indicators. See [IndicatorFactory.list_locations](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorFactory.list_locations "vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorFactory.list_locations").

* Indicator name. See [IndicatorFactory.get_indicator](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorFactory.get_indicator "vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorFactory.get_indicator").

* Simulation method from [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio").

* Any callable.

* Iterable of the above, with results aggregated as columns in a DataFrame.

Use `magnet_kwargs` to pass keyword arguments that are provided only if they are present in the
function signature. Use `rename_args` to map argument names; for example, data can be passed under a
different name as expected by a simulation method.

Set `unpack` to True, "dict", or "frame" to automatically post-process the result using the corresponding
methods: [IndicatorBase.unpack](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.unpack "vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.unpack"), `to_dict`, or `to_frame`.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [indexing](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.indexing "vectorbtpro._settings.indexing").

__Args__

**```func```** :&ensp;`MaybeIterable[Union[Hashable, Callable]]`
:   Function, location, indicator name,
    or simulation method to run, or an iterable of such.

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for the function.

**```on_features```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeFeatures]`
:   Features identifier(s) used to filter the data.

**```on_symbols```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeSymbols]`
:   Symbols identifier(s) used to filter the data.

**```func_name```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, run_func_dict]`
:   Name of the function.

    Can be used to rename the function, such as when the same function is called multiple times.

    Can be provided per function using [run_func_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict").

**```func_args```** :&ensp;`Union[ArgsLike, run_func_dict]`
:   Extra positional arguments for the function.

    Can be provided per function using [run_func_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict").

**```func_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[KwargsLike, run_func_dict]`
:   Extra keyword arguments for the function.

    Can be provided per function using [run_func_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict").

**```indicator_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the respective indicator constructor.

    See [IndicatorFactory.get_indicator](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorFactory.get_indicator "vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorFactory.get_indicator").
    Can be provided per function using [run_func_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.run_func_dict").

**```name_numbering```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Naming convention for duplicate types.

    Available options are:

    * 'none_based': First occurrence has no suffix, subsequent occurrences start from `_2`, `_3`, etc.

    * 'zero_based': All occurrences are suffixed starting from `_0`, `_1`, `_2`, etc.

    * 'one_based': All occurrences are suffixed starting from `_1`, `_2`, `_3`, etc.

**```magnet_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments injected only if they
    match the function signature.

**```ignore_args```** :&ensp;`Optional[Sequence[str]]`
:   Names of arguments to ignore when
    auto-assigning object attributes.

**```rename_args```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Mapping of argument names to substitute names.

**```location```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Identifier used to specify the location for indicator selection.

**```prepend_location```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   When True, indicator names are prefixed with their location.

**```unpack```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, str]`
:   Determines the processing of the function output.

    Use True, "dict", or "frame" to apply post-processing.

**```concat```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, concatenates results from multiple function calls.

**```data_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.from_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.from_data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.from_data").

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```raise_errors```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, raises any exceptions encountered.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```filter_results```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to filter out results that are [NoResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult").

**```raise_no_results```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to raise a
    [NoResultsException](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResultsException "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResultsException") exception if no results remain.

**```merge_func```** :&ensp;`MergeFuncLike`
:   Function to merge the results.

    See [MergeFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/merging/#vectorbtpro.utils.merging.MergeFunc "vectorbtpro.utils.merging.MergeFunc").

**```merge_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `merge_func`.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```return_keys```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, includes keys representing function names in the return.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for the function.

__Returns__

`Any`
:   Result of applying the function(s) to the data. If `return_keys` is True,
    returns a tuple of the results and the corresponding function keys.

### Data.sql | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L6874-L6960)

```python
Data.sql(
    query,
    dbcon=None,
    database=':memory:',
    db_config=None,
    alias='',
    params=None,
    other_objs=None,
    date_as_object=False,
    align_dtypes=True,
    squeeze=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Execute a SQL query on the current instance using DuckDB.

Establish a database connection, register the instance's data (retrieved via [Data.get](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.get "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.get"))
along with any additional objects, and execute the specified SQL query. Optionally,
align the data types with the original columns and adjust the index. If `squeeze` is True,
convert a one-column DataFrame into a Series.

__Args__

**```query```** :&ensp;`str`
:   SQL query to execute.

**```dbcon```** :&ensp;`Optional[DuckDBPyConnection]`
:   DuckDB connection to use; if not provided,
    a new connection is established.

**```database```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Identifier or path of the target database.

**```db_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for establishing the DuckDB connection.

**```alias```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Alias assigned to the query result.

**```params```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Parameters to substitute in the SQL query.

**```other_objs```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   Additional objects to register within the database.

**```date_as_object```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return date columns as objects.

**```align_dtypes```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to align result column data types with the original data.

**```squeeze```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to convert a single-column DataFrame to a Series.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.get](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.get "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.get").

__Returns__

`SeriesFrame`
:   Query result as a DataFrame or a Series if squeezed.

### Data.to_duckdb | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L6543-L6846)

```python
Data.to_duckdb(
    connection=None,
    table=None,
    schema=None,
    catalog=None,
    write_format=None,
    write_path='.',
    write_options=None,
    mkdir_kwargs=None,
    to_utc=None,
    remove_utc_tz=True,
    if_exists='fail',
    connection_config=None,
    check_dict_type=True,
    template_context=None,
    return_meta=False,
    return_connection=False
)
```

Save data to a DuckDB database.

This method saves the internal data to a DuckDB database. Each feature or symbol in the data
dictionary is processed individually. The target for saving can be either a database table
or a file, depending on the provided arguments.

If `connection` is None or a string, the method resolves a connection using
[DuckDBData.resolve_connection](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection"). The connection is not
disposed automatically if either `return_meta` or `return_connection` is True.

When `write_format` is not provided and `write_path` specifies a directory, each feature
or symbol is persisted to its own table (see <https://duckdb.org/docs/guides/python/import_pandas>).
Specifying `catalog` or `schema` sets the default context for the connection, and a new schema
is created if the given `schema` does not exist.

The `if_exists` argument controls the behavior when a table with the same name already exists:

* fail: Raise an error.

* replace: Drop the existing table.

* append: Append the new data to the existing table.

If `write_format` is specified (as "csv", "parquet", or "json") and `write_path` is a
directory or a path without a file suffix, each feature or symbol is saved to a separate file
with the appropriate format extension. Data is written using the `COPY` command, and options
for that command can be provided either as a dictionary or a preformatted string.

For datetime handling, the parameters `to_utc` and `remove_utc_tz` are passed to [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt").

__Args__

**```connection```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, DuckDBPyConnection, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Database connection string or instance.

    If None or a string, a connection is resolved via
    [DuckDBData.resolve_connection](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection").

**```table```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Name of the target table.

    If not provided, the key from the data dictionary is used.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Name of the schema to use.

    A new schema is created if it does not exist.

**```catalog```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Name of the catalog to set as default for the connection.

**```write_format```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Format for writing data to a file.

    Must be "csv", "parquet", or "json" if specified.

**```write_path```** :&ensp;`Union[PathLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   File path or directory where data is saved.

    If a directory or a path without a file suffix, each feature or symbol is saved
    to a separate file with the format extension.

**```write_options```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, dict, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Options to pass to the `COPY` command.

    Provide these as a dictionary or a preformatted string.

**```mkdir_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[KwargsLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Keyword arguments for directory creation.

    See [check_mkdir](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/path_/#vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir "vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir").

**```to_utc```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, str, Sequence[str], feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Specifies whether to localize or convert datetime fields to UTC.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt").

**```remove_utc_tz```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Indicates whether to remove the timezone after converting to UTC.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt").

**```if_exists```** :&ensp;`Union[str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Action to take if the target table already exists.

    Options are "fail", "replace", or "append".

**```connection_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a database connection.

**```check_dict_type```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to validate the type of dictionaries.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```return_meta```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns metadata including all processed arguments
    per feature or symbol.

**```return_connection```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True and a connection string was provided, returns the
    resolved DuckDB connection instead of disposing it automatically.

__Returns__

`Union[feature_dict, symbol_dict, DuckDBPyConnection, None]`
:   Metadata dictionary if
    `return_meta` is True. The resolved DuckDB connection is returned if
    `return_connection` is True, otherwise None.

### Data.to_feather | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L5983-L6064)

```python
Data.to_feather(
    path_or_buf='.',
    mkdir_kwargs=None,
    check_dict_type=True,
    template_context=None,
    return_meta=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Save data to Feather file(s) using PyArrow.

Save the instance's data as one or multiple Feather file(s). If `path_or_buf` specifies
a directory or lacks a file suffix, each feature (or symbol) is saved to a separate
file with a name based on its key. Otherwise, the data is saved to a single file.

__Args__

**```path_or_buf```** :&ensp;`Union[PathLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   File path or buffer.

    When a directory is provided or no file suffix is detected,
    the key is appended with a ".feather" extension to form the file name.

**```mkdir_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[KwargsLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Keyword arguments for directory creation.

    See [check_mkdir](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/path_/#vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir "vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir").

**```check_dict_type```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to validate the type of dictionaries.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```return_meta```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag specifying whether to return a metadata dictionary
    containing file paths and saving options.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments passed to DataFrame.to_feather.

__Returns__

`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Dictionary with metadata if `return_meta` is True, or None.

### Data.to_parquet | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L6092-L6278)

```python
Data.to_parquet(
    path_or_buf='.',
    mkdir_kwargs=None,
    partition_cols=None,
    partition_by=None,
    period_index_to='str',
    groupby_kwargs=None,
    keep_groupby_names=False,
    engine=None,
    check_dict_type=True,
    template_context=None,
    return_meta=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Save data to Parquet file(s) using PyArrow or FastParquet.

This method writes each feature or symbol's data to a Parquet file using Pandas'
`DataFrame.to_parquet. If a directory path is provided via `path_or_buf`, a separate file
is generated for each key. For a single file, specify the full file path; for multiple files,
wrap the paths using [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict").

__Args__

**```path_or_buf```** :&ensp;`Union[PathLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   File path or buffer.

    If a directory is provided, each feature or symbol is saved in a separate file.

**```mkdir_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[KwargsLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Keyword arguments for directory creation.

    See [check_mkdir](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/path_/#vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir "vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir").

**```partition_cols```** :&ensp;`Union[None, List[str], feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Column names for partitioning the data.

    Must be None if `partition_by` is provided.

**```partition_by```** :&ensp;`Union[None, AnyGroupByLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Criteria for grouping the index before partitioning.

    When provided, the index is grouped using [ArrayWrapper.get_index_grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.get_index_grouper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.get_index_grouper")
    with `groupby_kwargs`, and the resulting groups are added as partition columns.

**```period_index_to```** :&ensp;`Union[str, AnyGroupByLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Specifies how to convert a PeriodIndex.

    Use "str" to convert periods to strings or provide another method for timestamp conversion.

**```groupby_kwargs```** :&ensp;`Union[None, AnyGroupByLike, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Keyword arguments for `pandas.Series.groupby` and `pandas.Series.resample` methods.

    See [BaseIDXAccessor.get_grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/accessors/#vectorbtpro.base.accessors.BaseIDXAccessor.get_grouper "vectorbtpro.base.accessors.BaseIDXAccessor.get_grouper").

**```keep_groupby_names```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Flag indicating whether to retain original group names when partitioning.

**```engine```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Parquet engine to use; valid options are "pyarrow", "fastparquet", or "auto".

**```check_dict_type```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to validate the type of dictionaries.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```return_meta```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns a metadata dictionary containing
    file paths and configuration settings.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `DataFrame.to_parquet`.

__Returns__

`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict]`
:   Dictionary with metadata if `return_meta` is True, or None.

### Data.to_sql | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L6304-L6514)

```python
Data.to_sql(
    engine=None,
    table=None,
    schema=None,
    to_utc=None,
    remove_utc_tz=True,
    attach_row_number=False,
    from_row_number=None,
    row_number_column=None,

    check_dict_type=True,
    template_context=None,
    return_meta=False,
    return_engine=False,
    **kwargs

```

Save data to a SQL database using SQLAlchemy.

This method saves each feature or symbol from the data into a separate SQL table using
the Pandas DataFrame.to_sql method. When `engine` is provided as None or a string,
it is resolved via [SQLData.resolve_engine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine") and may be
disposed automatically unless overridden by `dispose_engine`.

__Args__

**```engine```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, EngineT, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Database engine instance, a URL string, or a mapping for per-feature/symbol configuration.

**```table```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Table name or mapping for assigning table names to each feature or symbol.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   SQL schema name or mapping; if the schema does not exist, a new one is created.

**```to_utc```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, str, Sequence[str], feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Specifies whether to localize or convert datetime fields to UTC.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt").

**```remove_utc_tz```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Indicates whether to remove the timezone after converting to UTC.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt").

**```attach_row_number```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Specifies whether to attach a row number column to the data.

**```from_row_number```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Starting row number for numbering if a row number column is attached.

**```row_number_column```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, feature_dict, symbol_dict, CustomTemplate]`
:   Name of the column to use for row numbers.

**```engine_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional configuration for the engine.

**```dispose_engine```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to dispose the engine after use.

**```check_dict_type```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to validate the type of dictionaries.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```return_meta```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns metadata for each saved table.

**```return_engine```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the database engine used.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.DataFrame.to_sql`.

__Returns__

`Union[None, feature_dict, symbol_dict, Engine]`
:   Dictionary with metadata if
    `return_meta` is True and/or engine if `return_engine` is True, or None.

### Data.transform | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/base.py#L4711-L4899)

```python
Data.transform(
    transform_func,
    *args,
    per_feature=False,
    per_symbol=False,
    pass_frame=False,
    key_wrapper_kwargs=None,
    broadcast_kwargs=None,
    template_context=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Transform data using a provided transformation function.

Depending on the configuration, the transformation function is applied to:

* the entire data if a single key is present or both `per_feature` and `per_symbol` are False,

* each feature individually if `per_feature` is True and `per_symbol` is False,

* each symbol individually if `per_symbol` is True and `per_feature` is False,

* each feature-symbol combination if both `per_feature` and `per_symbol` are True.

In cases with individual processing, if `pass_frame` is False, a Series is passed to
`transform_func`; otherwise, a one-column DataFrame is passed.

After transformation, the data is split by key and a new [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance is created. The new data
is aligned using [Data.align_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.align_data"). If the output is not a Pandas object, it is broadcast to match
the original data using `broadcast_kwargs`.

!!! note
    The returned object retains the same type and dimensionality as the input.

    * Number and names of columns remain unchanged.

    * To remove columns, use indexing or [Data.select](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.select "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.select").

    * To add columns, use column stacking or [Data.merge](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.merge "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.merge").

    * Index may change freely.

__Args__

**```transform_func```** :&ensp;`Callable`
:   Function to apply to the data.

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for `transform_func`.

**```per_feature```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Process each feature separately.

**```per_symbol```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Process each symbol separately.

**```pass_frame```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Pass a one-column DataFrame instead of a Series when processing individual keys.

**```key_wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.get_key_wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.get_key_wrapper "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.get_key_wrapper").

**```broadcast_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for broadcasting.

    See [broadcast](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast").

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `transform_func`.

__Returns__

[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data")
:   New instance with the transformed data.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`bool`

**```**kwargs```**

:   Result of executing [Data.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.run "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.run"), or [NoResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult")
    if execution fails without raising an error.

Update the data object.

Fetch new data for each feature or symbol by calling the appropriate update function via
[Data.update_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_feature") or [Data.update_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_symbol").

!!! note
    Returns a new [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance instead of modifying the current data in place.

__Args__

**```concat```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to concatenate existing data with updated/new data.

**```skip_on_error```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to skip updating a feature or symbol if an exception occurs.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

    Also passed to [Data.update_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_feature") or [Data.update_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_symbol") if accepted by
    [Data.fetch_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_feature") or [Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol").

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```return_raw```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the raw outputs from update operations.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Data.update_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_feature "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_feature") or [Data.update_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.update_symbol").

    If different features or symbols require distinct keyword arguments, provide them
    via [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict") or [feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict")/[symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict") for each.

__Returns__

`PullOutput`
:   [Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data") instance or a list of execution outputs if `return_raw` is True.

# vectorbtpro.data.decorators | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/decorators.py)

## attach_symbol_dict_methods | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/decorators.py#L22-L112)

```python
attach_symbol_dict_methods(
    cls
)
```

Attach methods for selecting and updating symbol dictionaries to a subclass of `Data`.

__Args__

**```cls```** :&ensp;`Type[T]`
:   Class to decorate.

    Must be a subclass of `Data` that defines `_key_dict_attrs` and `_updatable_attrs`.

__Returns__

`Type[T]`
:   Decorated class with the attached methods.

# vectorbtpro.data.nb | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/nb.py)

Module providing Numba-compiled functions for generating data.

This module offers a collection of functions compiled with Numba to efficiently
simulate data using statistical models such as cumulative return processes and
Geometric Brownian Motion. All functions are designed to work with NumPy arrays
and other Numba-compatible types.

## generate_gbm_data_1d_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/nb.py#L117-L147)

```python
generate_gbm_data_1d_nb(
    n_rows,
    start_value=100.0,
    mean=0.0,
    std=0.01,
    dt=1.0
)
```

Generate a one-dimensional array of data using Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM).

__Args__

**```n_rows```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Number of data points to generate.

**```start_value```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Initial value of the series.

**```mean```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Drift factor in the GBM process.

**```std```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Volatility factor in the GBM process.

**```dt```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Time increment per period.

__Returns__

`Array2d`
:   Array containing the simulated GBM data.

Generate a two-dimensional array of data using Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM), computed column-wise.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```std```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Volatility factor for the GBM process.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```dt```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Time increment used for the simulation.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

## generate_random_data_1d_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/nb.py#L31-L65)

```python
generate_random_data_1d_nb(
    n_rows,
    start_value=100.0,
    mean=0.0,
    std=0.01,
    symmetric=False
)
```

Generate a one-dimensional array of data using cumulative product of returns drawn
from a Gaussian distribution.

__Args__

**```n_rows```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Number of data points to generate.

**```start_value```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Initial value at the start of the series.

**```mean```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Mean of the Gaussian distribution for sampling returns.

**```std```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Standard deviation of the Gaussian distribution for sampling returns.

**```symmetric```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, converts negative returns to be symmetric to positive ones,
    reducing their negative impact.

__Returns__

`Array1d`
:   Array of generated data.

### DataSaver.update | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/saver.py#L108-L134)

```python
DataSaver.update(
    save_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Update data and save changes using [DataSaver.save_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/saver/#vectorbtpro.data.saver.DataSaver.save_data "vectorbtpro.data.saver.DataSaver.save_data").

This method merges update parameters, updates the data, and then calls [DataSaver.save_data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/saver/#vectorbtpro.data.saver.DataSaver.save_data "vectorbtpro.data.saver.DataSaver.save_data").
Override to add pre- and postprocessing behavior.

To cancel subsequent updates, raise [CancelledError](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/schedule_/#vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.CancelledError "vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.CancelledError").

### DataSaver.update_every | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/saver.py#L136-L167)

```python
DataSaver.update_every(
    *args,
    save_kwargs=None,
    init_save=False,
```

### DataUpdater.update_every | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/updater.py#L106-L147)

```python
DataUpdater.update_every(
    *args,
    to=None,
    tags=None,
    in_background=False,
    replace=True,
    start=True,
    start_kwargs=None,
    **update_kwargs

```

Schedule [DataUpdater.update](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/updater/#vectorbtpro.data.updater.DataUpdater.update "vectorbtpro.data.updater.DataUpdater.update") as a periodic job.

For details on `*args`, `to`, and `tags`, refer to [ScheduleManager.every](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/schedule_/#vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.every "vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.every").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for [ScheduleManager.every](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/schedule_/#vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.every "vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.every").

**```to```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Upper time boundary for scheduling updates.

**```tags```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[Hashable]]`
:   Tags used to identify the scheduled job.

**```in_background```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, the job runs as an asyncio task and
    can be stopped using [ScheduleManager.stop](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/schedule_/#vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.stop "vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.stop")

**```replace```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, remove existing jobs with matching tags.

**```start```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, start the job immediately after scheduling.

**```start_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for starting the scheduler.

    See [ScheduleManager.start](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/schedule_/#vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.start "vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.ScheduleManager.start").

**```**update_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `vectorbtpro.utils.schedule_.AsyncJob.do`.

__Returns__

None

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/alpaca.py)

Module providing the [AlpacaData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/alpaca/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData") class for fetching data from Alpaca.

## AlpacaData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/alpaca.py#L35-L562)

```python
AlpacaData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from Alpaca.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.alpaca` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

    Global settings can be provided per exchange id using the `exchanges` dictionary.

__See__

* <https://github.com/alpacahq/alpaca-py> for Alpaca API.

* [AlpacaData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/alpaca/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally (optional for crypto):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.AlpacaData.set_custom_settings(
...     client_config=dict(
...         api_key="YOUR_KEY",
...         secret_key="YOUR_SECRET"
...     )
... )
```

Pull stock data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.AlpacaData.pull(
...     "AAPL",
...     start="2024-01-01",
...     end="2025-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

Pull stock trade data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.AlpacaData.pull(
...     "AAPL",
...     start="2025-01-01",
...     end="2025-01-02",
...     data_type="trade",
... )
```

Pull crypto data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.AlpacaData.pull(
...     "BTC/USD",
...     start="2024-01-01",
...     end="2025-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

Pull option data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.AlpacaData.pull(
...     "AAPL241220C00300000",
...     start="2024-12-01",
...     end="2025-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

### AlpacaData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/alpaca.py#L249-L556)

```python
AlpacaData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    client=None,

    client_config=None,
```

Fetch a symbol from Alpaca via overriding [Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol").

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[RESTClient]`
:   Alpaca REST client instance.

    See [AlpacaData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/alpaca/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.resolve_client").

**```client_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies the type of client to create;
    expected values are "crypto", "stock(s)", or "option(s)".

    Automatically determined based on the symbol. Also see [AlpacaData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/alpaca/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.resolve_client").

**```client_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

    See [AlpacaData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/alpaca/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.alpaca.AlpacaData.resolve_client").

**```data_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Data type to fetch.

    Options: "bar(s)", "quote(s)", or "trade(s)".

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    See [split_freq_str](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```limit```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Upper limit of number of data points to return.

**```adjustment```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of corporate action data normalization.

    Options: "raw", "split", "dividend", or "all".

**```feed```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Stock data feed to retrieve from.

    Options: "iex", "sip", "delayed_sip", or "otc".

    OTC and SIP are available with premium data subscriptions.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Chronological order of response based on the timestamp.

    Options: "asc" or "desc".

**```asof```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Asof date of the queried stock symbol (e.g., "2024-01-01").

**```currency```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Currency of all prices in ISO 4217 format (e.g., "USD", "EUR").

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### AlpacaData.list_symbols | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/alpaca.py#L108-L187)

```python
AlpacaData.list_symbols(
    pattern=None,
    use_regex=False,
    sort=True,
    status=None,
    asset_class=None,
    exchange=None,
    trading_client=None,
    client_config=None
)
```

Return a list of symbols that match the specified criteria.

This method filters symbols using [CustomData.key_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/custom/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match")
based on the provided pattern.

!!! note
    If encountering an authorization error, verify that the `paper` flag in `client_config` is set
    appropriately based on the account credentials used (paper trading or live).

__Args__

**```pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter symbols.

**```use_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the pattern is a regular expression.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Specifies whether to return the symbols in sorted order.

**```status```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Filter for asset status.

    For possible values, refer to `alpaca.trading.enums`.

**```asset_class```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Filter for asset class.

    For possible values, refer to `alpaca.trading.enums`.

**```exchange```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Filter for the exchange.

    For possible values, refer to `alpaca.trading.enums`.

**```trading_client```** :&ensp;`Optional[RESTClient]`
:   Existing trading client instance.

**```client_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of symbol strings.

### AlpacaData.resolve_client | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/alpaca.py#L189-L247)

```python
AlpacaData.resolve_client(
    client=None,
    client_type=None,
    **client_config
)
```

Resolve and return a trading client instance based on the provided parameters.

If a client is provided, it must be of the type corresponding to `client_type`:

* "crypto": `alpaca.data.historical.CryptoHistoricalDataClient`

* "stock(s)": `alpaca.data.historical.StockHistoricalDataClient`

* "option(s)": `alpaca.data.historical.OptionHistoricalDataClient`

If no client is provided, a new instance is created using the supplied `client_config`.

__Args__

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[RESTClient]`
:   Alpaca REST client instance.

**```client_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies the type of client to create;
    expected values are "crypto", "stock(s)", or "option(s)".

**```**client_config```**
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

__Returns__

`RESTClient`
:   Instance of the trading client.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.av | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/av.py)

Module providing the [AVData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/av/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData") class for fetching data from the Alpha Vantage API.

## AVData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/av.py#L43-L670)

```python
AVData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from the Alpha Vantage API.

In addition to using the <https://github.com/RomelTorres/alpha_vantage> package,
this class can parse the API documentation with [AVData.parse_api_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/av/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta "vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta") (using BeautifulSoup4)
to dynamically build API queries (pass `use_parser=True`).

This flexible approach allows for rapid adaptation to changes in the API.
If the provider updates its documentation, override [AVData.parse_api_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/av/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta "vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta") to adjust the parsing logic.

If parsing fails, disable it and manually specify the required parameters by
setting `function` and disabling `match_params`.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.av` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

* <https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/> for API endpoints and parameters.

* [AVData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/av/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.AVData.set_custom_settings(
...     apikey="YOUR_KEY"
... )
```

Pull data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.AVData.pull(
...     "GOOGL",
...     timeframe="1 day",
... )

>>> data = vbt.AVData.pull(
...     "BTC_USD",
...     timeframe="30 minutes",  # premium?
...     category="digital-currency",
...     outputsize="full"
... )

>>> data = vbt.AVData.pull(
...     "REAL_GDP",
...     category="economic-indicators"
... )
```

### AVData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/av.py#L182-L665)

```python
AVData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    use_parser=None,
    apikey=None,
    api_meta=None,
    category=None,
    function=None,
    timeframe=None,
    tz=None,
    adjusted=None,
    extended=None,
    slice=None,
    series_type=None,
    time_period=None,
    outputsize=None,
    match_params=None,
    params=None,
    read_csv_kwargs=None,
    silence_warnings=None
)
```

Fetch symbol data from Alpha Vantage.

Uses the `alpha_vantage` package if `use_parser` is False or if it is not specified and
the package is installed. Otherwise, parses the API documentation directly to retrieve data.
When using the parser, refer to <https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/> for API endpoints and parameters.

!!! note
    Supports the CSV format only.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

    May combine symbol/from_currency and market/to_currency using an underscore.

**```use_parser```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to use the parser instead of the `alpha_vantage` package.

**```apikey```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   API key for authenticating with Alpha Vantage.

**```api_meta```** :&ensp;`Optional[dict]`
:   API meta information.

    If None, [AVData.parse_api_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/av/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta "vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta") is used when `function` is not provided
    or when `match_params` is True.

**```category```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, AlphaVantage, Type[AlphaVantage]]`
:   API category.

    Used when `function` is not provided or when `match_params` is True.

    Supported values include:

    * `alpha_vantage.alphavantage.AlphaVantage` instance, class, or class name

    * "time-series-data" or "time-series"

    * "fundamental-data" or "fundamentals"

    * "foreign-exchange", "forex", or "fx"

    * "digital-currency", "cryptocurrencies", "cryptocurrency", or "crypto"

    * "commodities"

    * "economic-indicators"

    * "technical-indicators" or "indicators"

**```function```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, callable]`
:   API function.

    If None, it is determined based on `timeframe`, `adjusted`, and `extended`.
    Required for technical indicators, economic indicators, and fundamental data.
    See the keys in sub-dictionaries returned by [AVData.parse_api_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/av/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta "vectorbtpro.data.custom.av.AVData.parse_api_meta").

    If `use_parser` is False, it can be the method (or its name) of the `category` class.
    For example, if `category` is `alpha_vantage.timeseries.TimeSeries`,
    `function` can be "get_daily", "get_intraday", etc.

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    For time series, forex, and crypto, the interval is inferred from the function name.
    Defaults to "60min" if `extended` is True, otherwise "daily".
    See [split_freq_str](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```adjusted```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to return time series adjusted for
    historical splits and dividend events.

**```extended```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to return historical intraday time series for
    the trailing 2 years.

**```slice```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Slice of the trailing 2 years.

**```series_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Desired price type in the time series.

**```time_period```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of data points used to calculate each window value.

**```outputsize```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Output size.

    Supported values:

    * "compact": returns only the latest 100 data points

    * "full": returns the complete time series

**```match_params```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to match parameters with those required by the endpoint.

    Otherwise, only the resolved `function`, `apikey`, `datatype="csv"`, and `params` are used.

**```params```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments passed as key/value pairs in the URL.

**```read_csv_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.read_csv`.

    See <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_csv.html> for arguments.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### AVData.list_symbols | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/av.py#L105-L129)

```python
AVData.list_symbols(
    keywords,
    apikey=None,
    sort=True
)
```

Return a list of unique symbols matching the specified keywords.

__Args__

**```keywords```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Search term used to find relevant symbols.

**```apikey```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   API key for authenticating with Alpha Vantage.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to sort the symbols alphabetically.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of unique symbols.

Parse metadata from the Alpha Vantage API documentation.

This cached class method downloads and parses the API documentation at
<https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation> using BeautifulSoup4. The resulting metadata includes
required and optional parameters for each API function.

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Dictionary containing the parsed API metadata organized by documentation sections.

Data class for fetching data from Databento.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.bento` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

* <https://github.com/databento/databento-python> for the Databento Python client.

* [BentoData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/bento/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.BentoData.set_custom_settings(
...     client_config=dict(
...         key="YOUR_KEY"
...     )
... )
```

Pull data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.BentoData.pull(
...     "AAPL",
...     dataset="XNAS.ITCH"
... )
```

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.BentoData.pull(
...     "AAPL",
...     dataset="XNAS.ITCH",
...     timeframe="hourly",
...     start="one week ago"
... )
```

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.BentoData.pull(
...     "ES.FUT",
...     dataset="GLBX.MDP3",
...     stype_in="parent",
...     schema="mbo",
...     start="2022-06-10T14:30",
...     end="2022-06-11",
...     limit=1000
... )
```

### BentoData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/bento.py#L137-L280)

```python
BentoData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    client=None,
    client_config=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    resolve_dates=None,
    timeframe=None,
    tz=None,
    dataset=None,
    schema=None,
    return_params=False,
    df_kwargs=None,
    **params
)
```

Fetch a symbol from Databento.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

    Can be provided in the `DATASET:SYMBOL` format if `dataset` is not specified.

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[databento.historical.client.Historical]`
:   Client instance.

    See [BentoData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/bento/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.resolve_client").

**```client_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

    See [BentoData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/bento/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.resolve_client").

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```resolve_dates```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to resolve `start` and `end` to UTC timestamps.

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    If both `timeframe` and `schema` are provided, an error is raised.
    See [split_freq_str](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```dataset```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Dataset identifier.

    See `databento.historical.client.Historical.get_range` for details.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Schema identifier.

    See `databento.historical.client.Historical.get_range` for details.

**```return_params```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return the client and resolved parameters instead of fetched data.

    Used by [BentoData.get_cost](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/bento/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.get_cost "vectorbtpro.data.custom.bento.BentoData.get_cost").

**```df_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `databento.common.dbnstore.DBNStore.to_df`.

**```**params```**
:   Keyword arguments for `databento.historical.client.Historical.get_range`.

__Returns__

`Union[float, SymbolData]`
:   If `return_params` is True, returns the client and final parameters.
    Otherwise, returns the fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.binance | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/binance.py)

Module providing the [BinanceData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/binance/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.binance.BinanceData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.binance.BinanceData") class for fetching data from Binance using the Python Binance API.

## BinanceData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/binance.py#L42-L373)

```python
BinanceData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from Binance using the Python Binance API.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.binance` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

!!! note
    If using an exchange from the US, Japan, or another TLD, pass `tld="us"` in
    `client_config` when creating the client.

__See__

* <https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance> for the API client.

* [BinanceData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/binance/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.binance.BinanceData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.binance.BinanceData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.BinanceData.set_custom_settings(
...     client_config=dict(
...         api_key="YOUR_KEY",
...         api_secret="YOUR_SECRET"
...     )
... )
```

Pull data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.BinanceData.pull(
...     "BTCUSDT",
...     start="2020-01-01",
...     end="2021-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

List and return all Binance symbols.

Retrieves symbol data from the Binance API and filters the symbols using
[CustomData.key_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/custom/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match") if a pattern is provided.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the symbols in sorted order.

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[Client]`
:   Binance client instance.

**```client_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of Binance symbols.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ccxt.py)

Module providing the [CCXTData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData") class for fetching data using the CCXT API.

## CCXTData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ccxt.py#L38-L591)

```python
CCXTData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data using CCXT.

This class provides functionality to retrieve market data via the CCXT API.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.ccxt` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

    Global settings can be configured per exchange identifier using the `exchanges` dictionary.

__See__

* <https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt> for more information on CCXT.

* [CCXTData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.CCXTData.set_exchange_settings(
...     exchange_name="binance",
...     populate_=True,
...     exchange_config=dict(
...         apiKey="YOUR_KEY",
...         secret="YOUR_SECRET"
...     )
... )
```

Pull data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.CCXTData.pull(
...     "BTCUSDT",
...     exchange="binance",
...     start="2020-01-01",
...     end="2021-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

### CCXTData.fetch_find_earliest_date | static method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ccxt.py#L276-L339)

```python
CCXTData.fetch_find_earliest_date(
    fetch_func,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    tz=None,
    for_internal_use=False
)
```

Find the earliest timestamp using binary search by calling the provided fetch function.

__Args__

**```fetch_func```** :&ensp;`Callable`
:   Function to fetch data.

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```for_internal_use```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the search is for internal processing.

__Returns__

`Optional[Timestamp]`
:   Earliest timestamp if data is available, otherwise None.

:   Exchange identifier or instance.

    See [CCXTData.resolve_exchange](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.resolve_exchange "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.resolve_exchange").

:   Exchange configuration.

    See [CCXTData.resolve_exchange](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.resolve_exchange "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.resolve_exchange").

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    See [split_freq_str](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```find_earliest_date```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to determine the earliest available date.

    Uses [CCXTData.find_earliest_date](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.find_earliest_date "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.find_earliest_date") when enabled.

**```limit```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of data items to return.

**```delay```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Delay in seconds between requests.

    !!! note
        Use only if `enableRateLimit` is not set.

**```retries```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of retries on failure to fetch data.

**```fetch_params```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Exchange-specific parameters for `fetch_ohlcv`.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the progress bar.

    See [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```return_fetch_method```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the fetch method and settings instead of fetched data.

__Returns__

`Union[dict, SymbolData]`
:   If `return_params` is True, returns the metadata around the fetching function.
    Otherwise, returns the fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### CCXTData.find_earliest_date | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ccxt.py#L341-L364)

```python
CCXTData.find_earliest_date(
    symbol,
    for_internal_use=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Find the earliest timestamp for a symbol using binary search.

This method calls [CCXTData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.fetch_symbol") to retrieve data for the specified symbol,
then performs a binary search to determine the earliest available date.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```for_internal_use```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the search is for internal processing.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [CCXTData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ccxt/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ccxt.CCXTData.fetch_symbol").

__Returns__

`Optional[Timestamp]`
:   Earliest timestamp if data is available, otherwise None.

## CSVData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/csv.py#L32-L296)

Data class for fetching CSV and TSV data files.

This class extends `FileData` and provides methods for verifying file types,
resolving metadata keys, and reading CSV files using pandas.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.csv` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

### CSVData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/csv.py#L88-L245)

```python
CSVData.fetch_key(
    key,
    path=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    tz=None,
    start_row=None,
    end_row=None,
    header=None,
    index_col=None,
    parse_dates=None,
    chunk_func=None,
    squeeze=None,
    **read_kwargs
)
```

Fetch the CSV file for a given feature or symbol.

Arguments `skiprows` and `nrows` are automatically determined based on `start_row` and `end_row`.

If either `start` or `end` is provided, the entire CSV file is read before applying date filtering.

For additional parameters, refer to `pd.read_csv` documentation.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```path```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   File path to the CSV file.

    If not provided, `key` is used as the file path.

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    The object's timezone will be used. See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    The object's timezone will be used. See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```start_row```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Starting row index (inclusive), excluding header rows.

**```end_row```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Ending row index (exclusive), excluding header rows.

**```header```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[int, Sequence[int]]]`
:   Row number(s) to use as the header.

    See `pd.read_csv` for details on this argument.

**```index_col```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Column to use as the index.

    If set to False, it is treated as None. See `pd.read_csv` for details on this argument.

**```parse_dates```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to parse dates.

    See `pd.read_csv` for details on this argument.

**```chunk_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function for processing and concatenating chunks from a `TextFileReader`.

    Invoked only if `iterator` or `chunksize` is specified.

**```squeeze```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to convert a single-column DataFrame to a Series.

**```**read_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.read_csv`.

    See <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_csv.html> for arguments.

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### CSVData.update_key | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/csv.py#L273-L290)

```python
CSVData.update_key(
    key,
    key_is_feature=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Update the CSV data for a feature or symbol.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```key_is_feature```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the key represents a feature.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [CSVData.fetch_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/csv/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.csv.CSVData.fetch_feature "vectorbtpro.data.custom.csv.CSVData.fetch_feature") or [CSVData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/csv/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.csv.CSVData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.csv.CSVData.fetch_symbol").

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Updated data and a metadata dictionary.

### CustomData.key_match | static method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/custom.py#L113-L131)

```python
CustomData.key_match(
    key,
    pattern,
    use_regex=False
)
```

Return a match result indicating whether the given key matches the specified pattern.

If `use_regex` is True, the pattern is interpreted as a regular expression.

Otherwise, a glob-style pattern is used.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Key to evaluate.

**```pattern```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Pattern to compare against.

**```use_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the pattern is a regular expression.

__Returns__

`Optional[re.Match]`
:   Match object if the key matches the pattern; otherwise, None.
