# vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/duckdb.py)

Module providing the [DuckDBData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData") class for interacting with DuckDB databases.

## DuckDBData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/duckdb.py#L39-L1063)

```python
DuckDBData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from a DuckDB database.

This class provides methods to pull tables, execute queries, and read Parquet files.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.duckdb` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

* [DuckDBData.pull](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.pull "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.pull") for argument details.

* [DuckDBData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_key") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the connection settings globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.DuckDBData.set_custom_settings(connection="database.duckdb")
```

Pull tables:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.DuckDBData.pull(["TABLE1", "TABLE2"])
```

Rename tables:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.DuckDBData.pull(
...     ["SYMBOL1", "SYMBOL2"],
...     table=vbt.key_dict({
...         "SYMBOL1": "TABLE1",
...         "SYMBOL2": "TABLE2"
...     })
... )
```

Pull queries:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.DuckDBData.pull(
...     ["SYMBOL1", "SYMBOL2"],
...     query=vbt.key_dict({
...         "SYMBOL1": "SELECT * FROM TABLE1",
...         "SYMBOL2": "SELECT * FROM TABLE2"
...     })
... )
```

Pull Parquet files:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.DuckDBData.pull(
...     ["SYMBOL1", "SYMBOL2"],
...     read_path=vbt.key_dict({
...         "SYMBOL1": "s1.parquet",
...         "SYMBOL2": "s2.parquet"
...     })
... )
```

### DuckDBData.fetch_feature | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/duckdb.py#L1001-L1012)

Fetch the data table for a feature using the underlying [DuckDBData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_key") method.

__Args__

**```feature```** :&ensp;`Feature`
:   Feature identifier.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [DuckDBData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_key").

__Returns__

`FeatureData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### DuckDBData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/duckdb.py#L700-L999)

```python
DuckDBData.fetch_key(
    key,
    table=None,
    schema=None,
    catalog=None,
    read_path=None,
    read_format=None,
    read_options=None,
    query=None,
    connection=None,
    connection_config=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    align_dates=None,
    parse_dates=None,
    to_utc=None,
    tz=None,
    index_col=None,
    squeeze=None,
    df_kwargs=None,
    **sql_kwargs
)
```

Fetch a feature or symbol from a DuckDB database.

Can use a table name (defaulting to the key) or a custom SQL query.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

    If both `table` and `query` are None, the key becomes the table name.
    The key can be provided in either `SCHEMA:TABLE` or `CATALOG:SCHEMA:TABLE` format,
    in which case the `schema` argument is ignored.

**```table```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Table name.

    Cannot be used together with `read_path` or `query`.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Schema name.

    Cannot be used together with `read_path` or `query`.

**```catalog```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Catalog name.

    Cannot be used together with `read_path` or `query`.

**```read_path```** :&ensp;`Optional[PathLike]`
:   Path to a file to read.

    Cannot be used together with `table`, `schema`, `catalog`, or `query`.

**```read_format```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   File format.

    Allowed values are "csv", "parquet", and "json".
    Requires `read_path` to be set.

**```read_options```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, dict]`
:   Options used to read the file.

    Requires both `read_path` and `read_format` to be set.
    Uses [DuckDBData.format_read_options](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.format_read_options "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.format_read_options") to transform options into a string.

**```query```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, DuckDBPyRelation]`
:   Custom SQL query.

    Cannot be used together with `catalog`, `schema`, or `table`.

**```connection```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, DuckDBPyConnection]`
:   Database connection string or instance.

    See [DuckDBData.resolve_connection](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection").

**```connection_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a database connection.

    See [DuckDBData.resolve_connection](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.resolve_connection").

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[Any]`
:   Start value for filtering.

    Interpreted as a datetime when the index is of datetime type and `align_dates` is True.
    Cannot be used together with `query`; include the condition in the query.

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[Any]`
:   End value for filtering.

    Interpreted as a datetime when the index is of datetime type and `align_dates` is True.
    Cannot be used together with `query`; include the condition in the query.

**```align_dates```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to align `start` and `end` to the index timezone.

    Retrieves one row (using `LIMIT 1`) and uses `SQLData.prepare_dt` to obtain the index.

**```parse_dates```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, Sequence[str]]`
:   Specifies whether to parse dates.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.prepare_dt").

**```to_utc```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, str, Sequence[str]]`
:   Specifies whether to localize or convert
    datetime fields to UTC.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.prepare_dt").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```index_col```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeSequence[IntStr]]`
:   Column position(s) or name(s) to use as the index.

If catalog is None, the method searches all catalogs and prefixes each schema with

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to sort the resulting schema names.

**```catalog```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specific catalog to search for schemas.

    If provided, schemas are not prefixed.

**```incl_system```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to include system schemas.

**```connection```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, DuckDBPyConnection]`

### DuckDBData.list_tables | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/duckdb.py#L319-L457)

```python
DuckDBData.list_tables(
    *,
    catalog_pattern=None,
    schema_pattern=None,
    table_pattern=None,
    use_regex=False,
    sort=True,
    catalog=None,
    schema=None,
    incl_system=False,
    incl_temporary=False,
    incl_views=True,
    connection=None,
    connection_config=None
)
```

List tables and views from the database.

This method queries the database's information schema to retrieve a list of tables
and views. When `schema` is not provided, it searches across all available schemas
and prefixes each table name with its corresponding catalog and schema names
(unless only a single current schema is detected). If a specific `schema` is provided,
the returned table names are not prefixed.

Uses [CustomData.key_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/custom/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match") to perform pattern matching
on schema and table names.

__Args__

**```catalog_pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter catalog names.

**```schema_pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter schema names.

**```table_pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter table names.

**```use_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the pattern is a regular expression.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates whether to sort the resulting list.

**```catalog```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Filter results to the specified catalog.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Filter results to the specified schema.

    Use `"current_schema"` to refer to the current schema.

**```incl_system```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to include system tables and views.

**```incl_temporary```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Include temporary tables.

**```incl_views```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Include view objects.

**```connection```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, DuckDBPyConnection]`
:   Database connection string or instance.

**```connection_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a database connection.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of table names, optionally prefixed with catalog and schema names.

### DuckDBData.update_key | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/duckdb.py#L1027-L1057)

```python
DuckDBData.update_key(
    key,
    from_last_index=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Update the data table for a specified feature or symbol.

This method selects fetch parameters via [Data.select_fetch_kwargs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.select_fetch_kwargs "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.select_fetch_kwargs") and determines
whether to start from the last index based on the `from_last_index` flag or the presence
of a "query" in the keyword arguments. It then updates and fetches the data table by
invoking either `fetch_feature` or `fetch_symbol` depending on the object's orientation.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```from_last_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to update data starting from the last index.

    If not provided, it is inferred from the presence of a "query" in the merged keyword arguments.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [DuckDBData.fetch_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_feature "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_feature") or [DuckDBData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/duckdb/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.duckdb.DuckDBData.fetch_symbol").

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Updated data and a metadata dictionary.

### FeatherData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/feather.py#L70-L139)

```python
FeatherData.fetch_key(
    key,
    path=None,
    tz=None,
    index_col=None,
    squeeze=None,
    **read_kwargs
)
```

Fetch a Feather file for a given feature or symbol.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```path```** :&ensp;`str`
:   File path for the Feather file.

    If None, `key` is used as the file path.

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```index_col```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeSequence[IntStr]]`
:   Column position(s) or name(s) to use as the index.

    Applies if the fetched data has a default index.

**```squeeze```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to convert a single-column DataFrame to a Series.

**```**read_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.read_feather`.

    See <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_feather.html> for arguments.

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### FileData.match_path | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/file.py#L64-L111)

```python
FileData.match_path(
    path,
    match_regex=None,
    sort_paths=True,
    recursive=True,
    extension=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Obtain a list of file system paths that match the specified criteria.

If the provided path is a directory and [FileData.is_dir_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.is_dir_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.is_dir_match") returns True, the
directory is returned directly. Otherwise, if the path is a directory, each file within
it is checked using [FileData.is_file_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.is_file_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.is_file_match"). When a regex pattern is provided via
`match_regex`, only paths matching the pattern are included.

__Args__

**```path```** :&ensp;`PathLike`
:   Starting path to search for files.

**```match_regex```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Regular expression for filtering paths.

**```sort_paths```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to sort the resulting paths.

**```recursive```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to search subdirectories recursively.

**```extension```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specifies a file extension to filter by (without the dot).

**```**kwargs```**
:   Additional keyword arguments.

__Returns__

`List[Path]`
:   List of paths that match the specified criteria.

### FileData.pull | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/file.py#L155-L289)

```python
FileData.pull(
    keys=None,
    *,
    keys_are_features=None,
    features=None,
    symbols=None,
    paths=None,
    match_paths=None,
    match_regex=None,
    sort_paths=None,
    match_path_kwargs=None,
    path_to_key_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Pull file data from the filesystem based on provided keys or paths.

Overrides [Data.pull](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.pull "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.pull") to handle file system paths.

Use one of `features`, `symbols`, or `paths` to specify the file location. The file paths
may be provided as strings, `pathlib.Path` objects, or glob patterns.

Set `match_paths` to False to bypass path parsing and perform a standard pull operation from
[Data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data").

__Args__

**```keys```** :&ensp;`MaybeKeys`
:   Feature or symbol identifier(s).

**```keys_are_features```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether the keys represent features.

**```features```** :&ensp;`MaybeFeatures`
:   Feature identifier(s).

**```symbols```** :&ensp;`MaybeSymbols`
:   Symbol identifier(s).

**```paths```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   One or more file paths or glob patterns.

**```match_paths```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to enable or disable path matching.

**```match_regex```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Regular expression for filtering paths.

**```sort_paths```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Indicates if the matched paths should be sorted.

**```match_path_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [FileData.match_path](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.match_path "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.match_path").

**```path_to_key_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [FileData.path_to_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.path_to_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.path_to_key").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [FileData.pull](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.pull "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData.pull").

__Returns__

[FileData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData")
:   Instance of [FileData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/file/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.file.FileData") containing the pulled file data.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/finpy.py)

Module providing the [FinPyData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/finpy/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData") class for fetching financial data using the findatapy API.

## FinPyData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/finpy.py#L36-L405)

```python
FinPyData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching financial data using the findatapy API.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.finpy` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

    Global settings can be provided per exchange id using the `exchanges` dictionary.

__See__

* <https://github.com/cuemacro/findatapy> for more information on findatapy.

* [FinPyData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/finpy/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Pull data (keyword argument format):

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.FinPyData.pull(
...     "EURUSD",
...     start="14 June 2016",
...     end="15 June 2016",
...     timeframe="tick",
...     category="fx",
...     fields=["bid", "ask"],
...     data_source="dukascopy"
... )
```

Pull data (string format):

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.FinPyData.pull(
...     "fx.dukascopy.tick.NYC.EURUSD.bid,ask",
...     start="14 June 2016",
...     end="15 June 2016",
... )
```

### FinPyData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/finpy.py#L238-L399)

```python
FinPyData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    market=None,
    market_config=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    timeframe=None,
    tz=None,
    **request_kwargs
)
```

Fetch symbol data using findatapy.

Overrides [Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol") to retrieve and process symbol data
from findatapy.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

    Accepts formats such as "fx.bloomberg.daily.NYC.EURUSD.close".

    The fields `freq`, `cut`, `tickers`, and `fields` are optional.

**```market```** :&ensp;`Optional[MarketT]`
:   Market instance.

    See [FinPyData.resolve_market](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/finpy/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData.resolve_market "vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData.resolve_market").

**```market_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Client configuration.

    See [FinPyData.resolve_market](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/finpy/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData.resolve_market "vectorbtpro.data.custom.finpy.FinPyData.resolve_market").

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    See [split_freq_str](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```**request_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `findatapy.market.marketdatarequest.MarketDataRequest`.

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### FinPyData.list_symbols | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/finpy.py#L140-L236)

```python
FinPyData.list_symbols(
    pattern=None,
    use_regex=False,
    sort=True,
    config_manager=None,
    config_manager_config=None,
    category=None,
    data_source=None,
    freq=None,
    cut=None,
    tickers=None,
    dict_filter=None,
    smart_group=False,
    return_fields=None,
    combine_parts=True
)
```

List symbols matching the specified filters.

This method passes most parameters to `findatapy.util.ConfigManager.free_form_tickers_regex_query`
and uses [CustomData.key_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/custom/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match") to filter symbols based on `pattern`.

__Args__

**```pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter symbols.

**```use_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the pattern is a regular expression.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the symbols in sorted order.

**```config_manager```** :&ensp;`Optional[ConfigManager]`
:   Optional configuration manager instance.

**```config_manager_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the configuration manager.

**```category```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Filter for the symbol category.

**```data_source```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Filter for the data source.

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Filter for the frequency.

**```cut```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Filter for cut information.

**```tickers```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Filter for tickers.

**```dict_filter```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Dictionary of additional filters.

**```smart_group```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to apply smart grouping to symbols.

**```return_fields```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Fields to include in the query output.

**```combine_parts```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to combine parts of symbol components into a single string.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of symbols that match the specified filters.

### FinPyData.resolve_config_manager | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/finpy.py#L109-L138)

```python
FinPyData.resolve_config_manager(
    config_manager=None,
    **config_manager_config
)
```

Resolve and return a ConfigManager instance.

__Args__

**```config_manager```** :&ensp;`Optional[ConfigManager]`

### GBMData.generate_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/gbm.py#L43-L112)

```python
GBMData.generate_key(
    key,
    index,
    columns=None,
    start_value=None,
    mean=None,
    std=None,
    dt=None,
    seed=None,
    jitted=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate synthetic data for a feature or symbol using geometric Brownian motion.

!!! note
    When setting a seed, pass a seed per feature or symbol using
    [feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict")/[symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict") or, more generally,
    [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict").

__See__

[generate_gbm_data_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/nb/#vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_gbm_data_nb "vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_gbm_data_nb")

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Pandas index representing time.

**```columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[Hashable, IndexLike]]`
:   Column names.

    Provide a single hashable value to create a Series.

**```start_value```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Initial value at time 0.

    Note that this value does not appear as the first data point.

**```mean```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Drift or average percentage change.

**```std```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Standard deviation of the percentage change.

**```dt```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Time increment for one period.

**```seed```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Random seed for deterministic output.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Generated data and a metadata dictionary.

### GBMOHLCData.generate_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/gbm_ohlc.py#L45-L111)

```python
GBMOHLCData.generate_symbol(
    symbol,
    index,
    n_ticks=None,
    start_value=None,
    mean=None,
    std=None,
    dt=None,
    seed=None,
    jitted=None,
    template_context=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate synthetic OHLC data for a given symbol using geometric Brownian motion.

!!! note
    When setting a seed, provide a seed per symbol using [symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict").

__See__

* [generate_gbm_data_1d_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/nb/#vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_gbm_data_1d_nb "vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_gbm_data_1d_nb") for generating ticks.

* [ohlc_every_1d_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/ohlcv/nb/#vectorbtpro.ohlcv.nb.ohlc_every_1d_nb "vectorbtpro.ohlcv.nb.ohlc_every_1d_nb") for aggregating ticks into OHLC bars.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Pandas index representing time periods.

**```n_ticks```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Number of ticks per bar.

    Flexible argument that can be provided as a template with a context
    containing `symbol` and `index`.

**```start_value```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Initial value at time 0.

    Note that this value does not appear as the first value in the resulting data.

**```mean```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Drift factor in the GBM process.

**```std```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Volatility factor in the GBM process.

**```dt```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Time increment per period.

**```seed```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Random seed for deterministic output.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`any`
:   Jitting option; refer to [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Generated data and a metadata dictionary.

### HDFData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/hdf.py#L216-L336)

```python
HDFData.fetch_key(
    key,
    path=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    tz=None,
    start_row=None,
    end_row=None,
    chunk_func=None,
    **read_kwargs
)
```

Fetch the HDF object of a feature or symbol.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```path```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   File path to the HDF file.

    Will be resolved using [HDFData.split_hdf_path](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/hdf/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.hdf.HDFData.split_hdf_path "vectorbtpro.data.custom.hdf.HDFData.split_hdf_path").

    If None, `key` is used as the file path.

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    Extracts the object's index and compares it to this date using the object's timezone.
    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

    !!! note
        Applicable only if the object was saved in table format.

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    Extracts the object's index and compares it to this date using the object's timezone.
    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

    !!! note
        Applicable only if the object was saved in table format.

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```start_row```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Index of the starting row (inclusive).

    Also used for querying the index.

**```end_row```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Index of the ending row (exclusive).

    Also used for querying the index.

**```chunk_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function for processing and concatenating chunks from a `TableIterator `.

    Invoked only if `iterator` or `chunksize` is specified.

**```**read_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.read_hdf`.

    See <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_hdf.html> for arguments.

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### HDFData.split_hdf_path | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/hdf.py#L87-L121)

```python
HDFData.split_hdf_path(
    path,
    key=None
)
```

Split the provided HDF path into its file and key components.

If the given path does not immediately correspond to an existing file,
the method recursively inspects parent directories to locate the HDF file
and constructs the key from intermediate path segments.

__Args__

**```path```** :&ensp;`PathLike`
:   Path to the HDF object.

**```key```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Key to identify the object within the HDF file.

    Defaults to None. When provided, it is combined with portions of the path during recursion.

__Returns__

`Tuple[Path, Optional[str]]`
:   Tuple containing the HDF file path and the associated key.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.ndl | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ndl.py)

Module providing the [NDLData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ndl/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ndl.NDLData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ndl.NDLData") class for accessing data from Nasdaq Data Link.

## NDLData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ndl.py#L29-L190)

```python
NDLData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from Nasdaq Data Link.

This class provides methods to pull data from Nasdaq Data Link using its API.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.ndl` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

* <https://github.com/Nasdaq/data-link-python> for the official API documentation.

* [NDLData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/ndl/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.ndl.NDLData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.ndl.NDLData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.NDLData.set_custom_settings(
...     api_key="YOUR_KEY"
... )
```

Pull a dataset:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.NDLData.pull(
...     "FRED/GDP",
...     start="2001-12-31",
...     end="2005-12-31"
... )
```

Pull a datatable:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.NDLData.pull(
...     "MER/F1",
...     data_format="datatable",
...     compnumber="39102",
...     paginate=True
... )
```

### NDLData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/ndl.py#L76-L184)

```python
NDLData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    api_key=None,
    data_format=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    tz=None,
    column_indices=None,
    **params
)
```

Fetch a symbol's data from Nasdaq Data Link.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```api_key```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   API key.

**```data_format```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Data format.

    Supported formats: "dataset" and "datatable".

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```column_indices```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeIterable[int]]`
:   Specific column(s) to retrieve.

    Column 0 (date) is always returned, with data columns starting at index 1.

**```**params```**
:   Keyword arguments for Nasdaq Data Link as field/value parameters.

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### ParquetData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/parquet.py#L173-L244)

```python
ParquetData.fetch_key(
    key,
    path=None,
    tz=None,
    squeeze=None,
    keep_partition_cols=None,
    engine=None,
    **read_kwargs
)
```

Fetch the Parquet file corresponding to a feature or symbol.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```path```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   File path to the Parquet file.

    If None, uses `key` as the path to the Parquet file.

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```squeeze```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to convert a single-column DataFrame to a Series.

**```keep_partition_cols```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to retain partition columns.

    When None, default partition columns will be removed using [ParquetData.list_partition_cols](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/parquet/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.parquet.ParquetData.list_partition_cols "vectorbtpro.data.custom.parquet.ParquetData.list_partition_cols").

**```engine```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Parquet engine to use.

    See `pd.read_parquet` for details.

**```**read_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.read_parquet`.

    See <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_parquet.html> for arguments.

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/polygon.py)

Module providing the [PolygonData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/polygon/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData") class for fetching data from Polygon's API.

## PolygonData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/polygon.py#L39-L417)

```python
PolygonData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from Polygon's API.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.polygon` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

* <https://github.com/polygon-io/client-python> for the official Polygon Python client.

* [PolygonData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/polygon/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the API key globally:

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.PolygonData.set_custom_settings(
...     client_config=dict(
...         api_key="YOUR_KEY"
...     )
... )
```

Pull stock data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.PolygonData.pull(
...     "AAPL",
...     start="2021-01-01",
...     end="2022-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

Pull crypto data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.PolygonData.pull(
...     "X:BTCUSD",
...     start="2021-01-01",
...     end="2022-01-01",
...     timeframe="1 day"
... )
```

### PolygonData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/polygon.py#L160-L411)

```python
PolygonData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    client=None,
    client_config=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    timeframe=None,
    tz=None,
    adjusted=None,
    limit=None,
    params=None,
    delay=None,
    retries=None,
    show_progress=None,
    pbar_kwargs=None,
    silence_warnings=None
)
```

Overrides [Data.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.fetch_symbol") to fetch data for a given symbol from Polygon.

!!! note
    If you're using a free plan with a rate limit of several requests per minute,
    set `delay` to a higher value (e.g., 12 to allow 5 requests per minute).

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

    Supports the following APIs:

    * Stocks and equities

    * Currencies — symbol must be prefixed with `C:`

    * Crypto — symbol must be prefixed with `X:`

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[PolygonClient]`
:   Polygon API client instance.

    See [PolygonData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/polygon/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData.resolve_client").

**```client_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

    See [PolygonData.resolve_client](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/polygon/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData.resolve_client "vectorbtpro.data.custom.polygon.PolygonData.resolve_client").

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    See [split_freq_str](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.split_freq_str").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```adjusted```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to adjust data for splits.

    Set to False to return unadjusted data.

**```limit```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Limits the number of base aggregates queried.

    Maximum allowed is 50000.

**```params```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Additional query parameters.

**```delay```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Delay in seconds between requests.

**```retries```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of retries on failure to fetch data.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Updated data and a metadata dictionary.

### PolygonData.list_symbols | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/polygon.py#L87-L128)

```python
PolygonData.list_symbols(
    pattern=None,
    use_regex=False,
    sort=True,
    client=None,
    client_config=None,
    **list_tickers_kwargs
)
```

List symbols from Polygon's API.

Retrieves and filters available symbols by matching each against a specified pattern using
[CustomData.key_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/custom/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match").

__Args__

**```pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter symbols.

    Symbols that do not match this pattern are excluded.

**```use_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the pattern is a regular expression.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the symbols in sorted order.

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[PolygonClient]`
:   Polygon API client instance.

**```client_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

**```**list_tickers_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `polygon.RESTClient.list_tickers`.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of symbols.

### PolygonData.resolve_client | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/polygon.py#L130-L158)

```python
PolygonData.resolve_client(
    client=None,
    **client_config
)
```

Resolve the Polygon API client.

If a client is provided, it must be an instance of `polygon.rest.RESTClient`.
Otherwise, a new client is instantiated using the supplied `client_config`.

__Args__

**```client```** :&ensp;`Optional[PolygonClient]`
:   Polygon API client instance.

**```**client_config```**
:   Configuration parameters for creating a new client.

__Returns__

`PolygonClient`
:   Instance of `polygon.rest.RESTClient` for API interactions.

### RandomData.generate_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/random.py#L43-L113)

```python
RandomData.generate_key(
    key,
    index,
    columns=None,
    start_value=None,
    mean=None,
    std=None,
    symmetric=None,
    seed=None,
    jitted=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate a feature or symbol.

__See__

[generate_random_data_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/nb/#vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_random_data_nb "vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_random_data_nb")

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Hashable`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Pandas index.

**```columns```** :&ensp;`Union[Hashable, IndexLike]`
:   Column names.

    Provide a single value to create a Series.

**```start_value```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Value at time 0.

    Not included as the first value in the output.

**```mean```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Mean of the Gaussian distribution for sampling returns.

**```std```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Standard deviation of the Gaussian distribution for sampling returns.

**```symmetric```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, converts negative returns to be symmetric to positive ones,
    reducing their negative impact.

**```seed```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Random seed for deterministic output.

    !!! note
        When using a seed, pass a unique seed per feature or symbol via
        [feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict"), [symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict"),
        or generally [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict").

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Generated data and a metadata dictionary.

### RandomOHLCData.generate_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/random_ohlc.py#L45-L110)

```python
RandomOHLCData.generate_symbol(
    symbol,
    index,
    n_ticks=None,
    start_value=None,
    mean=None,
    std=None,
    symmetric=None,
    seed=None,
    jitted=None,
    template_context=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate data for a symbol.

__See__

* [generate_random_data_1d_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/nb/#vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_random_data_1d_nb "vectorbtpro.data.nb.generate_random_data_1d_nb") for generating random data.

* [ohlc_every_1d_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/ohlcv/nb/#vectorbtpro.ohlcv.nb.ohlc_every_1d_nb "vectorbtpro.ohlcv.nb.ohlc_every_1d_nb") for aggregating ticks into OHLC bars.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Pandas index representing the time stamps.

**```n_ticks```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Number of ticks per bar.

    Flexible argument that can be provided as a template with a context
    containing `symbol` and `index`.

**```start_value```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Initial value at time 0.

    Note that this value does not appear as the first data point.

**```mean```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Drift or average percentage change.

**```std```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Standard deviation of the percentage change.

**```symmetric```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, adjust negative returns to be symmetric with positive ones.

**```seed```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Random seed for deterministic output.

    !!! note
        When using a seed, pass a unique seed per feature or symbol via
        [feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict"), [symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict"),
        or generally [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict").

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`Optional[JittedOption]`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Additional keyword arguments.

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Generated data and a metadata dictionary.

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/sql.py)

Module providing the [SQLData](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData") class for fetching data from SQL databases using SQLAlchemy.

## SQLData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/sql.py#L38-L1282)

```python
SQLData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from a database using SQLAlchemy.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.sql` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

    Global settings can be provided per engine name using the `engines` dictionary.

__See__

* <https://www.sqlalchemy.org/> for the SQLAlchemy API.

* <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_sql_query.html> for the Pandas read method.

* [SQLData.pull](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.pull "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.pull") and [SQLData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.fetch_key") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the engine settings globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.SQLData.set_engine_settings(
...     engine_name="postgresql",
...     populate_=True,
...     engine="postgresql+psycopg2://...",
...     engine_config=dict(),
...     schema="public"
... )
```

Pull tables:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.SQLData.pull(
...     ["TABLE1", "TABLE2"],
...     engine="postgresql",
...     start="2020-01-01",
...     end="2021-01-01"
... )
```

Pull queries:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.SQLData.pull(
...     ["SYMBOL1", "SYMBOL2"],
...     query=vbt.key_dict({
...         "SYMBOL1": "SELECT * FROM TABLE1",
...         "SYMBOL2": "SELECT * FROM TABLE2"
...     }),
...     engine="postgresql"
... )
```

### SQLData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/sql.py#L781-L1195)

```python
SQLData.fetch_key(
    key,
    table=None,
    schema=None,
    query=None,
    engine=None,
    engine_name=None,
    engine_config=None,
    dispose_engine=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    align_dates=None,
    parse_dates=None,
    to_utc=None,
    tz=None,
    start_row=None,
    end_row=None,
    keep_row_number=None,
    row_number_column=None,
    index_col=None,
    columns=None,
    dtype=None,
    chunksize=None,
    chunk_func=None,
    squeeze=None,
    **read_sql_kwargs
)
```

Fetch a feature or symbol from a SQL database.

Fetch data from a SQL database using either a table name or a custom SQL query.

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Key`
:   Feature or symbol identifier.

    If both `table` and `query` are None, the key is used as the table name.
    If the key contains a colon (`:`), it must follow the `SCHEMA:TABLE` format,
    and the `schema` argument is ignored.

**```table```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[str, Table]]`
:   Table name or table object.

    Must not be provided together with `query`.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Database schema.

    Must not be used with `query`.

**```query```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[str, Selectable]]`
:   Custom SQL query.

    Must not be provided together with `table` or `schema`.

**```engine```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, Engine]`
:   Engine instance, URL, or key for engine settings.

    See [SQLData.resolve_engine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine").

**```engine_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the engine.

    See [SQLData.resolve_engine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine").

**```engine_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional configuration for the engine.

    See [SQLData.resolve_engine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine").

**```dispose_engine```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to dispose the engine after use.

    See [SQLData.resolve_engine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/sql/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.resolve_engine").

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[Any]`
:   Start value for filtering.

    If the index is datetime and `align_dates` is True, it is parsed with
    [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

    For a multi-index, provide a tuple. Must not be used with `query`.

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[Any]`
:   End value for filtering.

    If the index is datetime and `align_dates` is True, it is parsed with
    [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

    For a multi-index, provide a tuple. Must not be used with `query`.

**```align_dates```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to align `start` and `end` to the index timezone.

    Retrieves one row (using `LIMIT 1`) and uses [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.prepare_dt") to obtain the index.

**```parse_dates```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[bool, List[IntStr], Dict[IntStr, Any]]]`
:   Configuration for parsing date columns.

    If `query` is not used, it maps to column names; otherwise, integer values are disallowed.

    Enabled parsing also attempts to process datetime columns that Pandas fails to parse.

**```to_utc```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[bool, str, Sequence[str]]]`
:   Parameter for UTC conversion.

    See [Data.prepare_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.Data.prepare_dt "vectorbtpro.data.custom.sql.SQLData.prepare_dt").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```start_row```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Index of the starting row (inclusive).

    The table must contain the column specified by `row_number_column`.

    Must not be used with `query`.

**```end_row```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Index of the ending row (exclusive).

    The table must contain the column specified by `row_number_column`.

    Must not be used with `query`.

**```keep_row_number```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Determines whether to include the row number column
    (specified by `row_number_column`) in the output.

**```row_number_column```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the column containing row numbers.

**```index_col```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[None, bool, MaybeList[IntStr]]]`
:   Column(s) to use as the index.

    If `query` is not used, integers map to column positions; otherwise,
    only column names are allowed.

**```columns```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[IntStr]]`
:   Column(s) to select from the table.

    Must not be used with `query`.

**```dtype```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[None, DTypeLike, Dict[IntStr, DTypeLike]]]`
:   Data type for each column.

    If `query` is not used, integers map to column positions;
    otherwise, only column names are allowed.

**```chunksize```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of rows per chunk for processing.

    See `pd.read_sql_query` for details on this argument.

**```chunk_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to process and concatenate chunks when `chunksize` is set.

**```squeeze```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to convert a single-column DataFrame to a Series.

**```**read_sql_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.read_sql_query`.

    See <https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.read_sql_query.html> for arguments.

__Returns__

`KeyData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### SQLData.list_tables | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/sql.py#L335-L446)

```python
SQLData.list_tables(
    *,
    schema_pattern=None,
    table_pattern=None,
    use_regex=False,
    sort=True,
    schema=None,
    incl_views=True,
    engine=None,
    engine_name=None,
    engine_config=None,
    dispose_engine=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

List all tables and views from the database.

This method retrieves a list of table and view names using SQLAlchemy's inspector. If `schema`
is None, all database schemas are searched and each table is prefixed with its respective
schema name unless only a single default schema ("main") exists. If `schema` is False, the
schema is disregarded. If a specific `schema` is provided, tables within that schema are
returned without a prefix.

Each schema and table is filtered using [CustomData.key_match](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/custom/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match "vectorbtpro.data.custom.custom.CustomData.key_match")
against the provided patterns.

__Args__

**```schema_pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter schema names.

**```table_pattern```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pattern to filter table names.

**```use_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the pattern is a regular expression.

**```sort```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return the list of table names in sorted order.

**```schema```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Specific schema for the search.

    If None, all schemas are considered.

**```incl_views```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to include view names along with table names.

**```engine```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, Engine]`
:   Engine instance, URL, or key for engine settings.

**```engine_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the engine.

**```engine_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional configuration for the engine.

**```dispose_engine```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to dispose the engine after use.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for SQLAlchemy's inspector methods.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of table and view names.

### SQLData.resolve_engine | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/sql.py#L201-L268)

# vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/synthetic.py)

## SyntheticData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/synthetic.py#L26-L260)

```python
SyntheticData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for generating synthetic data.

Provides a framework for generating and updating synthetic data for features and symbols.
Subclasses should implement the `generate_key` method, which is used by other class methods.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.synthetic` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

__See__

* [SyntheticData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/synthetic/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.fetch_key") for argument details.

### SyntheticData.fetch_feature | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/synthetic.py#L205-L218)

```python
SyntheticData.fetch_feature(
    feature,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate synthetic data for a feature.

Calls [SyntheticData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/synthetic/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.fetch_key") with `key_is_feature=True`.

__Args__

**```feature```** :&ensp;`Feature`
:   Feature identifier.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [SyntheticData.fetch_key](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/synthetic/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.fetch_key "vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.fetch_key").

__Returns__

`FeatureData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### SyntheticData.fetch_key | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/synthetic.py#L113-L203)

```python
SyntheticData.fetch_key(
    key,
    key_is_feature=False,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    periods=None,
    timeframe=None,
    tz=None,
    normalize=None,
    inclusive=None,
    randomize=None,
    step=None,
    seed=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate synthetic data for a given key (feature or symbol).

Generates a datetime index using [date_range](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.date_range "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.date_range").

__Args__

**```key```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Identifier of the feature or symbol.

**```key_is_feature```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether the key represents a feature.

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start datetime (e.g., "2024-01-01", "1 year ago").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End datetime (e.g., "2025-01-01", "now").

    See [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```periods```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of periods for the datetime index.

**```timeframe```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Timeframe specification (e.g., "daily", "15 minutes").

    See [to_freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_freq "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_freq").

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

    See [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```normalize```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, normalizes the datetime index.

**```inclusive```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Inclusivity setting for the datetime range.

**```randomize```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, float]`
:   Whether to randomize the index.

    A float between 0 and 1 controls the amount of randomization
    (0 means no change, 1 means full randomization).

**```step```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, TimedeltaLike]`
:   Step for the randomization (e.g., '5m' for 5 minutes).

    Displacements will be multiples of this step. Should be integer if the index is
    numeric and timedelta-like if the index is datetime.

**```seed```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Random seed for deterministic output.

    !!! note
        When using a seed, pass a unique seed per feature or symbol via
        [feature_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.feature_dict"), [symbol_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.symbol_dict"),
        or generally [key_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict "vectorbtpro.data.base.key_dict").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [SyntheticData.generate_feature](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/synthetic/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.generate_feature "vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.generate_feature") or
    [SyntheticData.generate_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/synthetic/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.generate_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.synthetic.SyntheticData.generate_symbol").

__Returns__

`SymbolData`
:   Fetched data and a metadata dictionary.

### SyntheticData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/synthetic.py#L220-L233)

```python
SyntheticData.fetch_symbol(
    symbol,
    **kwargs
)
```

### TVClient.convert_raw_data | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/tv.py#L388-L424)

```python
TVClient.convert_raw_data(
    raw_data,
    symbol
)
```

Convert a raw data string into a Pandas DataFrame containing historical trading data.

__Args__

**```raw_data```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Raw data string returned by TradingView.

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

__Returns__

`Frame`
:   DataFrame with columns ['datetime', 'open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']
    and an added 'symbol' column, indexed by datetime.

### TVClient.get_hist | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/tv.py#L452-L556)

```python
TVClient.get_hist(
    symbol,
    exchange='NSE',
    interval='1D',
    fut_contract=None,
    adjustment='splits',
    extended_session=False,
    pro_data=True,
    limit=20000,
    return_raw=False
)
```

Retrieve historical trading data for a specified symbol.

__Args__

**```symbol```** :&ensp;`Symbol`
:   Symbol identifier.

**```exchange```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Exchange code.

**```interval```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Time interval (e.g., '5m' for 5 minutes).

**```fut_contract```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Futures contract type:

    * None for cash,

    * 1 for the current continuous contract front, or

    * 2 for the following contract.

**```adjustment```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Price adjustment type.

**```extended_session```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, retrieves extended session data.

**```pro_data```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, uses the professional data WebSocket connection.

**```limit```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Maximum number of data points to retrieve.

**```return_raw```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the raw data string instead of a processed DataFrame.

__Returns__

`Union[str, DataFrame]`
:   Raw data string if `return_raw` is True;
    otherwise, a DataFrame containing the historical trading data.

## TVData | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/tv.py#L675-L1170)

```python
TVData(
    wrapper,
    data,
    single_key=True,
    classes=None,
    level_name=None,
    fetch_kwargs=None,
    returned_kwargs=None,
    last_index=None,
    delisted=None,
    tz_localize=None,
    tz_convert=None,
    missing_index=None,
    missing_columns=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Data class for fetching data from TradingView.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `custom.tv` in [data](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.data "vectorbtpro._settings.data").

!!! note
    If you encounter the error "Please confirm that you are not a robot by clicking the captcha box."
    during authentication, use the `auth_token` parameter instead of `username` and `password`.
    To obtain your authentication token, log in to TradingView, open any chart, access your
    browser's developer tools, and search for "auth_token".

__See__

* <https://www.tradingview.com/> for TradingView.

* [TVClient](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/tv/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.tv.TVClient "vectorbtpro.data.custom.tv.TVClient") for the client class used to fetch data.

* [TVData.fetch_symbol](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/custom/tv/#vectorbtpro.data.custom.tv.TVData.fetch_symbol "vectorbtpro.data.custom.tv.TVData.fetch_symbol") for argument details.

__Examples__

Set up the credentials globally (optional):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> vbt.TVData.set_custom_settings(
...     client_config=dict(
...         username="YOUR_USERNAME",
...         password="YOUR_PASSWORD",
...         auth_token="YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN",  # optional, used in place of username and password
...     )
... )
```

Pull data:

```pycon
>>> data = vbt.TVData.pull(
...     "NASDAQ:AAPL",
...     timeframe="1 hour"
... )
```

### TVData.fetch_symbol | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/data/custom/tv.py#L1026-L1165)

```python
TVData.fetch_symbol(
```
