### MA.run_combs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ma.py#L1-L206)

```python
MA.run_combs(
    close,
    window=Default(value=14),
    wtype=Default(value='simple'),
    r=2,
    param_product=False,
    comb_func=itertools.combinations,
    run_unique=True,
    short_names=None,
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Create multiple [MA](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ma/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ma.MA "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ma.MA") indicator instances based on parameter combinations.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `window`: Window size.

* `wtype`: Weighting type (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

__Outputs__

* `ma`: Moving Average (MA) series.

`comb_func` must accept an iterable of parameter tuples along with `r`. 
It also supports combinatoric iterators from `itertools`, like `itertools.combinations`.

!!! note
    Use this method only when multiple indicator instances are required.
    To test multiple parameters, pass them as lists to [MA.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ma/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ma.MA.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ma.MA.run").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for pipeline configuration and combination settings, including:

    * `r`: Number of indicators to run.

    * `param_product`: Flag controlling parameter combination behavior.

    * `comb_func`: Function to combine parameter tuples (e.g., `itertools.combinations`).

    * `run_unique`: If True, computes raw outputs before constructing indicators.

    * `short_names`: Custom short names for each indicator.

    * `hide_params`: Parameter names to hide column levels.

    * `hide_default`: Whether to hide parameters with default values.

    Other keyword arguments are passed to [MA.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ma/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ma.MA.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ma.MA.run").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Indicator, ...]`
:   Tuple of indicator instances generated.

# vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/macd.py)

## MACD | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/macd.py#L29-L101)

Class representing the Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) indicator.

This trend-following momentum indicator illustrates the relationship between
two moving averages of price data.

__See__

* [MACD.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run") for the main entry point.

* [macd_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.macd_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.macd_nb") for the underlying implementation.

* [macd_hist_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.macd_hist_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.macd_hist_nb") for the underlying implementation of [MACD.hist](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.hist "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.hist").

* <https://www.investopedia.com/terms/m/macd.asp> the definition of MACD.

### MACD.apply_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/macd.py#L1097-L1216)

```python
MACD.apply_func(
    close,
    fast_window=12,
    slow_window=26,
    signal_window=9,
    wtype=2,
    macd_wtype=None,
    signal_wtype=None,
    minp=None,
    macd_minp=None,
    signal_minp=None,
    adjust=False,
    macd_adjust=None,
    signal_adjust=None
)
```

Calculate 2-D MACD and signal lines for multiple price series.

Compute the fast and slow moving averages along each column, derive the MACD as their difference,
and calculate the signal line as the moving average of the MACD for each column.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2-D array of close prices.

**```fast_window```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Window size for computing the fast moving average.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```slow_window```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Window size for computing the slow moving average.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```signal_window```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Window size for computing the signal moving average.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```wtype```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Weighting type.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    See [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType").

**```macd_wtype```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   Weighting type for MACD computation.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    See [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType"). Uses `wtype` if not provided.

**```signal_wtype```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   Weighting type for signal computation.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    See [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType"). Uses `wtype` if not provided.

**```minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of observations required.

**```macd_minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum period for the MACD moving average.

    Uses `minp` if not provided.

**```signal_minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum period for the signal moving average.

    Uses `minp` if not provided.

**```adjust```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to adjust weights.

**```macd_adjust```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Alternative flag for MACD moving average adjustment.

    Uses `adjust` if not provided.

**```signal_adjust```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Alternative flag for signal moving average adjustment.

    Uses `adjust` if not provided.

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array2d, Array2d]`
:   Tuple where the first element contains MACD values and
    the second contains the signal line.

### MACD.custom_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/macd.py#L3177-L3526)

```python
MACD.custom_func(
    input_tuple,
    in_output_tuple,
    param_tuple,
    *args_,
    input_shape=None,
    per_column=False,
    split_columns=False,
    skipna=False,
    return_cache=False,
    use_cache=True,
    jitted_loop=False,
    jitted_warmup=False,
    param_index=None,
    final_index=None,
    single_comb=False,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs_
)
```

Forward inputs and parameters to [MACD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func"), performing caching and pre-processing.

Caching is performed using `cache_func` if provided, and the results are passed to
[MACD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func"). If [MACD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func") is a Numba-compiled function, the actual apply-function becomes
[MACD.param_select_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.param_select_func_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.param_select_func_nb"), which handles the selection of parameters and the passing of arguments.

__Args__

**```input_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[AnyArray, ...]`
:   Tuple of input arrays.

**```in_output_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[AnyArray], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of in-place output arrays.

**```param_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[ParamValue], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of parameter values.

**```*args_```**
:   Additional positional arguments.

**```input_shape```** :&ensp;`Optional[Shape]`
:   Shape of the input arrays.

**```per_column```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, processes parameters separately for each column.

**```split_columns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to split arrays into separate columns.

**```skipna```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to skip NaN values.

**```return_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return the cache result instead of processing further.

**```use_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, IFCacheOutput]`
:   Flag or configuration indicating whether to use caching.

**```jitted_loop```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to use a JIT-compiled loop.

**```jitted_warmup```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, perform a warm-up call for the JIT-compiled function.

**```param_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Index for parameter combinations.

**```final_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Final index used for the output.

**```single_comb```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether there is only one parameter combination.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```**kwargs_```**
:   Additional keyword arguments.

__Returns__

`Union[None, IFCacheOutput, Array2d, List[Array2d]]`
:       Result of applying [MACD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.apply_func"), which may be:

    * Cache output if `return_cache` is True.

    * 2D array.

    * List of 2D arrays.

    * None.

### MACD.run | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/macd.py#L1-L206)

```python
MACD.run(
    close,
    fast_window=Default(value=12),
    slow_window=Default(value=26),
    signal_window=Default(value=9),
    wtype=Default(value='exp'),
    macd_wtype=Default(value=None),
    signal_wtype=Default(value=None),
    short_name='macd',
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run [MACD](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD") indicator.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `fast_window`: Fast window size.

* `slow_window`: Slow window size.

* `signal_window`: Signal window size.

* `wtype`: Weighting type (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

* `macd_wtype`: Weighting type for MACD (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

* `signal_wtype`: Weighting type for signal (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

__Outputs__

* `macd`: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) series.

* `signal`: Signal series.

__Lazy outputs__

* `hist`: Histogram series.

Pass a list of parameter names as `hide_params` to hide their column levels, or `True` to hide all.
Set `hide_default` to False to display column levels for parameters with default values.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [IndicatorBase.run_pipeline](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.run_pipeline "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run_pipeline").

__Returns__

`Indicator`
:   Instance of the [MACD](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD") indicator, or a tuple of additional objects if applicable.

### MACD.run_combs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/macd.py#L1-L206)

```python
MACD.run_combs(
    close,
    fast_window=Default(value=12),
    slow_window=Default(value=26),
    signal_window=Default(value=9),
    wtype=Default(value='exp'),
    macd_wtype=Default(value=None),
    signal_wtype=Default(value=None),
    r=2,
    param_product=False,
    comb_func=itertools.combinations,
    run_unique=True,
    short_names=None,
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Create multiple [MACD](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD") indicator instances based on parameter combinations.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `fast_window`: Fast window size.

* `slow_window`: Slow window size.

* `signal_window`: Signal window size.

* `wtype`: Weighting type (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

* `macd_wtype`: Weighting type for MACD (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

* `signal_wtype`: Weighting type for signal (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

__Outputs__

* `macd`: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) series.

* `signal`: Signal series.

__Lazy outputs__

* `hist`: Histogram series.

`comb_func` must accept an iterable of parameter tuples along with `r`. 
It also supports combinatoric iterators from `itertools`, like `itertools.combinations`.

!!! note
    Use this method only when multiple indicator instances are required.
    To test multiple parameters, pass them as lists to [MACD.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for pipeline configuration and combination settings, including:

    * `r`: Number of indicators to run.

    * `param_product`: Flag controlling parameter combination behavior.

    * `comb_func`: Function to combine parameter tuples (e.g., `itertools.combinations`).

    * `run_unique`: If True, computes raw outputs before constructing indicators.

    * `short_names`: Custom short names for each indicator.

    * `hide_params`: Parameter names to hide column levels.

    * `hide_default`: Whether to hide parameters with default values.

    Other keyword arguments are passed to [MACD.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/macd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.macd.MACD.run").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Indicator, ...]`
:   Tuple of indicator instances generated.

## MSD | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/msd.py#L25-L58)

Class representing the Moving Standard Deviation (MSD) indicator.

This class represents the moving standard deviation (MSD) indicator that measures
the magnitude of recent price movements to assess asset volatility.

__See__

* [MSD.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run") for the main entry point.

* [msd_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.msd_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.msd_nb") for the underlying implementation.

* <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_deviation> for the definition of standard deviation.

### MSD.apply_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/msd.py#L152-L210)

```python
MSD.apply_func(
    close,
    window=14,
    wtype=0,
    minp=None,
    adjust=False,
    ddof=0
)
```

2-dim version of `msd_1d_nb`.

Computes the moving standard deviation for each column of a 2-dimensional array.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2D array where each column represents a data series.

**```window```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Window size.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```wtype```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Weighting type.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    See [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType").

**```minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of observations required.

**```adjust```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to adjust weights.

**```ddof```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Delta degrees of freedom.

__Returns__

`Array2d`
:   2D array of moving standard deviation values.

```python
MSD.custom_func(
    input_tuple,
```

Forward inputs and parameters to [MSD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.apply_func"), performing caching and pre-processing.

Caching is performed using `cache_func` if provided, and the results are passed to
[MSD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.apply_func"). If [MSD.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.apply_func") is a Numba-compiled function, the actual apply-function becomes
[MSD.param_select_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.param_select_func_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.param_select_func_nb"), which handles the selection of parameters and the passing of arguments.

:   Tuple of input arrays.

**```param_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[ParamValue], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of parameter values.

**```*args_```**
:   Additional positional arguments.

:   Shape of the input arrays.

:   If True, processes parameters separately for each column.

:   Whether to split arrays into separate columns.

**```skipna```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to skip NaN values.

**```return_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return the cache result instead of processing further.

**```use_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, IFCacheOutput]`
:   Flag or configuration indicating whether to use caching.

**```jitted_loop```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to use a JIT-compiled loop.

:   Index for parameter combinations.

### MSD.run | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/msd.py#L1-L206)

```python
MSD.run(
    close,
    window=Default(value=14),
    wtype=Default(value='simple'),
    short_name='msd',
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run [MSD](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD") indicator.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `window`: Window size.

* `wtype`: Weighting type (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

__Outputs__

* `msd`: Moving Standard Deviation (MSD) series.

Pass a list of parameter names as `hide_params` to hide their column levels, or `True` to hide all.
Set `hide_default` to False to display column levels for parameters with default values.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [IndicatorBase.run_pipeline](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.run_pipeline "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run_pipeline").

__Returns__

`Indicator`
:   Instance of the [MSD](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD") indicator, or a tuple of additional objects if applicable.

### MSD.run_combs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/msd.py#L1-L206)

```python
MSD.run_combs(
    close,
    window=Default(value=14),
    wtype=Default(value='simple'),
    r=2,
    param_product=False,
    comb_func=itertools.combinations,
    run_unique=True,
    short_names=None,
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Create multiple [MSD](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD") indicator instances based on parameter combinations.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `window`: Window size.

* `wtype`: Weighting type (see [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType")).

__Outputs__

* `msd`: Moving Standard Deviation (MSD) series.

`comb_func` must accept an iterable of parameter tuples along with `r`. 
It also supports combinatoric iterators from `itertools`, like `itertools.combinations`.

!!! note
    Use this method only when multiple indicator instances are required.
    To test multiple parameters, pass them as lists to [MSD.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for pipeline configuration and combination settings, including:

    * `r`: Number of indicators to run.

    * `param_product`: Flag controlling parameter combination behavior.

    * `comb_func`: Function to combine parameter tuples (e.g., `itertools.combinations`).

    * `run_unique`: If True, computes raw outputs before constructing indicators.

    * `short_names`: Custom short names for each indicator.

    * `hide_params`: Parameter names to hide column levels.

    * `hide_default`: Whether to hide parameters with default values.

    Other keyword arguments are passed to [MSD.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/msd/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.msd.MSD.run").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Indicator, ...]`
:   Tuple of indicator instances generated.

# vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/obv.py)

Module defining the [OBV](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/obv/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV") class for calculating the on-balance volume indicator.

## OBV | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/obv.py#L24-L42)

```python
OBV(
    wrapper,
    input_list,
    input_mapper,
    in_output_list,
    output_list,
    param_list,
    mapper_list,
    short_name,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class representing the on-balance volume (OBV) indicator.

Calculates OBV by accumulating total volume based on price movements,
thereby relating price and volume in the stock market.

See [On-Balance Volume (OBV)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/o/onbalancevolume.asp).

__See__

* [OBV.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/obv/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV.run") for the main entry point.

* [obv_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.obv_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.obv_nb") for the underlying implementation.

* <https://www.investopedia.com/terms/o/onbalancevolume.asp> for the definition of OBV.

__Superclasses__

### OBV.custom_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/obv.py#L1604-L1631)

```python
OBV.custom_func(
    close,
    volume
)
```

2-dim version of `obv_1d_nb`.

Calculates the on-balance volume (OBV) for 2-dimensional input arrays column-wise.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2-dimensional array of close prices.

**```volume```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2-dimensional array of trading volumes.

__Returns__

`Array2d`
:   Computed on-balance volume for each column.

### OBV.plot | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/obv.py#L59-L121)

```python
_OBV.plot(
    column=None,
    obv_trace_kwargs=None,
    add_trace_kwargs=None,
    fig=None,
    make_figure_kwargs=None,
    **layout_kwargs
)
```

Plot [OBV.obv](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/obv/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV.obv "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV.obv").

!!! info
    For default settings, see [plotting](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.plotting "vectorbtpro._settings.plotting").

__Args__

**```column```** :&ensp;`Optional[Column]`
:   Identifier of the column to plot.

**```obv_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `plotly.graph_objects.Scatter` for [OBV.obv](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/obv/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV.obv "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV.obv").

**```add_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.add_trace` for each trace;
    for example, `dict(row=1, col=1)`.

**```fig```** :&ensp;`Optional[BaseFigure]`
:   Figure to update; if None, a new figure is created.

**```make_figure_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for making the figure.

    See [make_figure](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/figure/#vectorbtpro.utils.figure.make_figure "vectorbtpro.utils.figure.make_figure").

**```**layout_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.update_layout`.

__Returns__

`BaseFigure`
:   Updated figure displaying the plotted OBV data.

__Examples__

```pycon
>>> vbt.OBV.run(ohlcv['Close'], ohlcv['Volume']).plot().show()
```

### OBV.run | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/obv.py#L1-L206)

```python
OBV.run(
    close,
    volume,
    short_name='obv',
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run [OBV](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/obv/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.obv.OBV") indicator.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

* `volume`: Volume series.

__Outputs__

* `obv`: On-Balance Volume (OBV) series.

Pass a list of parameter names as `hide_params` to hide their column levels, or `True` to hide all.
Set `hide_default` to False to display column levels for parameters with default values.

:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

# vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py)

Module defining the [OLS](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS") class for rolling Ordinary Least Squares regression analysis.

## OLS | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L27-L96)

```python
OLS(
    wrapper,
    input_list,
    input_mapper,
    in_output_list,
    output_list,
    param_list,
    mapper_list,
    short_name,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class representing the Rolling Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) indicator.

The [OLS](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS") indicator is used to detect changes in the relationship between stocks and
the market or between different stocks by computing rolling linear regressions.

__See__

* [OLS.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run") for the main entry point.

* [ols_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_nb") for the underlying implementation.

* [ols_pred_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_pred_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_pred_nb") for the underlying implementation of
    the [OLS.pred](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.pred "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.pred") property.

* [ols_error_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_error_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_error_nb") for the underlying implementation of
    the [OLS.error](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.error "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.error") property.

* [ols_angle_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_angle_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.ols_angle_nb") for the underlying implementation of
    the [OLS.angle](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.angle "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.angle") property.

* <https://www.investopedia.com/articles/trading/09/linear-regression-time-price.asp>
    for the definition of OLS.

### OLS.apply_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L1679-L1746)

```python
OLS.apply_func(
    x,
    y,
    window=14,
    norm_window=None,
    minp=None,
    ddof=0,
    with_zscore=True
)
```

Compute rolling ordinary least squares (OLS) regression for 2-dimensional arrays.

This function applies a 1-dimensional OLS regression on each column.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```x```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2-dimensional array of independent variable values.

**```y```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2-dimensional array of dependent variable values.

**```window```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Window size.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```norm_window```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   Window size for error normalization.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    Defaults to `window` if None.

**```minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of observations required.

**```ddof```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Delta degrees of freedom.

**```with_zscore```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to compute and return the z-score of regression errors.

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array2d, Array2d, Array2d]`
:   Arrays of slopes, intercepts, and z-scores for each column.

### OLS.custom_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L3177-L3526)

```python
OLS.custom_func(
    input_tuple,
    in_output_tuple,
    param_tuple,
    *args_,
    input_shape=None,
    per_column=False,
    split_columns=False,
    skipna=False,
    return_cache=False,
    use_cache=True,
    jitted_loop=False,
    jitted_warmup=False,
    param_index=None,
    final_index=None,
    single_comb=False,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs_
)
```

Forward inputs and parameters to [OLS.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func"), performing caching and pre-processing.

Caching is performed using `cache_func` if provided, and the results are passed to
[OLS.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func"). If [OLS.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func") is a Numba-compiled function, the actual apply-function becomes
[OLS.param_select_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.param_select_func_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.param_select_func_nb"), which handles the selection of parameters and the passing of arguments.

__Args__

**```input_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[AnyArray, ...]`
:   Tuple of input arrays.

**```in_output_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[AnyArray], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of in-place output arrays.

**```param_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[ParamValue], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of parameter values.

**```*args_```**
:   Additional positional arguments.

**```input_shape```** :&ensp;`Optional[Shape]`
:   Shape of the input arrays.

**```per_column```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, processes parameters separately for each column.

**```split_columns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to split arrays into separate columns.

**```skipna```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to skip NaN values.

**```return_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return the cache result instead of processing further.

**```use_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, IFCacheOutput]`
:   Flag or configuration indicating whether to use caching.

**```jitted_loop```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to use a JIT-compiled loop.

**```jitted_warmup```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, perform a warm-up call for the JIT-compiled function.

**```param_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Index for parameter combinations.

**```final_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Final index used for the output.

**```single_comb```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether there is only one parameter combination.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```**kwargs_```**
:   Additional keyword arguments.

__Returns__

`Union[None, IFCacheOutput, Array2d, List[Array2d]]`
:       Result of applying [OLS.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.apply_func"), which may be:

    * Cache output if `return_cache` is True.

    * 2D array.

    * List of 2D arrays.

    * None.

### OLS.plot | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L118-L196)

```python
_OLS.plot(
    column=None,
    plot_y=True,
    y_trace_kwargs=None,
    pred_trace_kwargs=None,
    add_trace_kwargs=None,
    fig=None,
    make_figure_kwargs=None,
    **layout_kwargs
)
```

Plot the [OLS.pred](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.pred "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.pred") and (optionally) [OLS.y](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.y "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.y") values.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [plotting](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.plotting "vectorbtpro._settings.plotting").

__Args__

**```column```** :&ensp;`Optional[Column]`
:   Identifier of the column to plot.

**```plot_y```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to plot [OLS.y](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.y "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.y").

**```y_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `plotly.graph_objects.Scatter` for [OLS.y](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.y "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.y").

**```pred_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `plotly.graph_objects.Scatter` for [OLS.pred](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.pred "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.pred").

**```add_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.add_trace` for each trace;
    for example, `dict(row=1, col=1)`.

**```fig```** :&ensp;`Optional[BaseFigure]`
:   Figure to update; if None, a new figure is created.

**```make_figure_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for making the figure.

    See [make_figure](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/figure/#vectorbtpro.utils.figure.make_figure "vectorbtpro.utils.figure.make_figure").

**```**layout_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.update_layout`.

__Returns__

`BaseFigure`
:   Figure with plotted OLS predictions and actual values.

__Examples__

```pycon
>>> vbt.OLS.run(np.arange(len(ohlcv)), ohlcv['Close']).plot().show()
```

### OLS.plot_zscore | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L198-L286)

```python
_OLS.plot_zscore(
    column=None,
    alpha=0.05,
    zscore_trace_kwargs=None,
    add_shape_kwargs=None,
    add_trace_kwargs=None,
    fig=None,
    make_figure_kwargs=None,
    **layout_kwargs
)
```

Plot the [OLS.zscore](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.zscore "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.zscore") values with confidence intervals.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [plotting](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.plotting "vectorbtpro._settings.plotting").

__Args__

**```column```** :&ensp;`Optional[Column]`
:   Identifier of the column to plot.

**```alpha```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Alpha level for the confidence interval.

    The default alpha value of 0.05 returns a 95% confidence interval.

**```zscore_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `plotly.graph_objects.Scatter` for [OLS.zscore](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.zscore "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.zscore").

**```add_shape_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.add_shape` for each shape.

**```add_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.add_trace` for each trace;
    for example, `dict(row=1, col=1)`.

**```fig```** :&ensp;`Optional[BaseFigure]`
:   Figure to update; if None, a new figure is created.

**```make_figure_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for making the figure.

    See [make_figure](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/figure/#vectorbtpro.utils.figure.make_figure "vectorbtpro.utils.figure.make_figure").

**```**layout_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.update_layout`.

__Returns__

`BaseFigure`
:   Figure with plotted OLS z-score and confidence intervals.

__Examples__

```pycon
>>> vbt.OLS.run(np.arange(len(ohlcv)), ohlcv['Close']).plot_zscore().show()
```

### OLS.run | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L1-L206)

```python
OLS.run(
    x,
    y,
    window=Default(value=14),
    norm_window=Default(value=None),
    short_name='ols',
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run [OLS](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS") indicator.

__Inputs__

* `x`: Independent variable series.

* `y`: Dependent variable series.

__Parameters__

* `window`: Window size.

* `norm_window`: Normalization window size.

__Outputs__

* `slope`: Slope of the regression line.

* `intercept`: Intercept of the regression line.

* `zscore`: Z-score of the regression line.

__Lazy outputs__

* `pred`: Predicted values based on the regression line.

* `error`: Error between the actual and predicted values.

* `angle`: Angle of the regression line in radians.

Pass a list of parameter names as `hide_params` to hide their column levels, or `True` to hide all.
Set `hide_default` to False to display column levels for parameters with default values.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [IndicatorBase.run_pipeline](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.run_pipeline "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run_pipeline").

__Returns__

`Indicator`
:   Instance of the [OLS](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS") indicator, or a tuple of additional objects if applicable.

### OLS.run_combs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/ols.py#L1-L206)

```python
OLS.run_combs(
    x,
    y,
    window=Default(value=14),
    norm_window=Default(value=None),
    r=2,
    param_product=False,
    comb_func=itertools.combinations,
    run_unique=True,
    short_names=None,
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Create multiple [OLS](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS") indicator instances based on parameter combinations.

__Inputs__

* `x`: Independent variable series.

* `y`: Dependent variable series.

__Parameters__

* `window`: Window size.

* `norm_window`: Normalization window size.

__Outputs__

* `slope`: Slope of the regression line.

* `intercept`: Intercept of the regression line.

* `zscore`: Z-score of the regression line.

__Lazy outputs__

* `pred`: Predicted values based on the regression line.

* `error`: Error between the actual and predicted values.

* `angle`: Angle of the regression line in radians.

`comb_func` must accept an iterable of parameter tuples along with `r`. 
It also supports combinatoric iterators from `itertools`, like `itertools.combinations`.

!!! note
    Use this method only when multiple indicator instances are required.
    To test multiple parameters, pass them as lists to [OLS.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for pipeline configuration and combination settings, including:

    * `r`: Number of indicators to run.

    * `param_product`: Flag controlling parameter combination behavior.

    * `comb_func`: Function to combine parameter tuples (e.g., `itertools.combinations`).

    * `run_unique`: If True, computes raw outputs before constructing indicators.

    * `short_names`: Custom short names for each indicator.

    * `hide_params`: Parameter names to hide column levels.

    * `hide_default`: Whether to hide parameters with default values.

    Other keyword arguments are passed to [OLS.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/ols/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.ols.OLS.run").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Indicator, ...]`
:   Tuple of indicator instances generated.

### PATSIM.apply_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/patsim.py#L2598-L2772)

```python
PATSIM.apply_func(
    arr,
    pattern,
    window=None,
    max_window=None,
    row_select_prob=1.0,
    window_select_prob=1.0,
    interp_mode=3,
    rescale_mode=0,
    vmin=nan,
    vmax=nan,
    pmin=nan,
    pmax=nan,
    invert=False,
    error_type=0,
    distance_measure=0,
    max_error=nan,
    max_error_interp_mode=None,
    max_error_as_maxdist=False,
    max_error_strict=False,
    min_pct_change=nan,
    max_pct_change=nan,
    min_similarity=0.85,
    minp=None
)
```

Compute rolling pattern similarity on a 2D array column-wise.

Each column of the input array is processed using `rolling_pattern_similarity_1d_nb`.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```arr```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2D input array where similarity is computed for each column.

**```pattern```** :&ensp;`Array1d`
:   1D array representing the pattern to locate.

    Can be smaller or larger than the source array. In such cases,
    the smaller array is stretched using the interpolation mode specified by `interp_mode`.

**```window```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Window size.

    If None, defaults to the length of `pattern`.

**```max_window```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum length of the rolling window for matching.

    If None, defaults to `window`.

**```row_select_prob```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Probability of selecting a row.

**```window_select_prob```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Probability of selecting a window size.

**```interp_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Interpolation mode.

    See [InterpMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode").

**```rescale_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Rescaling mode for adjusting the ranges of `arr` and `pattern`.

    See [RescaleMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.RescaleMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.RescaleMode").

**```vmin```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum value used for rescaling `arr`.

    Use only when the array has fixed bounds. Used in rescaling with `RescaleMode.MinMax`
    and for verifying `min_pct_change` and `max_pct_change`.

    If set to NaN, it is calculated dynamically.

**```vmax```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Maximum value used for rescaling `arr`.

    Use only when the array has fixed bounds. Used in rescaling with `RescaleMode.MinMax`
    and for verifying `min_pct_change` and `max_pct_change`.

    If set to NaN, it is calculated dynamically.

**```pmin```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum value used for rescaling `pattern`.

    Used in rescaling with `RescaleMode.MinMax` and for computing the maximum distance
    at each point when `max_error_as_maxdist` is disabled.

    If set to NaN, it is calculated dynamically.

**```pmax```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Maximum value used for rescaling `pattern`.

    Used in rescaling with `RescaleMode.MinMax` and for computing the maximum distance
    at each point when `max_error_as_maxdist` is disabled.

    If set to NaN, it is calculated dynamically.

**```invert```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Invert the pattern by reflecting its values.

**```error_type```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Error computation mode.

    See [ErrorType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.ErrorType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.ErrorType").

**```distance_measure```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Method for measuring distance (e.g., MAE, MSE, RMSE).

    See [DistanceMeasure](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.DistanceMeasure "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.DistanceMeasure").

**```max_error```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Maximum error threshold for normalization.

    Provided as a scalar or per element in the pattern.

**```max_error_interp_mode```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Interpolation mode for `max_error`.

    If None, defaults to `interp_mode`.

    See [InterpMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode").

**```max_error_as_maxdist```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates whether `max_error` represents the maximum distance at each point.

    If False, exceeding `max_error` sets the distance to the maximum derived from
    `pmin`, `pmax`, and the pattern value at that point. If True and any point
    in a window is NaN, that point is skipped.

**```max_error_strict```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, any instance of exceeding `max_error` results in a similarity of NaN.

**```min_pct_change```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum percentage change required for a window to remain a search candidate.

    Window similarity is set to NaN if this threshold is not met.

**```max_pct_change```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Maximum percentage change allowed for a window to remain a search candidate.

    Window similarity is set to NaN if this threshold is exceeded.

**```min_similarity```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum similarity threshold.

    If the computed similarity falls below this, returns NaN.

**```minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of observations required.

__Returns__

`Array2d`
:   2D array where each column contains the computed similarity values.

### PATSIM.custom_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/patsim.py#L3177-L3526)

```python
PATSIM.custom_func(
    input_tuple,
    in_output_tuple,
    param_tuple,
    *args_,
    input_shape=None,
    per_column=False,
    split_columns=False,
    skipna=False,
    return_cache=False,
    use_cache=True,
    jitted_loop=False,
    jitted_warmup=False,
    param_index=None,
    final_index=None,
    single_comb=False,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs_
)
```

Forward inputs and parameters to [PATSIM.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func"), performing caching and pre-processing.

Caching is performed using `cache_func` if provided, and the results are passed to
[PATSIM.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func"). If [PATSIM.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func") is a Numba-compiled function, the actual apply-function becomes
[PATSIM.param_select_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.param_select_func_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.param_select_func_nb"), which handles the selection of parameters and the passing of arguments.

__Args__

**```input_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[AnyArray, ...]`
:   Tuple of input arrays.

**```in_output_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[AnyArray], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of in-place output arrays.

**```param_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[ParamValue], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of parameter values.

**```*args_```**
:   Additional positional arguments.

**```input_shape```** :&ensp;`Optional[Shape]`
:   Shape of the input arrays.

**```per_column```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, processes parameters separately for each column.

**```split_columns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to split arrays into separate columns.

**```skipna```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to skip NaN values.

**```return_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return the cache result instead of processing further.

**```use_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, IFCacheOutput]`
:   Flag or configuration indicating whether to use caching.

**```jitted_loop```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to use a JIT-compiled loop.

**```jitted_warmup```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, perform a warm-up call for the JIT-compiled function.

**```param_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Index for parameter combinations.

**```final_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Final index used for the output.

**```single_comb```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether there is only one parameter combination.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```**kwargs_```**
:   Additional keyword arguments.

__Returns__

`Union[None, IFCacheOutput, Array2d, List[Array2d]]`
:       Result of applying [PATSIM.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.apply_func"), which may be:

    * Cache output if `return_cache` is True.

    * 2D array.

    * List of 2D arrays.

    * None.

### PATSIM.overlay_with_heatmap | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/patsim.py#L235-L304)

```python
_PATSIM.overlay_with_heatmap(
    column=None,
    close_trace_kwargs=None,

    **layout_kwargs
```

Overlay [PATSIM.similarity](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.similarity "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.similarity") as a heatmap on top of [PATSIM.close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.close "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.close").

!!! info
    For default settings, see [plotting](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.plotting "vectorbtpro._settings.plotting").

__Args__

**```column```** :&ensp;`Optional[Column]`
:   Identifier of the column to plot.

**```close_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `plotly.graph_objects.Scatter` for [PATSIM.close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.close "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.close").

**```similarity_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `plotly.graph_objects.Heatmap` for [PATSIM.similarity](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.similarity "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.similarity").

**```add_trace_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `fig.add_trace` for each trace;
    for example, `dict(row=1, col=1)`.

### PATSIM.run | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/patsim.py#L1-L206)

```python
PATSIM.run(
    close,
    pattern,
    window=Default(value=None),
    max_window=Default(value=None),
    row_select_prob=Default(value=1.0),
    window_select_prob=Default(value=1.0),
    interp_mode=Default(value='mixed'),
    rescale_mode=Default(value='minmax'),
    vmin=Default(value=nan),
    vmax=Default(value=nan),
    pmin=Default(value=nan),
    pmax=Default(value=nan),
    invert=Default(value=False),
    error_type=Default(value='absolute'),
    distance_measure=Default(value='mae'),
    max_error=Default(value=nan),
    max_error_interp_mode=Default(value=None),
    max_error_as_maxdist=Default(value=False),
    max_error_strict=Default(value=False),
    min_pct_change=Default(value=nan),
    max_pct_change=Default(value=nan),
    min_similarity=Default(value=nan),
    short_name='patsim',
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run [PATSIM](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM") indicator.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `pattern`: Pattern to compare against.

* `window`: Window size.

* `max_window`: Maximum window size.

* `row_select_prob`: Probability of selecting a row in the close series.

* `window_select_prob`: Probability of selecting a window in the close series.

* `interp_mode`: Interpolation mode (see [InterpMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode")).

* `rescale_mode`: Rescale mode (see [RescaleMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.RescaleMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.RescaleMode")).

* `vmin`: Minimum value for rescaling the window.

* `vmax`: Maximum value for rescaling the window.

* `pmin`: Minimum value for rescaling the pattern.

* `pmax`: Maximum value for rescaling the pattern.

* `invert`: Whether to invert the pattern.

* `error_type`: Error type (see [ErrorType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.ErrorType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.ErrorType")).

* `distance_measure`: Distance measure (see [DistanceMeasure](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.DistanceMeasure "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.DistanceMeasure")).

* `max_error`: Maximum error threshold.

* `max_error_interp_mode`: Interpolation mode for the maximum error (see [InterpMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode")).

* `max_error_as_maxdist`: Whether to use maximum error as maximum distance.

* `max_error_strict`: Whether exceeding the maximum error is considered a failure.

* `min_pct_change`: Minimum percentage change threshold.

* `max_pct_change`: Maximum percentage change threshold.

* `min_similarity`: Minimum similarity threshold.

__Outputs__

* `similarity`: Rolling pattern similarity series.

Pass a list of parameter names as `hide_params` to hide their column levels, or `True` to hide all.
Set `hide_default` to False to display column levels for parameters with default values.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [IndicatorBase.run_pipeline](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.run_pipeline "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.run_pipeline").

__Returns__

`Indicator`
:   Instance of the [PATSIM](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM") indicator, or a tuple of additional objects if applicable.

```python
PATSIM.run_combs(
```

Create multiple [PATSIM](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM") indicator instances based on parameter combinations.

__Inputs__

* `close`: Close price series.

__Parameters__

* `pattern`: Pattern to compare against.

* `window`: Window size.

* `max_window`: Maximum window size.

* `row_select_prob`: Probability of selecting a row in the close series.

* `window_select_prob`: Probability of selecting a window in the close series.

* `interp_mode`: Interpolation mode (see [InterpMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode")).

* `rescale_mode`: Rescale mode (see [RescaleMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.RescaleMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.RescaleMode")).

* `vmin`: Minimum value for rescaling the window.

* `vmax`: Maximum value for rescaling the window.

* `pmin`: Minimum value for rescaling the pattern.

* `pmax`: Maximum value for rescaling the pattern.

* `invert`: Whether to invert the pattern.

* `error_type`: Error type (see [ErrorType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.ErrorType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.ErrorType")).

* `distance_measure`: Distance measure (see [DistanceMeasure](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.DistanceMeasure "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.DistanceMeasure")).

* `max_error`: Maximum error threshold.

* `max_error_interp_mode`: Interpolation mode for the maximum error (see [InterpMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.InterpMode")).

* `max_error_as_maxdist`: Whether to use maximum error as maximum distance.

* `max_error_strict`: Whether exceeding the maximum error is considered a failure.

* `min_pct_change`: Minimum percentage change threshold.

* `max_pct_change`: Maximum percentage change threshold.

* `min_similarity`: Minimum similarity threshold.

__Outputs__

* `similarity`: Rolling pattern similarity series.

`comb_func` must accept an iterable of parameter tuples along with `r`. 
It also supports combinatoric iterators from `itertools`, like `itertools.combinations`.

!!! note
    Use this method only when multiple indicator instances are required.
    To test multiple parameters, pass them as lists to [PATSIM.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.run").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for pipeline configuration and combination settings, including:

    * `r`: Number of indicators to run.

    * `param_product`: Flag controlling parameter combination behavior.

    * `comb_func`: Function to combine parameter tuples (e.g., `itertools.combinations`).

    * `run_unique`: If True, computes raw outputs before constructing indicators.

    * `short_names`: Custom short names for each indicator.

    * `hide_params`: Parameter names to hide column levels.

    * `hide_default`: Whether to hide parameters with default values.

    Other keyword arguments are passed to [PATSIM.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/patsim/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.patsim.PATSIM.run").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Indicator, ...]`
:   Tuple of indicator instances generated.

## PIVOTINFO | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/pivotinfo.py#L29-L122)

### PIVOTINFO.apply_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/pivotinfo.py#L2135-L2191)

```python
PIVOTINFO.apply_func(
    high,
    low,
    up_th,
    down_th
)
```

Compute pivot information for 2D arrays.

Apply the 1D pivot information computation from `pivot_info_1d_nb` to each column independently.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```high```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   Array of high prices.

**```low```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   Array of low prices.

**```up_th```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   Upper threshold for detecting peaks.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```down_th```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   Lower threshold for detecting valleys.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array2d, Array2d, Array2d, Array2d]`
:   Tuple containing:

    * Confirmed pivot types.

    * Indices of confirmed pivots.

    * Last pivot types.

    * Indices of the last pivots.

### PIVOTINFO.custom_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/pivotinfo.py#L3177-L3526)

```python
PIVOTINFO.custom_func(
    input_tuple,
    in_output_tuple,
    param_tuple,
    *args_,
    input_shape=None,
    per_column=False,
    split_columns=False,
    skipna=False,
    return_cache=False,
    use_cache=True,
    jitted_loop=False,
    jitted_warmup=False,
    param_index=None,
    final_index=None,
    single_comb=False,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs_
)
```

Forward inputs and parameters to [PIVOTINFO.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func"), performing caching and pre-processing.

Caching is performed using `cache_func` if provided, and the results are passed to
[PIVOTINFO.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func"). If [PIVOTINFO.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func") is a Numba-compiled function, the actual apply-function becomes
[PIVOTINFO.param_select_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.param_select_func_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.param_select_func_nb"), which handles the selection of parameters and the passing of arguments.

__Args__

**```input_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[AnyArray, ...]`
:   Tuple of input arrays.

**```in_output_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[AnyArray], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of in-place output arrays.

**```param_tuple```** :&ensp;`Tuple[List[ParamValue], ...]`
:   Tuple of lists of parameter values.

**```*args_```**
:   Additional positional arguments.

**```input_shape```** :&ensp;`Optional[Shape]`
:   Shape of the input arrays.

**```per_column```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, processes parameters separately for each column.

**```split_columns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to split arrays into separate columns.

**```skipna```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to skip NaN values.

**```return_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, return the cache result instead of processing further.

**```use_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, IFCacheOutput]`
:   Flag or configuration indicating whether to use caching.

**```jitted_loop```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to use a JIT-compiled loop.

**```jitted_warmup```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, perform a warm-up call for the JIT-compiled function.

**```param_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Index for parameter combinations.

**```final_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Final index used for the output.

**```single_comb```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether there is only one parameter combination.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```**kwargs_```**
:   Additional keyword arguments.

__Returns__

`Union[None, IFCacheOutput, Array2d, List[Array2d]]`
:       Result of applying [PIVOTINFO.apply_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.apply_func"), which may be:

    * Cache output if `return_cache` is True.

    * 2D array.

    * List of 2D arrays.

    * None.

### PIVOTINFO.run | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/pivotinfo.py#L1-L206)

```python
PIVOTINFO.run(
    high,
    low,
    up_th,
    down_th,
    short_name='pivotinfo',
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Run [PIVOTINFO](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO") indicator.

__Inputs__

* `high`: High price series.

* `low`: Low price series.

__Parameters__

* `up_th`: Threshold for identifying a peak (high) pivot point, as a scalar or an array.

* `down_th`: Threshold for identifying a trough (low) pivot point, as a scalar or an array.

__Outputs__

* `conf_pivot`: Type of the latest confirmed pivot (running, see [Pivot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot")).

* `conf_idx`: Index of the latest confirmed pivot (running).

* `last_pivot`: Type of the latest pivot (running, see [Pivot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot")).

* `last_idx`: Index of the latest pivot (running).

__Lazy outputs__

* `conf_value`: High/low value under the latest confirmed pivot (running).

* `last_value`: High/low value under the latest pivot (running).

* `pivots`: Confirmed pivots stored by their indices (looking ahead, see [Pivot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot")).

* `modes`: Trend modes between confirmed pivot points (looking ahead, see [TrendMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.TrendMode "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.TrendMode")).

Pass a list of parameter names as `hide_params` to hide their column levels, or `True` to hide all.
Set `hide_default` to False to display column levels for parameters with default values.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [IndicatorBase.run_pipeline](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/factory/#vectorbtpro.indicators.factory.IndicatorBase.run_pipeline "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.run_pipeline").

__Returns__

`Indicator`
:   Instance of the [PIVOTINFO](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO") indicator, or a tuple of additional objects if applicable.

### PIVOTINFO.run_combs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/pivotinfo.py#L1-L206)

```python
PIVOTINFO.run_combs(
    high,
    low,
    up_th,
    down_th,
    r=2,
    param_product=False,
    comb_func=itertools.combinations,
    run_unique=True,
    short_names=None,
    hide_params=None,
    hide_default=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Create multiple [PIVOTINFO](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO") indicator instances based on parameter combinations.

__Inputs__

* `high`: High price series.

* `low`: Low price series.

__Parameters__

* `up_th`: Threshold for identifying a peak (high) pivot point, as a scalar or an array.

* `down_th`: Threshold for identifying a trough (low) pivot point, as a scalar or an array.

__Outputs__

* `conf_pivot`: Type of the latest confirmed pivot (running, see [Pivot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot")).

* `conf_idx`: Index of the latest confirmed pivot (running).

* `last_pivot`: Type of the latest pivot (running, see [Pivot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot")).

* `last_idx`: Index of the latest pivot (running).

__Lazy outputs__

* `conf_value`: High/low value under the latest confirmed pivot (running).

* `last_value`: High/low value under the latest pivot (running).

* `pivots`: Confirmed pivots stored by their indices (looking ahead, see [Pivot](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.Pivot")).

* `modes`: Trend modes between confirmed pivot points (looking ahead, see [TrendMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/enums/#vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.TrendMode "vectorbtpro.indicators.enums.TrendMode")).

`comb_func` must accept an iterable of parameter tuples along with `r`. 
It also supports combinatoric iterators from `itertools`, like `itertools.combinations`.

!!! note
    Use this method only when multiple indicator instances are required.
    To test multiple parameters, pass them as lists to [PIVOTINFO.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.run").

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments corresponding to inputs, parameters, and in-place outputs.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for pipeline configuration and combination settings, including:

    * `r`: Number of indicators to run.

    * `param_product`: Flag controlling parameter combination behavior.

    * `comb_func`: Function to combine parameter tuples (e.g., `itertools.combinations`).

    * `run_unique`: If True, computes raw outputs before constructing indicators.

    * `short_names`: Custom short names for each indicator.

    * `hide_params`: Parameter names to hide column levels.

    * `hide_default`: Whether to hide parameters with default values.

    Other keyword arguments are passed to [PIVOTINFO.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/pivotinfo/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.pivotinfo.PIVOTINFO.run").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Indicator, ...]`
:   Tuple of indicator instances generated.

## RSI | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/rsi.py#L25-L57)

Class representing the Relative Strength Index (RSI) indicator.

Represents the Relative Strength Index indicator, which measures the speed
and change of price movements of a security by comparing the magnitude of
recent gains and losses over a specified period. It is primarily used to
identify overbought or oversold conditions.

See [Relative Strength Index (RSI)](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/rsi.asp).

__See__

* [RSI.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/custom/rsi/#vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.rsi.RSI.run "vectorbtpro.indicators.custom.rsi.RSI.run") for the main entry point.

* [rsi_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/indicators/nb/#vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.rsi_nb "vectorbtpro.indicators.nb.rsi_nb") for the underlying implementation.

* <https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/rsi.asp> for the definition of RSI.

### RSI.apply_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/indicators/custom/rsi.py#L644-L698)

```python
RSI.apply_func(
    close,
    window=14,
    wtype=0,
    minp=None,
    adjust=False
)
```

Calculate the Relative Strength Index (RSI) for 2-dimensional arrays.

Computes the RSI for each column by applying `rsi_1d_nb` on slices of a 2D array of close prices.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   2-dimensional array of close prices.

**```window```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Window size.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```wtype```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   Weighting type.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    See [WType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/enums/#vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType "vectorbtpro.generic.enums.WType").

**```minp```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of observations required.

**```adjust```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to adjust weights.

__Returns__

`Array2d`
:   Array of computed RSI values for each column.
