Return a dictionary of assets relevant to a given object(s) or query.

!!! note
    Keyword arguments are passed to all functions (except for [find_api](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_api "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_api") when `obj_or_query` is an object
    since it doesn't share common arguments with other three functions), unless `combine` and `as_query`
    are both True; in this case they are passed to [VBTAsset.rank](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.rank "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.rank"). Use specialized arguments like
    `api_kwargs` to provide keyword arguments to the respective function.

    If `obj_or_query` is a query, will rank the combined asset. Otherwise, will rank each individual asset.

__Args__

**```obj_or_query```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList]`
:   Object reference, query, or list of such.

**```as_query```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to treat `obj_or_query` as a query.

**```attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Attribute name to target on the object.

**```module```** :&ensp;`Optional[ModuleLike]`
:   Module context used in reference resolution.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```asset_names```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeIterable[str]]`
:   List specifying the order and selection of assets.

    May include ellipsis (`...`) to adjust ordering. Allowed asset names are:

    * `api`: Retrieved via [find_api](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_api "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_api") with `api_kwargs`.

    * `docs`: Retrieved via [find_docs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_docs "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_docs") with `docs_kwargs`.

    * `messages`: Retrieved via [find_messages](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_messages "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_messages") with `messages_kwargs`.

    * `examples`: Retrieved via [find_examples](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_examples "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_examples") with `examples_kwargs`.

    * `all`: Includes all supported asset types.

    For example, `["examples", ...]` puts "examples" at the beginning and all other assets
    in their usual order at the end.

**```pages_asset```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[PagesAsset]]`
:   Class or instance representing pages assets.

**```messages_asset```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[MessagesAsset]]`
:   Class or instance representing messages assets.

**```pull_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`

:   Option to aggregate messages;
    if a string, it specifies the aggregation key.

## find_docs | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3811-L3878)

## interact | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L4680-L4720)

```python
interact(
    query,
    chat_history=None,
    *,
    tools='all',
    attach_context=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Engage in an interactive chat session with tool support.

This function extends the capabilities of [chat](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.chat "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.chat") by integrating tools that can be utilized during
the chat session. It allows for dynamic interaction, enabling the chat to leverage external functionalities
as needed.

__Args__

**```query```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Query string to process.

**```chat_history```** :&ensp;`ChatHistory`
:   Chat history, a list of dictionaries with defined roles.

**```tools```** :&ensp;`Optional[Tools]`
:   Tools to be used in the conversation.

    If a string is provided, it must be either the name of a registered tool,
    "registry" to use all available tools from the registry,
    "mcp" to use the MCP tools from [tool_registry](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/mcp_server/#vectorbtpro.mcp_server.tool_registry "vectorbtpro.mcp_server.tool_registry"),
    or "all" to use both all available tools and the MCP tools.

    If a list is provided, it must be a list of registered tool names or functions.
    Any unregistered functions will be added to the registry.

**```attach_context```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, attaches additional context to the chat session.

    This may include relevant information or metadata that can enhance the interaction.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [chat](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.chat "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.chat").

__Returns__

`MaybeChatOutput`
:   Chat response generated by the asset's chat method.

:   True if the input is a valid object reference; otherwise, False.

## search | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L4394-L4497)

```python
search(
    query,
    cache_documents=True,
    cache_key=None,
    asset_cache_manager=None,
    asset_cache_manager_kwargs=None,
    aggregate_messages='threads',
    find_assets_kwargs=None,
    display=20,
    display_kwargs=None,
    silence_warnings=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Search for assets relevant to the provided query and return a ranked asset or display output.

Uses [find_assets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets") with `combine=True` and [KnowledgeAsset.rank](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.rank "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.rank").
Keyword arguments are distributed among these two methods automatically, unless some keys cannot be
found in both signatures. In such a case, the key will be used for ranking. If this is not wanted,
specify the [find_assets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets")-related arguments explicitly with `find_assets_kwargs`.

Metadata when aggregating messages will be minimized by default.

__Args__

**```query```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Search query string.

**```cache_documents```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, will use an asset cache manager to cache the generated
    text documents after conversion.

    Running the same method again will use the cached documents.

**```cache_key```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Unique identifier for the cached asset.

**```asset_cache_manager```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[AssetCacheManager]]`
:   Class or instance of
    [AssetCacheManager](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.AssetCacheManager "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.AssetCacheManager").

**```asset_cache_manager_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments to initialize or update `asset_cache_manager`.

**```aggregate_messages```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, str]`
:   Option to aggregate messages;
    if a string, it specifies the aggregation key.

**```find_assets_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [find_assets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets").

**```display```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, int]`
:   If True, displays the top results as static HTML pages with [VBTAsset.display](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.display "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.display").

    Pass an integer to display n top results. Will return the path to the temporary file.

**```display_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [VBTAsset.display](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.display "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.display").

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [find_assets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.find_assets") or [VBTAsset.rank](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.rank "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.rank").

__Returns__

`Union[MaybeVBTAsset, Path]`
:   Ranked asset or the path to the temporary file with displayed results.

## ExamplesAsset | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3642-L3721)

ExamplesAsset(
    *args,
    release_name=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for managing code examples (i.e., extracted and annotated code snippets from other assets).

__    Fields__

link (str): URL of the page or message, e.g. "https://vectorbt.pro/features/data/".
title (str): Title of the code example, e.g. "Definition of `<function_name>`".
description (str): Description of the code example, e.g. "Demonstrates ...".
content (str): Actual code example wrapped in a fenced code block, e.g. "```python
...
```".
        verified (bool): Whether the code example was posted by project maintainer or has at least one upvote.

    !!! info
        For default settings, see `assets.examples` in [knowledge](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge "vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge").

### find_obj_examples <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3697-L3721" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.ExamplesAsset.find_obj_examples data-toc-label="find\_obj\_examples" }

```python
ExamplesAsset.find_obj_examples(
    obj,
    *,
    attr=None,
    module=None,
    resolve=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Return code examples relevant to the specified object(s).

Delegates the search to [VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.ExamplesAsset.find_obj_mentions") to locate code examples associated
with the provided object(s). Any additional keyword arguments are forwarded to the method.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`MaybeList`
:   Object or list of objects to search for.

**```attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Attribute name to target on the object.

**```module```** :&ensp;`Optional[ModuleLike]`
:   Module context used in reference resolution.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.ExamplesAsset.find_obj_mentions").

__Returns__

`MaybeExamplesAsset`
:   New examples asset containing code examples related to the specified object(s).

Return code examples sorted in reverse chronological order.

## MessagesAsset <span class="dobjtype">class</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3092-L3636" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset data-toc-label="MessagesAsset" }

```python
MessagesAsset(
    *args,
    release_name=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for managing Discord messages.

__Fields__

**```link```** :&ensp;`str`
:   URL of the message, e.g. "https://discord.com/channels/918629562441695344/919715148896301067/923327319882485851".

**```block```** :&ensp;`str`
:   URL of the first message in a block.

    A block is a sequence of messages by the same author that either reference another
    author's message or reference none.

**```thread```** :&ensp;`str`
:   URL of the first message in a thread.

    A thread is a bunch of blocks that reference each other in a chain, such as questions,
    answers, follow-up questions, etc.

**```reference```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   URL of the referenced message.

**```replies```** :&ensp;`List[str]`
:   URLs of messages that reference this message.

**```channel```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Name of the message channel, e.g. "support".

**```timestamp```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Timestamp of the message in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "2025-06-23".

**```author```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Message author:

    * "@user_n": participant n in this thread

    * "@ext_user_n": (external) mentioned user n who hasn't posted in this thread

    * "@maintainer": project maintainer

**```content```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Text content of the message.

**```mentions```** :&ensp;`List[str]`
:   Discord usernames mentioned in the message, e.g. ["@maintainer"].

**```attachments```** :&ensp;`List[dict]`
:   Attachments with fields "file_name" (e.g. "some_image.png") and
    "content" (extracted file content).

**```reactions```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Total number of reactions received.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `assets.messages` in [knowledge](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge "vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge").

### aggregate <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3462-L3484" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.aggregate data-toc-label="aggregate" }

```python
MessagesAsset.aggregate(
    by='lowest',
    **kwargs
)
```

Aggregate messages based on a specified level.

Determines the aggregation level among "message", "block", "thread", or "channel" by processing
the input `by`. If `by` is "lowest" or "highest", it is replaced with the corresponding property.
The level name is then pluralized and used to call the appropriate aggregation method.

__Args__

**```by```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Aggregation level or a special keyword ("lowest" or "highest").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for the aggregation method.

__Returns__

[MessagesAsset](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset")
:   New messages asset with aggregated messages.

---

### aggregate_blocks <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3193-L3258" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.aggregate_blocks data-toc-label="aggregate\_blocks" }

```python
MessagesAsset.aggregate_blocks(
    collect_kwargs=None,
    aggregate_fields=None,
    parent_links_only=None,
    minimize_metadata=None,
    minimize_keys=None,
    clean_metadata=None,
    clean_metadata_kwargs=None,
    dump_metadata_kwargs=None,
    metadata_fence=None,
    to_markdown_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Aggregate messages by block.

Collects messages grouped by the "block" field using [KnowledgeAsset.collect](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.collect "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.collect")
(with `uniform_groups` defaulting to True) and then applies
[AggBlockAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.AggBlockAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.AggBlockAssetFunc") to aggregate each group.

__Args__

**```collect_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.collect](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.collect "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.collect").

    If not provided, an empty dict with `uniform_groups` set to True is used.

**```aggregate_fields```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, Iterable[str]]`
:   Fields to aggregate instead of
    including in child metadata; True aggregates all lists; False aggregates none.

**```parent_links_only```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, excludes links from the metadata.

**```minimize_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to minimize metadata.

**```minimize_keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[PathLikeKey]]`
:   Keys specifying which metadata to minimize.

**```clean_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, remove empty metadata fields.

**```clean_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for cleaning metadata.

    See [FindRemoveAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.FindRemoveAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.FindRemoveAssetFunc").

**```dump_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for dumping metadata.

    See [DumpAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc").

**```metadata_fence```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Metadata fence to use for formatting.

    Options are "code", "frontmatter", or a custom string.

**```to_markdown_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for markdown conversion.

    See [to_markdown](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/formatting/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown "vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.apply](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.apply "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.apply").

__Returns__

`MaybeMessagesAsset`
:   New messages asset with messages aggregated by block.

### aggregate_messages <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3143-L3191" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.aggregate_messages data-toc-label="aggregate\_messages" }

```python
MessagesAsset.aggregate_messages(
    minimize_metadata=None,
    minimize_keys=None,
    clean_metadata=None,
    clean_metadata_kwargs=None,
    dump_metadata_kwargs=None,
    metadata_fence=None,
    to_markdown_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Aggregate attachments and metadata for each message.

Applies [KnowledgeAsset.apply](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.apply "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.apply") with [AggMessageAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.AggMessageAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.AggMessageAssetFunc")
to aggregate attachments on a per-message basis. For additional keyword arguments,
see [VBTAsset.to_markdown](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.to_markdown "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.to_markdown").

__Args__

**```minimize_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to minimize metadata.

**```minimize_keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[PathLikeKey]]`
:   Keys specifying which metadata to minimize.

**```clean_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, remove empty metadata fields.

**```clean_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for cleaning metadata.

    See [FindRemoveAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.FindRemoveAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.FindRemoveAssetFunc").

**```dump_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for dumping metadata.

    See [DumpAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc").

**```metadata_fence```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Metadata fence to use for formatting.

    Options are "code", "frontmatter", or a custom string.

**```to_markdown_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for markdown conversion.

    See [to_markdown](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/formatting/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown "vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.apply](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.apply "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.apply").

__Returns__

`MaybeMessagesAsset`
:   New messages asset with aggregated messages.

MessagesAsset.aggregate_threads(
    collect_kwargs=None,

Aggregate messages by thread.

Collects messages grouped by the "thread" field using [KnowledgeAsset.collect](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.collect "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.collect")
(with `uniform_groups` defaulting to True) and then applies
[AggThreadAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.AggThreadAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.AggThreadAssetFunc") to aggregate each group.

__Args__

**```collect_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.collect](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.collect "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.collect").

    If not provided, an empty dict with `uniform_groups` set to True is used.

**```aggregate_fields```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, Iterable[str]]`
:   Fields to aggregate instead of
    including in child metadata; True aggregates all lists; False aggregates none.

**```parent_links_only```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, excludes links from the metadata.

**```minimize_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to minimize metadata.

**```minimize_keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[PathLikeKey]]`
:   Keys specifying which metadata to minimize.

**```clean_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, remove empty metadata fields.

**```clean_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for cleaning metadata.

    See [FindRemoveAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.FindRemoveAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.FindRemoveAssetFunc").

**```dump_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for dumping metadata.

    See [DumpAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc").

**```metadata_fence```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Metadata fence to use for formatting.

    Options are "code", "frontmatter", or a custom string.

**```to_markdown_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for markdown conversion.

    See [to_markdown](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/formatting/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown "vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.apply](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.apply "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.apply").

### lowest_aggregate_by <span class="dobjtype">class property</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L3394-L3428" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.MessagesAsset.lowest_aggregate_by data-toc-label="lowest\_aggregate\_by" }

Lowest aggregation level for the messages.

Checks the following fields in order:

* If `attachments` is present, returns "message".

* If all messages share the same `block`, returns "block".

* If all messages share the same `thread`, returns "thread".

* If all messages share the same `channel`, returns "channel".

__Returns__

`Optional[str]`
:   Lowest level by which messages are aggregated,
    or None if no level is consistently available.

## PagesAsset <span class="dobjtype">class</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1762-L3086" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset data-toc-label="PagesAsset" }

```python
PagesAsset(
    *args,
    release_name=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for handling website pages and headings.

__Fields__

**```link```** :&ensp;`str`
:   URL of the page without fragment, such as "https://vectorbt.pro/features/data/",
    or heading with fragment, such as "https://vectorbt.pro/features/data/#trading-view".

**```parent```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   URL of the parent page or heading.

    For example, a heading 1 is a parent of a heading 2.

**```children```** :&ensp;`List[str]`
:   List of URLs of the child pages and/or headings.

    For example, a heading 2 is a child of a heading 1.

**```name```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Name of the page or heading representing the API object's name, such as "Portfolio.from_signals".

**```type```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Type of the page or heading (e.g., "page", "heading 1").

**```icon```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Icon identifier (e.g., "material-brain").

**```tags```** :&ensp;`List[str]`
:   List of tags associated with the page or heading.

**```content```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Content of the page or heading; may be None if it solely redirects.

**```obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   API type of the represented object (e.g., "property").

**```github_link```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   URL to the source code of the represented object.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `assets.pages` in [knowledge](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge "vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge").

### aggregate <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L2640-L2704" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate data-toc-label="aggregate" }

```python
PagesAsset.aggregate(
    append_obj_type=None,
    append_github_link=None
)
```

Aggregate pages by merging descendant headings into their parent page content.

This method converts each heading's content into markdown and concatenates it with its
parent's content, resulting in pages that contain aggregated information. Only parent pages
and headings without a designated parent remain, while aggregated headings are merged.

__Args__

**```append_obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, append the object type to the heading.

**```append_github_link```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, append the GitHub source link to the heading.

__Returns__

[PagesAsset](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset")
:   New pages asset with aggregated page content.

### find_obj_api <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L2005-L2419" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.find_obj_api data-toc-label="find\_obj\_api" }

```python
PagesAsset.find_obj_api(
    obj,
    *,
    attr=None,
    module=None,
    resolve=True,
    only_obj=False,
    use_parent=None,
    use_base_parents=None,
    use_ref_parents=None,
    incl_bases=None,
    incl_ancestors=None,
    incl_base_ancestors=None,
    incl_refs=None,
    incl_descendants=None,
    incl_ancestor_descendants=None,
    incl_ref_descendants=None,
    aggregate=None,
    aggregate_ancestors=None,
    aggregate_refs=None,
    aggregate_kwargs=None,
    topo_sort=None,
    return_refname_graph=False
)
```

Return API pages and headings relevant to the provided object(s).

Resolves the object reference name using [ensure_refname](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/refs/#vectorbtpro.utils.refs.ensure_refname "vectorbtpro.utils.refs.ensure_refname") and
extends the asset with related pages based on various options. This includes incorporating
base classes/attributes, ancestors, reference descendants, and aggregation of links.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`MaybeList`
:   Object or list of objects to find API pages for.

**```attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Attribute name to target on the object.

**```module```** :&ensp;`Optional[ModuleLike]`
:   Module context used in reference resolution.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```only_obj```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, disable all extensions and return only the object itself.

**```use_parent```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include the object's parent page.

**```use_base_parents```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include base classes/attributes of the parent.

**```use_ref_parents```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include reference parent pages.

**```incl_bases```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Include base classes/attributes or specify maximum inheritance level.

    For instance, [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") has [Analyzable](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/analyzable/#vectorbtpro.generic.analyzable.Analyzable "vectorbtpro.generic.analyzable.Analyzable")
    as one of its base classes. It can also be an integer indicating the maximum inheritance level.
    If `obj` is a module, then bases are sub-modules.

**```incl_ancestors```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Include ancestor pages or specify maximum level.

    For instance, [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") has [vectorbtpro.portfolio.base](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/ "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base") as its ancestor.
    It can also be an integer indicating the maximum level. Provide `incl_base_ancestors`
    to override `incl_ancestors` for base classes/attributes.

**```incl_base_ancestors```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Override `incl_ancestors` for base classes/attributes.

**```incl_refs```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Extend the asset with references from the object's content.

    If True, include reference names; if an integer, limit to the specified maximum reference level.
    Defaults to False for modules and classes, and True otherwise. When reference name resolution
    is disabled, defaults to False.

**```incl_descendants```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Extend the asset with descendant headings.

    Provide `incl_ancestor_descendants` and `incl_ref_descendants` to override `incl_descendants`
    for ancestors and references respectively.

**```incl_ancestor_descendants```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Override descendant inclusion for ancestor headings.

**```incl_ref_descendants```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Override descendant inclusion for reference headings.

**```aggregate```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Aggregate descendant headings into pages for the object and its
    base classes or attributes.

    Provide `aggregate_ancestors` and `aggregate_refs` to override `aggregate` for ancestors
    and references respectively.

**```aggregate_ancestors```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Override aggregation for ancestor headings.

**```aggregate_refs```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Override aggregation for reference headings.

**```aggregate_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [PagesAsset.aggregate](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate").

**```topo_sort```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Create a topological graph from reference names and
    sort pages and headings.

    Set `return_refname_graph` to True to also return the graph.

**```return_refname_graph```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Return a tuple of the asset and reference name graph if True.

__Returns__

`Union[PagesAsset, Tuple[PagesAsset, dict]]`
:   Asset with relevant API pages and headings,
    optionally accompanied by a reference name graph.

### find_obj_docs <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L2421-L2573" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.find_obj_docs data-toc-label="find\_obj\_docs" }

```python
PagesAsset.find_obj_docs(
    obj,
    *,
    attr=None,
    module=None,
    resolve=True,
    incl_pages=None,
    excl_pages=None,
    page_find_mode=None,
    up_aggregate=None,
    up_aggregate_th=None,
    up_aggregate_pages=None,
    aggregate=None,
    aggregate_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Find documentation for the given object(s).

Search for documentation links related to the specified object(s) by applying inclusion and
exclusion criteria. This method filters documentation pages by checking if their links contain
parts specified in `incl_pages` and excludes those matching `excl_pages`. Matching is performed
using [find](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/search_/#vectorbtpro.utils.search_.find "vectorbtpro.utils.search_.find") with `page_find_mode` to determine relevance. For example,
specifying `excl_pages=["release-notes"]` will omit documentation related to release notes.

When upward aggregation is enabled via `up_aggregate`, the method aggregates child headings into
their parent if the count exceeds the threshold defined by `up_aggregate_th` (an integer for an
absolute count or a float for a relative count). For example, `up_aggregate_th=2/3` means this
method must find 2 headings out of 3 in order to replace it by the full parent heading/page.
Similarly, if `up_aggregate_pages` is True, page aggregation is applied. For example, if 2
tutorial pages out of 3 are matched, the whole tutorial series is used. This strategy
consolidates related documentation sections.

If `aggregate` is True, aggregates any descendant headings into pages for this object
and all base classes/attributes using [PagesAsset.aggregate_links](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate_links "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate_links").

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`MaybeList`
:   Object or list of objects to find documentation for.

**```attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Attribute name to target on the object.

**```module```** :&ensp;`Optional[ModuleLike]`
:   Module context used in reference resolution.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```incl_pages```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeIterable[str]]`
:   Iterable of page identifiers or parts to include.

**```excl_pages```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeIterable[str]]`
:   Iterable of page identifiers or parts to exclude.

**```page_find_mode```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Mode used for matching pages in [find](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/search_/#vectorbtpro.utils.search_.find "vectorbtpro.utils.search_.find").

**```up_aggregate```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to aggregate child headings into their parent.

**```up_aggregate_th```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, float]`
:   Threshold for upward aggregation of headings.

**```up_aggregate_pages```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to aggregate pages.

**```aggregate```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to perform aggregation on matched items.

**```aggregate_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [PagesAsset.aggregate](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.find_obj_mentions").

__Returns__

`MaybePagesAsset`
:   New pages asset with the found documentation pages or headings.

### find_page <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1851-L1890" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.find_page data-toc-label="find\_page" }

```python
PagesAsset.find_page(
    link,
    aggregate=False,
    aggregate_kwargs=None,
    incl_descendants=False,
    single_item=True,
    **kwargs
)
```

Return the page or pages corresponding to the given link(s).

Searches for pages using the specified link(s) with options to aggregate or include descendant headings.
Keyword arguments are passed to [VBTAsset.find_link](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_link "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_link").

__Args__

**```link```** :&ensp;`MaybeList[str]`
:   Link or list of links to search for.

**```aggregate```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to aggregate headings into pages.

**```aggregate_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [PagesAsset.aggregate](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.aggregate").

**```incl_descendants```** :&ensp;`bool`

### print_site_schema <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L2926-L3010" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.PagesAsset.print_site_schema data-toc-label="print\_site\_schema" }

```python
PagesAsset.print_site_schema(
    append_type=False,
    append_obj_type=False,
    structure_fragments=True,
    split_fragments=True,
    **dir_tree_kwargs
)
```

Print the site schema in a formatted tree layout.

The schema displays page links with optional appended types and object types.
When `structure_fragments` is True, link fragments are organized into a hierarchical structure,
and if `split_fragments` is enabled, fragments are shown as continuations of their parent links.

__Args__

**```append_type```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Append the page type to each displayed name.

**```append_obj_type```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Append the object type to each displayed name when available.

**```structure_fragments```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Organize link fragments into a hierarchical structure.

**```split_fragments```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Display fragments as continuations of their parent links.

**```**dir_tree_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [dir_tree_from_paths](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/path_/#vectorbtpro.utils.path_.dir_tree_from_paths "vectorbtpro.utils.path_.dir_tree_from_paths").

__Returns__

None

### find_obj_mentions <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1527-L1657" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions data-toc-label="find\_obj\_mentions" }

```python
VBTAsset.find_obj_mentions(
    obj,
    *,
    attr=None,
    module=None,
    resolve=True,
    incl_shortcuts=None,
    incl_shortcut_access=None,
    incl_shortcut_call=None,
    incl_instances=None,
    incl_custom=None,
    is_custom_regex=False,
    as_code=None,
    as_regex=None,
    allow_prefix=None,
    allow_suffix=None,
    merge_targets=None,
    per_path=False,
    path='content',
    return_type='item',
    **kwargs
)
```

Find and return mentions associated with a VBT object.

Uses [VBTAsset.generate_mention_targets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.generate_mention_targets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.generate_mention_targets") to obtain mention targets from the given object.
Custom mention targets can be provided via `incl_custom`, and if these are regular expressions,
set `is_custom_regex` to True. Depending on the settings for `as_code` and `as_regex`, the search
is performed using either [KnowledgeAsset.find_code](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.find_code "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_code") or [KnowledgeAsset.find](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.find "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find"). If `merge_targets` is True, the
mention targets are consolidated using [VBTAsset.merge_mention_targets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.merge_mention_targets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.merge_mention_targets").

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`MaybeList`
:   Object or list of objects to find mentions for.

**```attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Attribute name to target on the object.

**```module```** :&ensp;`Optional[ModuleLike]`
:   Module context used in reference resolution.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```incl_shortcuts```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include shortcuts from `import vectorbtpro as vbt`.

**```incl_shortcut_access```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include attribute access forms when applicable.

**```incl_shortcut_call```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include callable forms when applicable.

**```incl_instances```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include common class abbreviation forms.

**```incl_custom```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[str]]`
:   Additional custom mention targets.

**```is_custom_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Treat custom mention targets as regular expressions.

**```as_code```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Format the target as code.

**```as_regex```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Format the target as a regular expression.

    For instance, `vbt.PF` may match `vbt.PFO` if RegEx is not used.

**```allow_prefix```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Allow a prefix in target formatting.

**```allow_suffix```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Allow a suffix in target formatting.

**```merge_targets```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Merge mention targets to simplify the search.

**```per_path```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to perform the search per specified path.

**```path```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[PathLikeKey]]`
:   Path(s) within the data item to
    search (e.g. "x.y[0].z").

**```return_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of result to return.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.find](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.find "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find") or [KnowledgeAsset.find_code](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.find_code "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.find_code").

__Returns__

`MaybeVBTAsset`
:   New VBT asset containing the found mentions.

### generate_mention_targets <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1389-L1490" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.generate_mention_targets data-toc-label="generate\_mention\_targets" }

```python
VBTAsset.generate_mention_targets(
    obj,
    *,
    attr=None,
    module=None,
    resolve=True,
    incl_base_attr=None,
    incl_shortcuts=None,
    incl_shortcut_access=None,
    incl_shortcut_call=None,
    incl_instances=None,
    as_code=None,
    as_regex=None,
    allow_prefix=None,
    allow_suffix=None
)
```

Generate mention targets for an object.

This method generates a list of mention targets for a given object or list of objects.
It first resolves the object reference name using [ensure_refname](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/refs/#vectorbtpro.utils.refs.ensure_refname "vectorbtpro.utils.refs.ensure_refname").
If an attribute is specified, the method checks whether it is defined on the object
itself or on a base class. When the attribute belongs to a base class and `incl_base_attr` is True,
targets are generated for both the object attribute and the corresponding base class attribute.
Final targets are produced via [VBTAsset.generate_refname_targets](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.generate_refname_targets "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.generate_refname_targets").

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`MaybeList`
:   Object or list of objects to generate mention targets for.

**```attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Attribute name to target on the object.

**```module```** :&ensp;`Optional[ModuleLike]`
:   Module context used in reference resolution.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```incl_base_attr```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include targets for base class attributes if applicable.

**```incl_shortcuts```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include shortcuts from `import vectorbtpro as vbt`.

**```incl_shortcut_access```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include attribute access forms when applicable.

**```incl_shortcut_call```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include callable forms when applicable.

**```incl_instances```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include common class abbreviation forms.

**```as_code```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Format the target as code.

**```as_regex```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Format the target as a regular expression.

    For instance, `vbt.PF` may match `vbt.PFO` if RegEx is not used.

**```allow_prefix```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Allow a prefix in target formatting.

**```allow_suffix```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Allow a suffix in target formatting.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   List of generated mention targets.

### generate_refname_targets <span class="dobjtype">class method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1254-L1387" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.generate_refname_targets data-toc-label="generate\_refname\_targets" }

Generate targets based on a reference name.

This method constructs a list of targets representing a module, class, attribute, or callable.
It optionally includes:

* Shortcuts from `vectorbtpro as vbt`.

* Attribute access versions for classes or modules.

* Callable versions for callables.

* Common class abbreviation forms via mapped name parts from [class_abbr_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.class_abbr_config "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.class_abbr_config").

Each target is formatted using [VBTAsset.prepare_mention_target](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.prepare_mention_target "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.prepare_mention_target").

__Args__

:   Reference name.

**```resolve```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to resolve the reference to an actual object.

**```incl_shortcuts```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include shortcuts from `import vectorbtpro as vbt`.

**```incl_shortcut_access```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include attribute access forms when applicable.

**```incl_shortcut_call```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include callable forms when applicable.

**```incl_instances```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Include common class abbreviation forms.

**```as_code```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Format the target as code.

**```as_regex```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Format the target as a regular expression.

    For instance, `vbt.PF` may match `vbt.PFO` if RegEx is not used.

**```allow_prefix```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Allow a prefix in target formatting.

**```allow_suffix```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Allow a suffix in target formatting.

__Returns__

`List[str]`
:   Sorted list of generated reference name targets.

### prepare_mention_target <span class="dobjtype">class method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1174-L1210" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.prepare_mention_target data-toc-label="prepare\_mention\_target" }

```python
VBTAsset.prepare_mention_target(
    target,
    as_code=False,
    as_regex=True,
    allow_prefix=False,
    allow_suffix=False
)
```

Prepare a mention target for pattern matching.

Transforms the input target into a regex pattern if `as_regex` is True by escaping special
characters and optionally adding boundary assertions based on the `allow_prefix` and
`allow_suffix` flags. Returns the original target if `as_regex` is False.

__Args__

**```target```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Target string to process.

**```as_code```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if the target represents code.

**```as_regex```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates whether to prepare the target as a regex pattern.

**```allow_prefix```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, do not prepend a non-word boundary.

**```allow_suffix```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, do not append a non-word boundary.

__Returns__

`str`
:   Processed mention target.

---

### pull <span class="dobjtype">class method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L141-L403" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.pull data-toc-label="pull" }

```python
VBTAsset.pull(
    release_name=None,
    asset_name=None,
    repo_owner=None,
    repo_name=None,
    token=None,
    token_required=None,
    use_pygithub=None,
    chunk_size=None,

```

Build a [VBTAsset](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset") instance from a JSON asset in a GitHub release.

__Args__

**```release_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   GitHub release specification ('latest', 'current',
    or a specific tag such as 'v2024.12.15').

**```asset_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the asset file (e.g. 'messages.json.zip').

    You can find all asset file names at <https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/releases/latest>

**```repo_owner```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Owner of the GitHub repository.

**```repo_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the GitHub repository.

**```token```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   GitHub authentication token.

    It doesn't have to be provided if the asset has already been downloaded.

**```token_required```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether a GitHub token is required.

**```use_pygithub```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Use the PyGithub library to fetch release data.

    If True, uses <https://github.com/PyGithub/PyGithub> (otherwise requests)

**```chunk_size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of bytes per download chunk.

**```cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to determine whether to use the cache directory.

**```cache_dir```** :&ensp;`Optional[PathLike]`
:   Directory for saving JSON asset files (`assets_dir` in settings).

**```cache_mkdir_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for cache directory creation.

    See [check_mkdir](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/path_/#vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir "vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir").

**```clear_cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Remove the cache directory before operation if True.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the progress bar.

    See [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [KnowledgeAsset.from_json_file](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.from_json_file "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.from_json_file") or [KnowledgeAsset.from_json_bytes](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.from_json_bytes "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.from_json_bytes").

__Returns__

[VBTAsset](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset")
:   New VBT asset built from the downloaded JSON asset.

### resolve_spec_settings_path <span class="dobjtype">class method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L1659-L1681" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.resolve_spec_settings_path data-toc-label="resolve\_spec\_settings\_path" }

```python
VBTAsset.resolve_spec_settings_path()
```

Resolve specialized settings paths based on the inheritance hierarchy of [VBTAsset](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset").

Iterates through the reversed method resolution order of the class, collecting the `_settings_path`
attribute from each subclass of [VBTAsset](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset"). The base path is added under the key "knowledge", and the
same path with a ".chat" suffix is added under "knowledge.chat".

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Dictionary containing specialized settings paths for 'knowledge' and 'knowledge.chat'.

### save_to_html <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L924-L1045" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.save_to_html data-toc-label="save\_to\_html" }

```python
VBTAsset.save_to_html(
    cache=None,
    cache_dir=None,
    cache_mkdir_kwargs=None,
    clear_cache=None,
    use_hash=False,
    show_progress=None,
    pbar_kwargs=None,
    template_context=None,
    return_url_map=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Save asset content as HTML files and open them in a web browser.

!!! note
    An index page is created if there are multiple top-level parent entries.

__Args__

**```cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to determine whether to use the cache directory.

    Otherwise, creates a temporary directory.

**```cache_dir```** :&ensp;`Optional[PathLike]`
:   Directory for saving HTML files (`html_dir` in settings).

**```cache_mkdir_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for cache directory creation.

    See [check_mkdir](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/path_/#vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir "vectorbtpro.utils.path_.check_mkdir").

**```clear_cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Remove the cache directory before operation if True.

**```use_hash```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, use a hash of the URL as filename to avoid long paths.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the progress bar.

    See [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```return_url_map```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, also return a mapping of links to file paths along
    with the HTML directory path.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ToHTMLAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.ToHTMLAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.ToHTMLAssetFunc").

__Returns__

`Union[Path, Tuple[Path, dict]]`
:   Directory where HTML files are stored, and optionally
    a mapping of links to file paths.

### to_html <span class="dobjtype">method</span><a class="githublink" href="https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/custom_assets.py#L803-L857" target="_blank" title="Jump to source">:material-github:</a> { #vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.to_html data-toc-label="to\_html" }

```python

    minimize_metadata=None,
    minimize_keys=None,
    clean_metadata=None,

Uses [KnowledgeAsset.apply](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_assets/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_assets.KnowledgeAsset.apply "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_assets.VBTAsset.apply") on [ToHTMLAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/custom_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.ToHTMLAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.custom_asset_funcs.ToHTMLAssetFunc").

**```minimize_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`

**```minimize_keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeList[PathLikeKey]]`
:   Keys specifying which metadata to minimize.

**```clean_metadata```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`

**```clean_metadata_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`

    See [DumpAssetFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/base_asset_funcs/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc "vectorbtpro.knowledge.base_asset_funcs.DumpAssetFunc").

    Options are "code", "frontmatter", or a custom string.

**```to_markdown_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for markdown conversion.

    See [to_markdown](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/formatting/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown "vectorbtpro.knowledge.formatting.to_markdown").

**```format_html_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`

## rank_documents | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L1568-L1628)

```python
rank_documents(
    query,
    documents=None,
    top_k=None,
    min_top_k=None,
    max_top_k=None,
    cutoff=None,
    refresh=False,
    refresh_documents=None,
    refresh_embeddings=None,
    return_chunks=False,
    return_scores=False,
    doc_ranker=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Rank documents based on their relevance to a query using a [DocumentRanker](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker").

__Args__

**```query```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Query string for ranking.

**```documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[StoreDocument]]`
:   Collection of documents to rank.

    If None, documents from the document store are used.

**```top_k```** :&ensp;`TopKLike`
:   Number or percentage of top documents to return, or a method to determine it.

**```min_top_k```** :&ensp;`TopKLike`
:   Minimum limit for determining top documents.

**```max_top_k```** :&ensp;`TopKLike`
:   Maximum limit for determining top documents.

**```cutoff```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Score threshold to filter documents.

**```refresh```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to refresh both documents and embeddings.

**```refresh_documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh documents; defaults to `refresh`.

**```refresh_embeddings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh embeddings; defaults to `refresh`.

**```return_chunks```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return document chunks.

**```return_scores```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return scored documents with their scores.

**```doc_ranker```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[DocumentRanker]]`
:   [DocumentRanker](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker") class or instance.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments to initialize or update `doc_ranker`.

__Returns__

`RankedDocuments`
:   Ranked documents based on the query relevance.

### Contextable.chat | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L1803-L1847)

```python
Contextable.chat(
    message,
    chat_history=None,
    *,
    return_chat=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Chat with a language model using the instance as context.

!!! note
    Context is recalculated each time this method is invoked. For multiple turns,
    it's more efficient to use [Contextable.create_chat](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.Contextable.create_chat "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.Contextable.create_chat").

__Args__

**```message```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Message to send to the language model.

**```chat_history```** :&ensp;`Optional[ChatHistory]`
:   Chat history, a list of dictionaries with defined roles.

**```return_chat```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to return both the completion and the chat instance.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Contextable.create_chat](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.Contextable.create_chat "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.Contextable.create_chat").

__Returns__

`MaybeChatOutput`
:   Completion response or a tuple of the response and the chat instance.

__Examples__

```pycon
>>> asset.chat("What's the value under 'xyz'?")
The value under 'xyz' is 123.

>>> chat_history = []
>>> asset.chat("What's the value under 'xyz'?", chat_history=chat_history)
The value under 'xyz' is 123.

>>> asset.chat("Are you sure?", chat_history=chat_history)
Yes, I am sure. The value under 'xyz' is 123 for the entry where `s` is "EFG".
```

## DocumentRanker | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L90-L1519)

```python
DocumentRanker(
    dataset_id=None,
    embeddings=None,
    embeddings_kwargs=None,
    doc_store=None,
    doc_store_kwargs=None,
    cache_doc_store=None,
    emb_store=None,
    emb_store_kwargs=None,
    cache_emb_store=None,
    search_method=None,
    bm25_tokenizer=None,
    bm25_tokenizer_kwargs=None,
    bm25_retriever=None,
    bm25_retriever_kwargs=None,
    bm25_mirror_store_id=None,
    rrf_k=None,
    rrf_bm25_weight=None,
    score_func=None,
    score_agg_func=None,
    normalize_scores=None,
    show_progress=None,
    pbar_kwargs=None,
    template_context=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for embedding, scoring, and ranking documents.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [knowledge](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge "vectorbtpro._settings.knowledge") and
    its sub-configurations `chat` and `chat.doc_ranker_config`.

__Args__

**```dataset_id```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Identifier for the dataset.

**```embeddings```** :&ensp;`EmbeddingsLike`
:   Identifier, subclass, or instance of [Embeddings](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/embeddings/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.embeddings.Embeddings "vectorbtpro.knowledge.embeddings.Embeddings").

    Resolved using [resolve_embeddings](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/embeddings/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.embeddings.resolve_embeddings "vectorbtpro.knowledge.embeddings.resolve_embeddings").

**```embeddings_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments to initialize or update `embeddings`.

**```doc_store```** :&ensp;`ObjectStoreLike`
:   Identifier, subclass, or instance of
    [ObjectStore](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_storing/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.ObjectStore "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.ObjectStore") for documents.

    Resolved using [resolve_obj_store](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_storing/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.resolve_obj_store "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.resolve_obj_store").

**```doc_store_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments to initialize or update `doc_store`.

**```cache_doc_store```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to indicate if `doc_store` should be cached.

**```emb_store```** :&ensp;`ObjectStoreLike`
:   Identifier, subclass, or instance of
    [ObjectStore](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_storing/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.ObjectStore "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.ObjectStore") for embeddings.

    Resolved using [resolve_obj_store](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_storing/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.resolve_obj_store "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_storing.resolve_obj_store").

**```emb_store_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments to initialize or update `emb_store`.

**```cache_emb_store```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to indicate if `emb_store` should be cached.

**```search_method```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Strategy for document search.

    Supported strategies:

    * "bm25": Use BM25 for document search.

    * "embeddings": Use embeddings for document search.
        Embeds documents that don't have embeddings, which can be time-consuming.

    * "hybrid": Use a combination of embeddings and BM25 for document search.
        Embeds documents that don't have embeddings, which can be time-consuming.

    * "embeddings_fallback": Use "embeddings" if all documents have embeddings, otherwise use "bm25".

    * "hybrid_fallback": Use "hybrid" if all documents have embeddings, otherwise use "bm25".

**```bm25_tokenizer```** :&ensp;`Optional[BM25Tokenizer]`
:   BM25 tokenizer instance or type for processing text.

    Resolved using [DocumentRanker.resolve_bm25_tokenizer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.resolve_bm25_tokenizer "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.resolve_bm25_tokenizer").

**```bm25_tokenizer_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments to initialize `bm25_tokenizer`.

**```bm25_retriever```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[BM25]]`
:   BM25 retriever instance or type for document retrieval.

    Resolved using [DocumentRanker.resolve_bm25_retriever](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.resolve_bm25_retriever "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.resolve_bm25_retriever").

**```bm25_retriever_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments to initialize `bm25_retriever`.

**```bm25_mirror_store_id```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Identifier for the BM25 mirror store.

**```rrf_k```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   K parameter for RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion).

**```rrf_bm25_weight```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   BM25 weight for RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion).

    The embedding weight is computed as 1 minus this value.

**```score_func```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, Callable]`
:   Function or identifier for scoring documents.

    See [DocumentRanker.compute_score](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.compute_score "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.compute_score").

**```score_agg_func```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, Callable]`
:   Function or identifier for aggregating scores.

**```normalize_scores```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether scores should be normalized before filtering.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

### DocumentRanker.bm25_score_documents | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L969-L1143)

```python
DocumentRanker.bm25_score_documents(
    query,
    documents=None,
    refresh=False,
    refresh_documents=None,
    return_chunks=False,
    return_documents=False
)
```

Return BM25 relevance scores for documents matching a query.

__Args__

**```query```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Query string for relevance scoring.

**```documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[StoreDocument]]`
:   Collection of documents to score.

    If None, documents from the document store are used.

**```refresh```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to refresh both documents and embeddings.

**```refresh_documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh documents; defaults to `refresh`.

**```return_chunks```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return document chunks.

**```return_documents```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, include original document objects in the output.

__Returns__

`ScoredDocuments`
:   Computed BM25 scores for each document, as either numeric scores or
    [ScoredDocument](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.ScoredDocument "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.ScoredDocument") objects.

### DocumentRanker.compute_score | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L772-L821)

```python
DocumentRanker.compute_score(
    emb1,
    emb2
)
```

Compute similarity or distance scores between embeddings.

Compute scores between embedding vectors using the configured scoring function.
Supported functions include "cosine", "euclidean", and "dot". Alternatively, a callable
metric can be supplied that accepts two arrays and returns a 2-dimensional ndarray.

__Args__

**```emb1```** :&ensp;`Union[MaybeIterable[List[float]], ndarray]`
:   First embedding or collection of embeddings.

**```emb2```** :&ensp;`Union[MaybeIterable[List[float]], ndarray]`
:   Second embedding or collection of embeddings.

__Returns__

`Union[float, ndarray]`
:   Computed score or score matrix between the embeddings.

### DocumentRanker.embed_documents | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L612-L770)

```python
DocumentRanker.embed_documents(
    documents,
    refresh=False,
    refresh_documents=None,
    refresh_embeddings=None,
    return_embeddings=False,
    return_documents=False,
    with_fallback=False
)
```

Embed documents by optionally refreshing stored documents and embeddings.

Without refreshing, persisted objects from the respective stores are used.

__Args__

**```documents```** :&ensp;`Iterable[StoreDocument]`
:   Collection of documents to embed.

**```refresh```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to refresh both documents and embeddings.

**```refresh_documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh documents; defaults to `refresh`.

**```refresh_embeddings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh embeddings; defaults to `refresh`.

**```return_embeddings```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to return embeddings.

**```return_documents```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, include original document objects in the output.

**```with_fallback```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, raise [FallbackError](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.FallbackError "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.FallbackError") if new embeddings are needed.

__Returns__

`Optional[EmbeddedDocuments]`
:   Embedded documents or embeddings based on the specified return flags.

    Returns None if both return flags are False.

### DocumentRanker.rank_documents | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/knowledge/doc_ranking.py#L1412-L1519)

```python
DocumentRanker.rank_documents(
    query,
    documents=None,
    top_k=None,
    min_top_k=None,
    max_top_k=None,
    cutoff=None,
    refresh=False,
    refresh_documents=None,
    refresh_embeddings=None,
    return_chunks=False,
    return_scores=False
)
```

Rank documents based on their relevance to a query.

The method retrieves scored documents using embedding and BM25 strategies (or both in hybrid mode),
fuses and normalizes their scores, and then sorts them to identify the most relevant documents.
Top-k parameters and score cutoff are resolved using [DocumentRanker.resolve_top_k](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.resolve_top_k "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.resolve_top_k") and
[DocumentRanker.top_k_from_cutoff](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/knowledge/doc_ranking/#vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.top_k_from_cutoff "vectorbtpro.knowledge.doc_ranking.DocumentRanker.top_k_from_cutoff").

__Args__

**```query```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Query string to evaluate document relevance.

**```documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[StoreDocument]]`
:   Collection of documents to rank.

    If None, documents from the document store are used.

**```top_k```** :&ensp;`TopKLike`
:   Number or percentage of top documents to return, or a method to determine it.

**```min_top_k```** :&ensp;`TopKLike`
:   Minimum limit for determining top documents.

**```max_top_k```** :&ensp;`TopKLike`
:   Maximum limit for determining top documents.

**```cutoff```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Score threshold to filter documents.

**```refresh```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to refresh both documents and embeddings.

**```refresh_documents```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh documents; defaults to `refresh`.

**```refresh_embeddings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to refresh embeddings; defaults to `refresh`.

**```return_chunks```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return document chunks.

**```return_scores```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to return scored documents with their scores.

__Returns__

`RankedDocuments`
:   Documents ranked by relevance to the query.
