## Portfolio | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L1322-L14099)

```python
Portfolio(
    wrapper,
    order_records,
    *,
    close,
    open=None,
    high=None,
    low=None,
    log_records=None,
    cash_sharing=False,
    init_cash='auto',
    init_position=0.0,
    init_price=nan,
    cash_deposits=0.0,
    cash_deposits_as_input=None,
    cash_earnings=0.0,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,
    call_seq=None,
    in_outputs=None,
    use_in_outputs=None,
    bm_close=None,
    fillna_close=None,
    year_freq=None,
    returns_acc_defaults=None,
    trades_type=None,
    orders_cls=None,
    logs_cls=None,
    trades_cls=None,
    entry_trades_cls=None,
    exit_trades_cls=None,
    positions_cls=None,
    drawdowns_cls=None,
    weights=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for simulating a portfolio and measuring its performance.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio "vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio").

!!! note
    Use class methods with the `from_` prefix to build a portfolio.
    The `__init__` method is reserved for indexing purposes.

!!! note
    This class is immutable. To change any attribute, use [Configured.replace](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured.replace "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.replace").

__Args__

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`ArrayWrapper`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```order_records```** :&ensp;`Union[RecordArray, SimulationOutput]`
:   Structured NumPy array of order records, or
    a [SimulationOutput](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput") object.

    Must adhere to the [order_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.order_dt "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.order_dt") dtype.

**```close```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Last asset price at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```open```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Open price at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```high```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   High price at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```low```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Low price at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```log_records```** :&ensp;`Optional[RecordArray]`
:   Structured NumPy array of log records.

    Must adhere to the [log_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.log_dt "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.log_dt") dtype.

**```cash_sharing```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether cash is shared among assets of the same group.

**```init_cash```** :&ensp;`Union[str, ArrayLike]`
:   Initial capital.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

    Mapped using [InitCashMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.InitCashMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.InitCashMode") if provided as a string.

    !!! note
        When using `InitCashMode.AutoAlign`, initial cash values are synchronized
        across columns/groups after initialization.

**```init_position```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Initial position at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```init_price```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Initial position price at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```cash_deposits```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Cash deposits or withdrawals at the beginning of each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```cash_earnings```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Cash earnings or losses at the end of each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

**```call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Array2d]`
:   Sequence dictating the order in which columns are
    processed per row and group.

**```in_outputs```** :&ensp;`Optional[NamedTuple]`
:   Named tuple containing in-place output objects.

    Provide pre-broadcasted and grouped objects to substitute default [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") attributes.
    See [Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func") for indexing details.

**```use_in_outputs```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Indicates whether to return in-place output objects when accessing properties.

**```bm_close```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Last benchmark asset price at each bar.

    Provided in a format that supports flexible indexing.

**```fillna_close```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to forward-backward fill NaN values in [Portfolio.close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.close "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.close").

    Filling is applied post-simulation to avoid NaNs in asset values.
    See [Portfolio.get_filled_close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_filled_close "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_filled_close").

**```year_freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Year frequency for annualization (e.g., "252 days", "auto").

**```returns_acc_defaults```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Defaults for [ReturnsAccessor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/returns/accessors/#vectorbtpro.returns.accessors.ReturnsAccessor "vectorbtpro.returns.accessors.ReturnsAccessor").

**```trades_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[Union[str, int]]`
:   Default trades type for [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio").

    Mapped using [TradesType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.TradesType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.TradesType") if provided as a string.

**```orders_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping order records.

**```logs_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping log records.

**```trades_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping trade records.

**```entry_trades_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping entry trade records.

**```exit_trades_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping exit trade records.

**```positions_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping position records.

**```drawdowns_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[Type]`
:   Class used for wrapping drawdown records.

**```weights```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, ArrayLike]`
:   Asset weights to apply.

    Applied to initial positions, cash, deposits, earnings, and orders.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Analyzable](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/generic/analyzable/#vectorbtpro.generic.analyzable.Analyzable "vectorbtpro.generic.analyzable.Analyzable").

### Portfolio.apply_weights | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L6929-L6974)

```python
Portfolio.apply_weights(
    weights=None,
    rescale=False,
    group_by=None,
    apply_group_by=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Get view of portfolio with asset weights applied and optionally rescaled.

If `rescale` is True, weights are rescaled relative to other weights in the same group.
For example, weights 0.5 and 0.5 are rescaled to 1.0 and 1.0 respectively, while
weights 0.7 and 0.3 are rescaled to 1.4 and 0.6, respectively.

__Args__

**```weights```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, ArrayLike]`
:   Asset weights to apply.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_weights](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_weights "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_weights") if not provided.

    Passing None or False disables weights.

**```rescale```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, rescale weights relative to other weights in the same group.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```apply_group_by```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to apply grouping based on `group_by`.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Configured.replace](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured.replace "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.replace").

__Returns__

[Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio")
:   Portfolio view with asset weights applied.

### Portfolio.column_stack | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2191-L2435)

```python
Portfolio.column_stack(
    *objs,
    wrapper_kwargs=None,
    group_by=None,
    ffill_close=False,
    fbfill_close=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack multiple [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances along columns.

This function stacks the provided [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") objects along their columns using
[ArrayWrapper.column_stack](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.column_stack "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.column_stack"). All input portfolios must have
the same cash sharing configuration.

Depending on the array dimensions:

* Two-dimensional arrays are merged via [ArrayWrapper.column_stack_arrs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.column_stack_arrs "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.column_stack_arrs").

* One-dimensional arrays are concatenated via [ArrayWrapper.concat_arrs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.concat_arrs "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.concat_arrs").

In-place outputs are merged using [Portfolio.column_stack_in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.column_stack_in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.column_stack_in_outputs") and records are aggregated
using [Records.column_stack_records_arrs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/records/base/#vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.column_stack_records_arrs "vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.column_stack_records_arrs").

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Portfolio]`
:   (Additional) [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances to stack.

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```ffill_close```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, forward-fill missing values in the close prices.

**```fbfill_close```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, forward and backward-fill missing values in the close prices.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") through
    [Wrapping.resolve_column_stack_kwargs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.Wrapping.resolve_column_stack_kwargs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.resolve_column_stack_kwargs") and [Wrapping.resolve_stack_kwargs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.Wrapping.resolve_stack_kwargs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.resolve_stack_kwargs").

__Returns__

[Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio")
:   New [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instance created by stacking the input objects along columns.

### Portfolio.column_stack_in_outputs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2116-L2189)

```python
Portfolio.column_stack_in_outputs(
    *objs,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack [Portfolio.in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs") along columns.

Merge the `in_outputs` from multiple [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances by stacking corresponding fields.
All in-place output tuples must either be None or have identical fields.

If a field is also defined as an attribute of the [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") class, its options are used
to determine the required type and layout by merging results from [Portfolio.parse_field_options](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.parse_field_options "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.parse_field_options")
and [Portfolio.in_output_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_output_config "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_output_config"). Stacking for each field is performed using [Portfolio.column_stack_objs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.column_stack_objs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.column_stack_objs").

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Portfolio]`
:   [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") objects whose `in_outputs` attributes are to be stacked.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio.column_stack_objs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.column_stack_objs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.column_stack_objs").

__Returns__

`Optional[NamedTuple]`
:   New `in_outputs` named tuple with fields stacked along columns, or
    None if all `in_outputs` are None.

### Portfolio.column_stack_objs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2010-L2114)

```python
Portfolio.column_stack_objs(
    objs,
    wrappers,
    grouping='columns_or_groups',
    obj_name=None,
    obj_type=None,
    wrapper=None,
    cash_sharing=False,
    column_stack_func=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack (one- and two-dimensional) objects along columns.

`column_stack_func` must take the portfolio class and all arguments passed to this method.
If not all arguments are needed, define `column_stack_func` to accept them as `**kwargs`.

If all objects are None, boolean, or empty, returns the first object.

__Args__

**```objs```** :&ensp;`Sequence[Any]`
:   Objects to be stacked.

**```wrappers```** :&ensp;`Sequence[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Wrappers corresponding to the objects.

**```grouping```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Grouping strategy.

    Supported options include "columns_or_groups", "columns", "groups", and "cash_sharing".

**```obj_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the object.

**```obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of the object.

    Supported options include "records", "array", and "red_array".

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

**```cash_sharing```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether cash is shared among assets of the same group.

**```column_stack_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Custom function for stacking columns.

    Must accept the portfolio class and all method arguments.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `column_stack_func`.

__Returns__

`Any`
:   Result of stacking the objects along columns.

### Portfolio.from_def_order_func | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L6171-L6477)

```python
Portfolio.from_def_order_func(
    close,
    size=None,
    size_type=None,
    direction=None,
    price=None,
    fees=None,
    fixed_fees=None,
    slippage=None,
    min_size=None,
    max_size=None,
    size_granularity=None,
    cash_limit=None,
    leverage=None,
    leverage_mode=None,
    reject_prob=None,
    price_area_vio_mode=None,
    allow_partial=None,
    raise_reject=None,
    log=None,
    pre_segment_func_nb=None,
    order_func_nb=None,
    flex_order_func_nb=None,
    val_price=None,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,
    call_seq=None,
    flexible=False,
    broadcast_named_args=None,
    broadcast_kwargs=None,
    chunked=None,
    return_preparer=False,
    return_prep_result=False,
    return_sim_out=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Build portfolio using the default order function.

This method constructs a portfolio by applying the default order function, which processes
trading orders based on parameters such as size, price, fees, and other available data. It also
employs a segment preprocessing function that adjusts valuation prices and sorts the call sequence,
behaving similarly to [Portfolio.from_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders") but with enhanced control through pre- and postprocessing.
The method supports argument chunking for efficient processing, although [Portfolio.from_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders") may be
up to 5x faster.

If `flexible` is True:

* `pre_segment_func_nb` is set to [def_flex_pre_segment_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_flex_pre_segment_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_flex_pre_segment_func_nb")

* `flex_order_func_nb` is set to [def_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_flex_order_func_nb")

If `flexible` is False:

* `pre_segment_func_nb` is set to [def_pre_segment_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_pre_segment_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_pre_segment_func_nb")

* `order_func_nb` is set to [def_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_order_func_nb")

Prepared using [FDOFPreparer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FDOFPreparer "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FDOFPreparer").

!!! info
    For default settings, see [portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio "vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio").

    These defaults are not used to fill NaN values after reindexing; vectorbtpro uses its own
    defaults (typically NaN for floating arrays and preset flags for integer arrays).
    Use [BCO](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.BCO "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.BCO") with `fill_value` to override.

!!! tip
    All broadcastable arguments are handled using [broadcast](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast")
    to preserve their original shapes for flexible indexing and memory efficiency.
    Each can be provided per frame, series, row, column, or individual element.

!!! note
    All provided functions must be Numba-compiled if Numba is enabled.
    Also see the notes in [Portfolio.from_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders").

:   Callback function to be called to generate an order.

    Defaults to [def_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_order_func_nb").

**```flex_order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexOrderFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called to generate a flexible order.

    Defaults to [def_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.def_flex_order_func_nb").

**```val_price```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Asset valuation price used in decision making.

    Broadcasts. Can also be provided as [ValPriceType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ValPriceType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ValPriceType").

    * Any `-np.inf` element is replaced by the latest valuation price
        (using `open` or a previously known value if `ffill_val_price` is True).

    * Any `np.inf` element is replaced by the current order price.

    !!! note
        Unlike [Portfolio.from_order_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func"), the order price is effectively predetermined,
        so `val_price` defaults to the current order price when using `np.inf`.
        To use the previous close, set it in the settings to `-np.inf`.

    !!! note
        Ensure that the timestamp associated with `val_price` precedes all order
        timestamps in a cash-sharing group.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

    Can be "auto" to automatically select the first non-NA size value.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

    Can be "auto" to automatically select the first non-NA size value.

**```call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Sequence dictating the order in which columns are
    processed per row and group.

    Each element specifies the position of a column in the processing order.
    Options include:

    * None: Generates a default call sequence.

    * Value from [CallSeqType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.CallSeqType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.CallSeqType"): Creates a full array of the specified type.

    * Custom array: Specifies a user-defined call sequence.

    If set to `CallSeqType.Auto`, orders are rearranged dynamically so that sell orders are
    processed before buy orders.

    !!! warning
        `CallSeqType.Auto` assumes predetermined order prices and flexible execution,
        which may not accurately reflect real-time conditions.
        For stricter control, use [Portfolio.from_order_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func").

**```flexible```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to apply flexible processing.

**```broadcast_named_args```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional named arguments for broadcasting.

    Use templates such as [Rep](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/template/#vectorbtpro.utils.template.Rep "vectorbtpro.utils.template.Rep") to substitute
    callback function arguments with their broadcasted values.

**```broadcast_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for broadcasting.

    See [broadcast](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast").

**```chunked```** :&ensp;`ChunkedOption`
:   Option to control chunked processing.

    See [resolve_chunked_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option").

**```return_preparer```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the preparer instance
    ([FDOFPreparer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FDOFPreparer "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FDOFPreparer")).

    !!! note
        In this case, the seed is not automatically set;
        invoke `preparer.set_seed()` explicitly if needed.

**```return_prep_result```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the preparer result
    ([PFPrepResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.PFPrepResult "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.PFPrepResult")).

**```return_sim_out```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the simulation output
    ([SimulationOutput](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput")).

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio.from_order_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func").

__Returns__

`PortfolioResult`
:   Portfolio result.

__Examples__

Working with [Portfolio.from_def_order_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_def_order_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_def_order_func") is similar to using [Portfolio.from_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders"):

```pycon
>>> close = pd.Series([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_def_order_func(close, 10)

>>> pf.assets
0    10.0
1    20.0
2    30.0
3    40.0
4    40.0
dtype: float64
>>> pf.cash
0    90.0
1    70.0
2    40.0
3     0.0
4     0.0
dtype: float64
```

Equal-weighted portfolio as in the example under [Portfolio.from_order_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_order_func") but
much less verbose and with pre-computed asset values during simulation for enhanced performance:

```pycon
>>> np.random.seed(42)
>>> close = np.random.uniform(1, 10, size=(5, 3))

>>> @njit
... def post_segment_func_nb(c):
...     for col in range(c.from_col, c.to_col):
...         c.in_outputs.asset_value_pc[c.i, col] = c.last_position[col] * c.last_val_price[col]

>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_def_order_func(
...     close,
...     size=1/3,
...     size_type='targetpercent',
...     direction='longonly',
...     fees=0.001,
...     fixed_fees=1.,
...     slippage=0.001,
...     segment_mask=2,
...     cash_sharing=True,
...     group_by=True,
...     call_seq='auto',
...     post_segment_func_nb=post_segment_func_nb,
...     call_post_segment=True,
...     in_outputs=dict(asset_value_pc=vbt.RepEval('np.empty_like(close)'))
... )

>>> asset_value = pf.wrapper.wrap(pf.in_outputs.asset_value_pc, group_by=False)
>>> asset_value.vbt.plot().show()
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_def_order_func.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

### Portfolio.from_holding | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L5100-L5196)

```python
Portfolio.from_holding(
    close,
    direction=None,
    at_first_valid_in='close',
    close_at_end=None,
    dynamic_mode=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Simulate portfolio from plain holding using signals.

If `close_at_end` is True, an opposite signal is placed at the very end.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio "vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio").

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Union[ArrayLike, OHLCDataMixin]`
:   Close prices or OHLC data used for portfolio simulation.

**```direction```** :&ensp;`Union[str, int]`
:   Holding direction.

    Mapped using [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction") if provided as a string.

    If None, the default hold direction from portfolio settings is used.

**```at_first_valid_in```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Column name for determining the first valid entry signal.

**```close_at_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to place an exit signal at the end.

    If None, the default is used.

**```dynamic_mode```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Specifies whether to use dynamic mode for signal generation.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio.from_signals](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_signals "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_signals").

__Returns__

`PortfolioResult`
:   Portfolio result.

### Portfolio.from_optimizer | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L5349-L5487)

```python
Portfolio.from_optimizer(
    close,
    optimizer,
    pf_method='from_orders',
    squeeze_groups=True,
    dropna=None,
    fill_value=nan,
    size_type='targetpercent',
    direction=None,
    cash_sharing=True,
    call_seq='auto',
    group_by=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Build a portfolio from a [PortfolioOptimizer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/pfopt/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.pfopt.base.PortfolioOptimizer "vectorbtpro.portfolio.pfopt.base.PortfolioOptimizer") instance.

If the `direction` parameter is not provided, it is inferred from the allocation values:

* If both positive and negative values exist, set to "both".

* If only positive values exist, set to "longonly".

* If only negative values exist, set to "shortonly" (allocations are converted to absolute values).

The simulation method is selected based on `pf_method`:

* "from_orders": Uses the orders-based simulation ([Portfolio.from_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders")).

* "from_signals": Uses the signals-based simulation ([Portfolio.from_signals](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_signals "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_signals")).

By default, `size_type` is "targetpercent", `cash_sharing` is True, `call_seq` is "auto", and
if `group_by` is None, it defaults to the optimizer's grouper.

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Union[ArrayLike, OHLCDataMixin]`
:   Close prices or OHLC data used for portfolio simulation.

**```optimizer```** :&ensp;`PortfolioOptimizer`
:   Optimizer instance that provides allocation weights.

**```pf_method```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Portfolio simulation method, either "from_orders" or "from_signals".

**```squeeze_groups```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True and the data's grouped ndim is 1,
    group levels are squeezed in the resulting DataFrame.

**```dropna```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Strategy for handling missing allocations, either "all" or "head".

**```fill_value```** :&ensp;`Scalar`
:   Value used to fill missing allocation entries.

**```size_type```** :&ensp;`ArrayLike`
:   Order size type.

**```direction```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Order direction.

    If None, determined automatically from allocations.

**```cash_sharing```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether cash is shared among assets of the same group.

**```call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Sequence dictating the order in which columns are
    processed per row and group; defaults to "auto".

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for the underlying simulation function.

__Returns__

`PortfolioResult`
:   Portfolio result.

__Examples__

```pycon
>>> close = pd.DataFrame({
...     "MSFT": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
...     "GOOG": [5, 4, 3, 2, 1],
...     "AAPL": [1, 2, 3, 2, 1]
... }, index=pd.date_range(start="2020-01-01", periods=5))

>>> pfo = vbt.PortfolioOptimizer.from_random(
...     close.vbt.wrapper,
...     every="2D",
...     seed=42
... )
>>> pfo.fill_allocations()
                  MSFT      GOOG      AAPL
2020-01-01   0.182059  0.462129  0.355812
2020-01-02        NaN       NaN       NaN
2020-01-03   0.657381  0.171323  0.171296
2020-01-04        NaN       NaN       NaN
2020-01-05   0.038078  0.567845  0.394077

>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_optimizer(close, pfo)
>>> pf.get_asset_value(group_by=False).vbt / pf.value
alloc_group                         group
                  MSFT      GOOG      AAPL
2020-01-01   0.182059  0.462129  0.355812  << rebalanced
2020-01-02   0.251907  0.255771  0.492322
2020-01-03   0.657381  0.171323  0.171296  << rebalanced
2020-01-04   0.793277  0.103369  0.103353
2020-01-05   0.038078  0.567845  0.394077  << rebalanced
```

### Portfolio.from_order_func | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L5489-L6169)

```python
Portfolio.from_order_func(
    close,
    *,
    init_cash=None,
    init_position=None,
    init_price=None,
    cash_deposits=None,
    cash_earnings=None,
    cash_sharing=None,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,

    attach_call_seq=None,
    segment_mask=None,

    post_sim_func_nb=None,
    post_sim_args=(),

    pre_group_args=(),

    post_group_args=(),

    records=None,
    return_preparer=False,
    return_prep_result=False,
    return_sim_out=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Build a portfolio using a custom order function.

!!! tip
    See [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb") for illustrations.

Prepared using [FOFPreparer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FOFPreparer "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FOFPreparer").

!!! info
    For default settings, see [portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio "vectorbtpro._settings.portfolio").

    These defaults are not used to fill NaN values after reindexing; vectorbtpro uses its own
    defaults (typically NaN for floating arrays and preset flags for integer arrays).
    Use [BCO](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.BCO "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.BCO") with `fill_value` to override.

!!! tip
    All broadcastable arguments are handled using [broadcast](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast")
    to preserve their original shapes for flexible indexing and memory efficiency.
    Each can be provided per frame, series, row, column, or individual element.

!!! note
    All provided functions must be Numba-compiled if Numba is enabled.
    Also see the notes in [Portfolio.from_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_orders").

!!! note
    Unlike other methods, the valuation price is taken from the previous `close` rather than
    the order price, since an order's price is unknown until execution. You can override
    the valuation price in `pre_segment_func_nb`.

__See__

* [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb") for `order_func_nb`

* [from_order_func_rw_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_rw_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_rw_nb") for `order_func_nb` and `row_wise=True`

* [from_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb") for `flex_order_func_nb`

* [from_flex_order_func_rw_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_rw_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_rw_nb") for `flex_order_func_nb` and `row_wise=True`

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Union[ArrayLike, OHLCDataMixin, FOFPreparer, PFPrepResult]`
:   Close prices or
    OHLC data used for portfolio simulation.

    Broadcasts.

    * If an instance of [OHLCDataMixin](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/data/base/#vectorbtpro.data.base.OHLCDataMixin "vectorbtpro.data.base.OHLCDataMixin"), extracts open, high, low, and close prices.

    * If an instance of [FOFPreparer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FOFPreparer "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FOFPreparer"), it is used as a preparer.

    * If an instance of [PFPrepResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.PFPrepResult "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.PFPrepResult"), it is used as a preparer result.

**```init_cash```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Initial capital.

    Broadcasts to the final number of columns, or to the number of groups if
    cash sharing is enabled. See [InitCashMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.InitCashMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.InitCashMode").

    !!! note
        When using `InitCashMode.AutoAlign`, initial cash values are synchronized across
        columns/groups after initialization.

**```init_position```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Initial position.

    Broadcasts to match the final number of columns.

**```init_price```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Initial position price.

    Broadcasts to match the final number of columns.

**```cash_deposits```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Cash deposits or withdrawals at the beginning of each bar.

    Broadcasts to match the shape of `init_cash`.

**```cash_earnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Cash earnings or losses at the end of each bar.

    Broadcasts.

**```cash_dividends```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Cash dividends or interest at the end of each bar.

    Broadcasts, are multiplied by the position, and then added to `cash_earnings`.

**```cash_sharing```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether cash is shared among assets of the same group.

    If `group_by` is None and this is True, all assets are grouped together for cash sharing.

    !!! warning
        Enables cross-asset dependencies by assuming that all orders in a cash-sharing group
        execute in the same tick and retain their price.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

**```call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Sequence dictating the order in which columns are
    processed per row and group.

    Each element specifies the position of a column in the processing order.
    Options include:

    * None: Generates a default call sequence.

    * Value from [CallSeqType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.CallSeqType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.CallSeqType"): Creates a full array of the specified type.

    * Custom array: Specifies a user-defined call sequence.

    !!! note
        `CallSeqType.Auto` must be implemented manually. Use
        [sort_call_seq_1d_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.sort_call_seq_1d_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.sort_call_seq_1d_nb") or
        [sort_call_seq_out_1d_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.sort_call_seq_out_1d_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.sort_call_seq_out_1d_nb") in `pre_segment_func_nb`.

**```attach_call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Indicates whether to attach the computed call sequence
    to the portfolio instance.

**```segment_mask```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Mask that indicates whether a segment should be executed.

    An integer activates every n-th row, while a boolean or an array of booleans broadcasts
    to the number of rows and groups. It does not broadcast together with `close` and
    `broadcast_named_args`, only against the final shape.

**```call_pre_segment```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to call `pre_segment_func_nb` regardless of `segment_mask`.

**```call_post_segment```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to call `post_segment_func_nb` regardless of `segment_mask`.

**```pre_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PreSimFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called before the simulation.

    Defaults to [no_pre_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb").

**```pre_sim_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_sim_func_nb`.

**```post_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PostSimFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called after the simulation.

    Defaults to [no_post_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb").

**```post_sim_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_sim_func_nb`.

**```pre_group_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PreGroupFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a group.

    Defaults to [no_pre_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb") and
    is used only when `row_wise` is False.

**```pre_group_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_group_func_nb`.

**```post_group_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PostGroupFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a group.

    Defaults to [no_post_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb") and
    is used only when `row_wise` is False.

**```post_group_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_group_func_nb`.

**```pre_row_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PreRowFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a row.

    Defaults to [no_pre_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb") and
    is used only when `row_wise` is True.

**```pre_row_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_row_func_nb`.

**```post_row_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PostRowFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a row.

    Defaults to [no_post_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb") and
    is used only when `row_wise` is True.

**```post_row_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_row_func_nb`.

**```pre_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PreSegmentFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a segment.

    Defaults to [no_pre_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_pre_func_nb").

**```pre_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_segment_func_nb`.

**```post_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PostSegmentFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a segment.

    Defaults to [no_post_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb").

**```post_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_segment_func_nb`.

**```order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[OrderFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called to generate an order.

    Defaults to [no_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_order_func_nb").

**```order_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `order_func_nb`.

**```flex_order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexOrderFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called to generate a flexible order.

    Defaults to [no_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_flex_order_func_nb").

**```flex_order_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `flex_order_func_nb`.

**```post_order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`Optional[PostOrderFunc]`
:   Callback function to be called after processing an order.

    Defaults to [no_post_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.no_post_func_nb").

**```post_order_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_order_func_nb`.

**```open```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Open prices.

    Broadcasts. Used as a price boundary (see [PriceArea](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea")).

    For stop signals, `np.nan` is replaced with the corresponding close price.

**```high```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   High prices.

    Broadcasts. Used as a price boundary (see [PriceArea](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea")).

    For stop signals, `np.nan` is replaced with the maximum of open and close prices.

**```low```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Low prices.

    Broadcasts. Used as a price boundary (see [PriceArea](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea")).

    For stop signals, `np.nan` is replaced with the minimum of open and close prices.

**```ffill_val_price```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, tracks the valuation price only when available
    to prevent propagation of NaN values.

**```update_value```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   If True, updates the group value after each filled order.

**```fill_pos_info```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to fill the position information record.

    Disabling this may speed up simulation for simple cases.

**```track_value```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to track metrics such as current valuation price, value, and return.

    Disable to improve simulation speed in simple cases.

**```row_wise```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to iterate over rows instead of by columns/groups.

**```max_order_records```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of order records expected per column.

    Defaults to the number of rows in the broadcasted shape. Set to 0 to disable,
    lower to reduce memory usage, or higher if multiple orders per timestamp are expected.

**```max_log_records```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of log records expected per column.

    Set to the number of rows in the broadcasted shape if logging is enabled. Set lower to
    reduce memory usage, or higher if multiple logs per timestamp are expected.

**```in_outputs```** :&ensp;`Optional[tp.MappingLike]`
:   Mapping of in-place output objects available via
    [Portfolio.in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs") as a named tuple.

    To override [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") attributes, provide objects that are already broadcasted and grouped
    (e.g. using `broadcast_named_args` and templates). Also see [Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func")
    for indexing details. When chunking, supply the chunk specification and merging function as per
    [merge_sim_outs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/chunking/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.chunking.merge_sim_outs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.chunking.merge_sim_outs").

    !!! note
        For Numba versions below 0.54, `in_outputs` must be a globally defined named tuple
        rather than a mapping.

**```seed```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Random seed for deterministic output.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```broadcast_named_args```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional named arguments for broadcasting.

    Use templates such as [Rep](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/template/#vectorbtpro.utils.template.Rep "vectorbtpro.utils.template.Rep") to substitute
    callback function arguments with their broadcasted values.

**```broadcast_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for broadcasting.

    See [broadcast](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast").

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

    !!! note
        Disabling jitting affects only the main simulation function.
        To disable compilation entirely, ensure that all functions are uncompiled
        (e.g. via the `py_func` attribute or by setting `os.environ['NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT'] = '1'`
        before importing vectorbtpro).

    !!! warning
        Parallelization assumes that groups are independent with no data flow between them.

**```chunked```** :&ensp;`ChunkedOption`
:   Option to control chunked processing.

    See [resolve_chunked_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option").

**```staticized```** :&ensp;`StaticizedOption`
:   Keyword arguments or a task id for staticizing.

    If True or a dict, these are passed to [cut_and_save_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/source/#vectorbtpro.utils.source.cut_and_save_func "vectorbtpro.utils.source.cut_and_save_func")
    to cache the simulator. If a hashable or callable, it is used as a task id for an already
    registered simulator. The dict may include options like `override` and `reload`.

**```bm_close```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Benchmark asset price at each bar.

    Broadcasts. If not provided, `close` is used; if set to False, benchmarking is disabled.

**```records```** :&ensp;`Optional[RecordsLike]`
:   Records used to construct arrays.

    See [IdxRecords](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/indexing/#vectorbtpro.base.indexing.IdxRecords "vectorbtpro.base.indexing.IdxRecords").

**```return_preparer```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the preparer instance
    ([FOFPreparer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FOFPreparer "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.FOFPreparer")).

    !!! note
        In this case, the seed is not automatically set;
        invoke `preparer.set_seed()` explicitly if needed.

**```return_prep_result```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the preparer result
    ([PFPrepResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/preparing/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.PFPrepResult "vectorbtpro.portfolio.preparing.PFPrepResult")).

**```return_sim_out```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, returns the simulation output
    ([SimulationOutput](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput")).

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio").

__Returns__

`PortfolioResult`
:   Portfolio result.

__Examples__

Buy 10 units each tick using close price:

```pycon
>>> @njit
... def order_func_nb(c, size):
...     return vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(size=size)

>>> close = pd.Series([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_order_func(
...     close,
...     order_func_nb=order_func_nb,
...     order_args=(10,)
... )

>>> pf.assets
0    10.0
1    20.0
2    30.0
3    40.0
4    40.0
dtype: float64
>>> pf.cash
0    90.0
1    70.0
2    40.0
3     0.0
4     0.0
dtype: float64
```

Reverse each position by first closing it. Use a stateful function to alternate positions:

```pycon
>>> @njit
... def pre_group_func_nb(c):
...     last_pos_state = np.array([-1])
...     return (last_pos_state,)

>>> @njit
... def order_func_nb(c, last_pos_state):
...     if c.position_now != 0:
...         return vbt.pf_nb.close_position_nb()
...
...     if last_pos_state[0] == 1:
...         size = -np.inf  # open short
...         last_pos_state[0] = -1
...     else:
...         size = np.inf  # open long
...         last_pos_state[0] = 1
...     return vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(size=size)

>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_order_func(
...     close,
...     order_func_nb=order_func_nb,
...     pre_group_func_nb=pre_group_func_nb
... )

>>> pf.assets
0    100.000000
1      0.000000
2    -66.666667
3      0.000000
4     26.666667
dtype: float64
>>> pf.cash
0      0.000000
1    200.000000
2    400.000000
3    133.333333
4      0.000000
dtype: float64
```

Equal-weighted portfolio as in the example under
[from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb"):

```pycon
>>> @njit
... def pre_group_func_nb(c):
...     order_value_out = np.empty(c.group_len, dtype=float_)
...     return (order_value_out,)

>>> @njit
... def pre_segment_func_nb(c, order_value_out, size, price, size_type, direction):
...     for col in range(c.from_col, c.to_col):
...         c.last_val_price[col] = vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, price)
...     vbt.pf_nb.sort_call_seq_nb(c, size, size_type, direction, order_value_out)
...     return ()

>>> @njit
... def order_func_nb(c, size, price, size_type, direction, fees, fixed_fees, slippage):
...     return vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(
...         size=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, size),
...         price=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, price),
...         size_type=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, size_type),
...         direction=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, direction),
...         fees=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, fees),
...         fixed_fees=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, fixed_fees),
...         slippage=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, slippage)
...     )

>>> np.random.seed(42)
>>> close = np.random.uniform(1, 10, size=(5, 3))
>>> size_template = vbt.RepEval('np.array([[1 / group_lens[0]]])')

>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_order_func(
...     close,
...     order_func_nb=order_func_nb,
...     order_args=(
...         size_template,
...         vbt.Rep('price'),
...         vbt.Rep('size_type'),
...         vbt.Rep('direction'),
...         vbt.Rep('fees'),
...         vbt.Rep('fixed_fees'),
...         vbt.Rep('slippage'),
...     ),
...     segment_mask=2,  # rebalance every second tick
...     pre_group_func_nb=pre_group_func_nb,
...     pre_segment_func_nb=pre_segment_func_nb,
...     pre_segment_args=(
...         size_template,
...         vbt.Rep('price'),
...         vbt.Rep('size_type'),
...         vbt.Rep('direction')
...     ),
...     broadcast_named_args=dict(  # broadcast against each other
...         price=close,
...         size_type=vbt.pf_enums.SizeType.TargetPercent,
...         direction=vbt.pf_enums.Direction.LongOnly,
...         fees=0.001,
...         fixed_fees=1.,
...         slippage=0.001
...     ),
...     template_context=dict(np=np),  # required by size_template
...     cash_sharing=True, group_by=True,  # one group with cash sharing
... )

>>> pf.get_asset_value(group_by=False).vbt.plot().show()
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func.light.svg#only-light){: .iimg loading=lazy }
![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

Templates are a powerful tool to prepare custom arguments after broadcasting and before passing
them to simulation functions. In the above example, `broadcast_named_args` broadcasts arguments
and templates pass them to callbacks. An evaluation template is used to compute position size
based on the number of assets in each group.

You may ask: why should we bother using broadcasting and templates if we could just pass `size=1/3`?
Because of flexibility those features provide: we can now pass whatever parameter combinations we want
and it will work flawlessly. For example, to create two groups of equally-allocated positions,
we need to change only two parameters:

```pycon
>>> close = np.random.uniform(1, 10, size=(5, 6))  # 6 columns instead of 3
>>> group_by = ['g1', 'g1', 'g1', 'g2', 'g2', 'g2']  # 2 groups instead of 1
>>> # Replace close and group_by in the example above

>>> pf['g1'].get_asset_value(group_by=False).vbt.plot().show()
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_g1.light.svg#only-light){: .iimg loading=lazy }
![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_g1.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

```pycon
>>> pf['g2'].get_asset_value(group_by=False).vbt.plot().show()
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_g2.light.svg#only-light){: .iimg loading=lazy }
![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_g2.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

Combine multiple exit conditions. Exit early if the price exceeds a threshold before an actual exit:

```pycon
>>> @njit
... def pre_sim_func_nb(c):
...     # We need to define stop price per column once
...     stop_price = np.full(c.target_shape[1], np.nan, dtype=float_)
...     return (stop_price,)

>>> @njit
... def order_func_nb(c, stop_price, entries, exits, size):
...     # Select info related to this order
...     entry_now = vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, entries)
...     exit_now = vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, exits)
...     size_now = vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, size)
...     price_now = vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, c.close)
...     stop_price_now = stop_price[c.col]
...
...     # Our logic
...     if entry_now:
...         if c.position_now == 0:
...             return vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(
...                 size=size_now,
...                 price=price_now,
...                 direction=vbt.pf_enums.Direction.LongOnly)
...     elif exit_now or price_now >= stop_price_now:
...         if c.position_now > 0:
...             return vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(
...                 size=-size_now,
...                 price=price_now,
...                 direction=vbt.pf_enums.Direction.LongOnly)
...     return vbt.pf_enums.NoOrder

>>> @njit
... def post_order_func_nb(c, stop_price, stop):
...     # Same broadcasting as for size
...     stop_now = vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, stop)
...
...     if c.order_result.status == vbt.pf_enums.OrderStatus.Filled:
...         if c.order_result.side == vbt.pf_enums.OrderSide.Buy:
...             # Position entered: Set stop condition
...             stop_price[c.col] = (1 + stop_now) * c.order_result.price
...         else:
...             # Position exited: Remove stop condition
...             stop_price[c.col] = np.nan

>>> def simulate(close, entries, exits, size, stop):
...     return vbt.Portfolio.from_order_func(
...         close,
...         order_func_nb=order_func_nb,
...         order_args=(vbt.Rep('entries'), vbt.Rep('exits'), vbt.Rep('size')),
...         pre_sim_func_nb=pre_sim_func_nb,
...         post_order_func_nb=post_order_func_nb,
...         post_order_args=(vbt.Rep('stop'),),
...         broadcast_named_args=dict(  # broadcast against each other
...             entries=entries,
...             exits=exits,
...             size=size,
...             stop=stop
...         )
...     )

>>> close = pd.Series([10, 11, 12, 13, 14])
>>> entries = pd.Series([True, True, False, False, False])
>>> exits = pd.Series([False, False, False, True, True])
>>> simulate(close, entries, exits, np.inf, 0.1).asset_flow
0    10.0
1     0.0
2   -10.0
3     0.0
4     0.0
dtype: float64

>>> simulate(close, entries, exits, np.inf, 0.2).asset_flow
0    10.0
1     0.0
2   -10.0
3     0.0
4     0.0
dtype: float64

>>> simulate(close, entries, exits, np.inf, np.nan).asset_flow
0    10.0
1     0.0
2     0.0
3   -10.0
4     0.0
dtype: float64
```
The stop of 10% does not trigger an order at the second bar because it occurs simultaneously
with entry; it must wait until no entry is present. To exit regardless of an entry, replace "elif"
with "if" (similar to using `ConflictMode.Opposite` in [Portfolio.from_signals](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_signals "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.from_signals")).

Multiple parameter combinations can be tested at once via broadcasting using
[broadcast](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.broadcast"):

```pycon
>>> stop = pd.DataFrame([[0.1, 0.2, np.nan]])
>>> simulate(close, entries, exits, np.inf, stop).asset_flow
      0     1     2
0  10.0  10.0  10.0
1   0.0   0.0   0.0
2 -10.0 -10.0   0.0
3   0.0   0.0 -10.0
4   0.0   0.0   0.0
```

Or use a Cartesian product:

```pycon
>>> stop = vbt.Param([0.1, 0.2, np.nan])
>>> simulate(close, entries, exits, np.inf, stop).asset_flow
threshold   0.1   0.2   NaN
0          10.0  10.0  10.0
1           0.0   0.0   0.0
2         -10.0 -10.0   0.0
3           0.0   0.0 -10.0
4           0.0   0.0   0.0
```

This works because `pd.Index` automatically translates into [BCO](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/reshaping/#vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.BCO "vectorbtpro.base.reshaping.BCO")
with `product` set to True.

Let's illustrate how to generate multiple orders per symbol and bar.
For each bar, buy at open and sell at close:

```pycon
>>> @njit
... def flex_order_func_nb(c, size):
...     if c.call_idx == 0:
...         return c.from_col, vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(size=size, price=c.open[c.i, c.from_col])
...     if c.call_idx == 1:
...         return c.from_col, vbt.pf_nb.close_position_nb(price=c.close[c.i, c.from_col])
...     return -1, vbt.pf_enums.NoOrder

>>> open = pd.DataFrame({'a': [1, 2, 3], 'b': [4, 5, 6]})
>>> close = pd.DataFrame({'a': [2, 3, 4], 'b': [3, 4, 5]})
>>> size = 1
>>> pf = vbt.Portfolio.from_order_func(
...     close,
...     flex_order_func_nb=flex_order_func_nb,
...     flex_order_args=(size,),
...     open=open,
...     max_order_records=close.shape[0] * 2
... )

>>> pf.orders.readable
    Order Id Column  Timestamp  Size  Price  Fees  Side
0          0      a          0   1.0    1.0   0.0   Buy
1          1      a          0   1.0    2.0   0.0  Sell
2          2      a          1   1.0    2.0   0.0   Buy
3          3      a          1   1.0    3.0   0.0  Sell
4          4      a          2   1.0    3.0   0.0   Buy
5          5      a          2   1.0    4.0   0.0  Sell
6          0      b          0   1.0    4.0   0.0   Buy
7          1      b          0   1.0    3.0   0.0  Sell
8          2      b          1   1.0    5.0   0.0   Buy
9          3      b          1   1.0    4.0   0.0  Sell
10         4      b          2   1.0    6.0   0.0   Buy
11         5      b          2   1.0    5.0   0.0  Sell
```

!!! warning
    Each bar is treated as a black box—price movements within a bar are unknown.
    Since order processing must mirror real-world conditions, only the opening and
    close prices remain reliably ordered.
