
Get market value series per column or group.

Computes the market value based on close prices, initial portfolio value, and cash deposits.
When grouping is applied, the initial cash is evenly distributed among the assets in the group.

!!! note
    Does not account for fees and slippage. For accurate results, create a separate portfolio.

__See__

* [market_value_grouped_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/analysis/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.analysis.market_value_grouped_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.analysis.market_value_grouped_nb") if grouping is enabled.

* [market_value_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/analysis/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.analysis.market_value_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.analysis.market_value_nb") if grouping is disabled.

__Args__

**```close```** :&ensp;`Optional[SeriesFrame]`
:   Price data used for market value computation.

    If not provided, uses [Portfolio.filled_close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.filled_close "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.filled_close") if available; otherwise, uses [Portfolio.close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.close "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.close").

**```init_value```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeSeries]`
:   Initial portfolio value.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_init_value](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_init_value "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_init_value") with `group_by=False` if not provided.

**```cash_deposits```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Cash deposits or withdrawals at the beginning of each bar.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_cash_deposits](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_cash_deposits "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_cash_deposits") with `split_shared=True`, `keep_flex=True`,
    and `group_by=False` or 0 if not provided.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

**```rec_sim_range```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to apply the simulation range recursively.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

**```chunked```** :&ensp;`ChunkedOption`
:   Option to control chunked processing.

    See [resolve_chunked_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option").

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

### Portfolio.get_signals | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L7781-L7895)

Return signals for long and short entries and exits.

Compute boolean signals indicating the occurrence of long entry orders, long exit orders,
short entry orders, and short exit orders. Signals are computed per group if grouping is enabled.
Pass `group_by=False` to disable grouping.

__Args__

**```orders```** :&ensp;`Optional[Orders]`
:   Instance containing order records.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_orders") if not provided.

**```entry_trades```** :&ensp;`Optional[EntryTrades]`
:   Instance containing entry trade records.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_entry_trades](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_entry_trades "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_entry_trades") if not provided.

**```exit_trades```** :&ensp;`Optional[ExitTrades]`
:   Instance containing exit trade records.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_exit_trades](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_exit_trades "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_exit_trades") if not provided.

**```idx_arr```** :&ensp;`Union[None, str, Array1d]`
:   Array of row indices or field name for retrieving row indices.

    If a string, it is used with [Records.map_field](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/records/base/#vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.map_field "vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.map_field");
    otherwise, with [Records.map_array](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/records/base/#vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.map_array "vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.map_array").

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

**```rec_sim_range```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to apply the simulation range recursively.

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

__Returns__

`Tuple[SeriesFrame, SeriesFrame, SeriesFrame, SeriesFrame]`
:       Signals for long entries, long exits, short entries, and short exits.

Get total cash deposit series per column or group.

Aggregates cash deposit data across columns or groups by summing the individual cash deposits.

__Args__

**```cash_deposits_raw```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Raw cash deposit values.

    Defaults to `Portfolio._cash_deposits` if not provided.

:   Flag indicating whether cash is shared among assets of the same group.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.cash_sharing](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.cash_sharing "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.cash_sharing") if not provided.

**```split_shared```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to split shared cash equally among columns in a group.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

**```rec_sim_range```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to apply the simulation range recursively.

**```weights```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, ArrayLike]`
:   Asset weights to apply.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_weights](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_weights "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_weights") if not provided.

    If False, weights are ignored.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

**```chunked```** :&ensp;`ChunkedOption`
:   Option to control chunked processing.

    See [resolve_chunked_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option").

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

### Portfolio.get_trade_history | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L7666-L7779)

Return a readable DataFrame merging order history with entry and exit trade records.

!!! note
    The P&L and return aggregated across the DataFrame may not match the actual total
    P&L and return, as the DataFrame annotates entry and exit orders with performance
    relative to their respective trade types. For accurate total statistics, aggregate
    only statistics of a single trade type. Additionally, entry orders include open
    statistics, whereas exit orders do not.

__Args__

**```orders```** :&ensp;`Optional[Orders]`
:   Instance containing order records.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_orders](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_orders "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_orders") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

### Portfolio.get_value | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L9763-L9856)

Get portfolio value series per column or group.

Calculates the portfolio value series for each asset or group based on the provided
cash flows and asset values. By default, each asset's portfolio value is computed
independently with the initial cash balance and positions representing the entire group.
This functionality is useful for generating returns and comparing assets within the same group.

__See__

[value_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/analysis/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.analysis.value_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.analysis.value_nb")

__Args__

**```cash```** :&ensp;`Optional[SeriesFrame]`
:   Cash balance data.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_cash](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_cash "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_cash") if not provided.

**```asset_value```** :&ensp;`Optional[SeriesFrame]`
:   Asset value series for computation.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_asset_value](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_asset_value "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_asset_value") if not provided.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   Start index of the simulation range.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

**```rec_sim_range```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to apply the simulation range recursively.

**```jitted```** :&ensp;`JittedOption`
:   Option to control JIT compilation.

    See [resolve_jitted_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/jitting/#vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option "vectorbtpro.utils.jitting.resolve_jitted_option").

**```chunked```** :&ensp;`ChunkedOption`
:   Option to control chunked processing.

    See [resolve_chunked_option](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.resolve_chunked_option").

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`

:   Computed portfolio value series.

### Portfolio.in_outputs_indexing_func | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L3015-L3067)

Perform indexing on [Portfolio.in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs").

Processes each field in [Portfolio.in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs") by determining the field's configuration
from attribute options, parsed field options via [Portfolio.parse_field_options](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.parse_field_options "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.parse_field_options"), and
the indexing configuration in [Portfolio.in_output_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_output_config "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_output_config"). Each field is then indexed
using the [Portfolio.index_obj](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.index_obj "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.index_obj") method.

### Portfolio.index_obj | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2853-L3013)

```python
Portfolio.index_obj(
    obj,
    wrapper_meta,
    obj_name=None,
    grouping='columns_or_groups',
    obj_type=None,
    wrapper=None,
    group_by=None,
    indexing_func=None,
    force_indexing=False,
    silence_warnings=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Perform indexing on an object.

Indexes an object based on the provided metadata, type, and grouping parameters.
If the object is None, a boolean, or an empty array, it is returned as-is.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   Object to index.

**```wrapper_meta```** :&ensp;`dict`
:   Metadata from the indexing operation on the wrapper.

**```obj_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the object.

**```grouping```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Grouping strategy.

    Supported options include "columns_or_groups", "columns", "groups", and "cash_sharing".

**```obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of the object.

    Supported options include "records", "array", and "red_array".

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```indexing_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Custom indexing function that must accept [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio"),
    the object, wrapper_meta, and the remaining arguments, including `**kwargs`.

    If unused, leave as None.

**```force_indexing```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if indexing should be forced,
    raising an error if it cannot be applied.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `indexing_func`.

__Returns__

`Any`
:   Resulting indexed object.

### Portfolio.matches_field_options | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2522-L2585)

```python
Portfolio.matches_field_options(
    options,
    obj_type=None,
    group_by_aware=True,
    wrapper=None,
    group_by=None
)
```

Determine if a field's options meet the required criteria.

This method checks whether the field's parsed options match the expected object type
and grouping configuration. The evaluation also considers the portfolio's current grouping
state and cash sharing setting. If an option is absent from the provided options, it is assumed
to satisfy the requirement.

__Args__

**```options```** :&ensp;`Kwargs`
:   Dictionary of parsed field options.

**```obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of the object.

    Supported options include "records", "array", and "red_array".

**```group_by_aware```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to account for grouping awareness.

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

__Returns__

`bool`
:   True if the field options satisfy the requirements; otherwise, False.

__Args__

**```__pdoc__```** :&ensp;`dict`
:   Dictionary mapping objects to their documentation strings.

**```source_cls```** :&ensp;`Optional[type]`
:   Source class providing the original configuration.

    If None, [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") is used.

__Returns__

None

### Portfolio.parse_field_options | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2469-L2520)

```python
Portfolio.parse_field_options(
    field
)
```

Parse options from a field name.

Extracts suffixes from the field name to determine the grouping and object type,
and returns a cleaned field name.

Suffixes for grouping:

* `_cs`: per group if cash sharing is enabled, otherwise per column.

* `_pcg`: per group if grouped, otherwise per column.

* `_pg`: per group.

* `_pc`: per column.

* `_records`: records.

Suffixes for object type:

* `_2d`: element per timestamp and column or group (time series).

* `_1d`: element per column or group (reduced time series).

__Args__

**```field```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Field identifier.

__Returns__

`Kwargs`
:   Dictionary with the following keys:

    * `obj_type`: Detected object type if applicable.

    * `grouping`: Detected grouping option if applicable.

    * `field`: Cleaned field name.

Pre-process an attribute before resolution.

Apply modifications based on the provided keyword arguments. Specifically, if `use_asset_returns`
is set in `final_kwargs` and the attribute is "returns", it is changed to "asset_returns".

### Portfolio.resample | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L3386-L3502)

```python
Portfolio.resample(
    *args,
    ffill_close=False,
    fbfill_close=False,
    in_output_kwargs=None,
    wrapper_meta=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Resample the [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instance.

Resamples various portfolio components including price series, order and log records,
cash deposits, cash earnings, benchmark data, and in-place outputs. Downsampling is performed
using methods provided by the portfolio's wrapper, with optional forward-fill or backward-fill
applied to the close prices.

!!! warning
    Downsampling is associated with information loss:

    * Cash deposits and earnings are assumed to be added/removed at the beginning of each bar.
        Imagine depositing $100 and using them up in the same bar, and then depositing another $100
        and using them up. Downsampling both bars into a single bar will aggregate cash deposits
        and earnings, and assign both to the beginning of the new bar, even though the second
        deposit was made later.

    * Market/benchmark returns are computed by applying the initial close price of the first bar
        and tracking the price change to simulate holding. Moving the close price of the first bar
        further into the future will affect this computation and likely produce different market
        values and returns. To mitigate this, ensure that the downsampled index's first bar contains
        only the first bar from the original timeframe.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for [ArrayWrapper.resample_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta").

**```ffill_close```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, forward-fill missing values in the close prices.

**```fbfill_close```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, forward and backward-fill missing values in the close prices.

**```in_output_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for resampling in-place outputs.

    See [Portfolio.resample_in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.resample_in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.resample_in_outputs").

**```wrapper_meta```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Metadata from the resampling operation on the wrapper.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ArrayWrapper.resample_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.resample_meta").

__Returns__

[Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio")
:   New resampled [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instance.

__Overridden methods__

If `resample_func` is a string, it is used as `reduce_func_nb` in

If the object is None, a boolean, or an empty array, it is returned unchanged.

    or a Pandas resampler.

:   Name of the object for reference.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```resample_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`

This method computes a range of return statistics from the portfolio's returns, with additional
keyword arguments forwarded to the corresponding stats method of the returns accessor.

Based on [Portfolio.get_returns_acc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_returns_acc "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_returns_acc").

__Args__

:   Return Series or DataFrame.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_returns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_returns "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_returns") or [Portfolio.get_asset_returns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_asset_returns "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_asset_returns") if not provided.

**```use_asset_returns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to use asset returns instead of portfolio returns.

:   Benchmark returns or a flag to resolve benchmark returns.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.get_bm_returns](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_bm_returns "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.get_bm_returns") if not provided.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayLike]`
:   End index of the simulation range.

    Passed inside `settings`.

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Frequency of the index (e.g., "daily", "15 min", "index_mean").

    Defaults to [ArrayWrapper.freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.freq "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.freq") if not provided.

    Merges with [Portfolio.returns_acc_defaults](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.returns_acc_defaults "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.returns_acc_defaults").

**```chunked```** :&ensp;`ChunkedOption`
:   Option to control chunked processing.

### Portfolio.row_stack | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L1741-L2008)

```python
Portfolio.row_stack(
    *objs,
    wrapper_kwargs=None,
    group_by=None,
    combine_init_cash=False,
    combine_init_position=False,
    combine_init_price=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack multiple [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances along rows.

Stacks multiple [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances by merging their underlying data arrays along rows.
This method leverages [ArrayWrapper.row_stack](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.row_stack "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.row_stack") to combine wrappers
and applies specialized stacking functions for two-dimensional arrays such as close prices,
benchmark close, cash deposits, cash earnings, and call sequences. Records are merged using
[Records.row_stack_records_arrs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/records/base/#vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.row_stack_records_arrs "vectorbtpro.records.base.Records.row_stack_records_arrs").

If an object's initial cash is specified as one of the options in [InitCashMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.InitCashMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.InitCashMode"),
it is retained in the final portfolio. When an object defines its initial cash as an absolute amount
or an array, the first object's value is used by default, and subsequent non-zero values are treated
as cash deposits. Set `combine_init_cash` to True to sum all initial cash arrays.

The initial position is copied from the first object if it is the only one with a positive value;
otherwise, stacking is disallowed unless `combine_init_position` is True, which will sum the positions.
For initial price, stacking occurs only if non-NaN values are found across objects; otherwise,
the first object's initial price is used. When `combine_init_price` is enabled, a weighted average
is computed based on the initial positions.

!!! note
    When possible, avoid including initial position and price in portfolios to be stacked,
    as their stacking order might not correctly reflect the simulation chronology and could
    lead to inaccurate results.

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Portfolio]`
:   (Additional) [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances to stack.

**```wrapper_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the wrapper.

    See [ArrayWrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper").

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```combine_init_cash```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, sums all initial cash arrays instead of using
    the first object's value.

**```combine_init_position```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, sums initial position arrays when
    multiple objects have non-zero positions.

**```combine_init_price```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, combines initial price arrays using
    a weighted average when stacking.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") through
    [Wrapping.resolve_row_stack_kwargs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.Wrapping.resolve_row_stack_kwargs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.resolve_row_stack_kwargs") and [Wrapping.resolve_stack_kwargs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.Wrapping.resolve_stack_kwargs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.resolve_stack_kwargs").

__Returns__

[Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio")
:   New [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instance resulting from stacking the input objects along rows.

### Portfolio.row_stack_in_outputs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L1667-L1739)

```python
Portfolio.row_stack_in_outputs(

)
```

Stack [Portfolio.in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_outputs") fields along rows.

This method stacks the `in_outputs` named tuples from multiple [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") instances row-wise.
All `in_outputs` must either be None or contain identical fields. For each field, stacking options
are determined by merging options from [Portfolio.parse_field_options](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.parse_field_options "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.parse_field_options") and
[Portfolio.in_output_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_output_config "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.in_output_config"). The stacking is then performed on each field using
[Portfolio.row_stack_objs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.row_stack_objs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.row_stack_objs").

__Args__

**```*objs```** :&ensp;`MaybeSequence[Portfolio]`
:   [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio") objects whose `in_outputs` attributes are to be stacked.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Portfolio.row_stack_objs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.row_stack_objs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.row_stack_objs").

__Returns__

`Optional[NamedTuple]`
:   New named tuple with each field stacked row-wise, or
    None if all `in_outputs` are None.

### Portfolio.row_stack_objs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L1576-L1665)

```python
Portfolio.row_stack_objs(
    objs,
    wrappers,
    grouping='columns_or_groups',
    obj_name=None,
    obj_type=None,
    wrapper=None,
    cash_sharing=False,
    row_stack_func=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Stack two-dimensional objects along rows.

This method stacks objects row-wise using either a custom stacking function or an internal
logic based on grouping and object type. If all objects are None, boolean, or empty arrays,
the first object is returned.

__Args__

**```objs```** :&ensp;`Sequence[Any]`
:   Objects to be stacked.

**```wrappers```** :&ensp;`Sequence[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Wrappers corresponding to the objects.

**```grouping```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Grouping strategy.

    Supported options include "columns_or_groups", "columns", "groups", and "cash_sharing".

**```obj_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the object.

**```obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of the object.

    Supported options include "records", "array", and "red_array".

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

**```cash_sharing```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether cash is shared among assets of the same group.

**```row_stack_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Custom function for row stacking that must accept the
    portfolio class and all provided arguments.

    If unused, it should accept additional arguments via `**kwargs`.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `row_stack_func`.

__Returns__

`Any`
:   Stacked result, or the first object if all inputs are None, boolean, or empty.

```python
        yaxis_kwargs=dict(
            title='Exposure'
        ),
        plot_func='plot_net_exposure',
        pass_add_trace_kwargs=True,
        tags=[
            'portfolio',
            'exposure'
        ]
    ),
    allocations=dict(
        title='Allocations',
        yaxis_kwargs=dict(
            title='Allocation'
        ),
        plot_func='plot_allocations',
        pass_add_trace_kwargs=True,
        tags=[
            'portfolio',
            'allocations'
        ]
    )
)
```

This property returns a hybrid copy of `Portfolio._subplots` created at instance initialization,
ensuring that modifications do not affect the class-level configuration.

To modify the subplots, update the configuration in-place, override this property, or assign a new value
to `Portfolio._subplots` on the instance.

__Returns__

`Config`
:   Hybrid copy of the subplots configuration.

### Portfolio.wrap_obj | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/base.py#L2587-L2749)

```python
Portfolio.wrap_obj(
    obj,
    obj_name=None,
    grouping='columns_or_groups',
    obj_type=None,
    wrapper=None,
    group_by=None,
    wrap_func=None,
    wrap_kwargs=None,
    force_wrapping=False,
    silence_warnings=False,
    **kwargs
)
```

Wrap an object.

Wraps the provided object according to the specified object type, grouping strategy,
and wrapping function. If `wrap_func` is provided, it is called with the portfolio ([Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio")),
the object, and all other arguments. If the object is None or a boolean, it is returned unchanged.

!!! note
    The wrapping process considers the object type, its dimensionality, and
    the specified grouping or cash sharing settings.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   Object to be wrapped.

**```obj_name```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Name of the object.

**```grouping```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Grouping strategy.

    Supported options include "columns_or_groups", "columns", "groups", and "cash_sharing".

**```obj_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Type of the object.

    Supported options include "records", "array", and "red_array".

**```wrapper```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArrayWrapper]`
:   Array wrapper instance.

    Defaults to [Portfolio.wrapper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.HasWrapper.wrapper "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio.wrapper") if not provided.

**```group_by```** :&ensp;`GroupByLike`
:   Grouping specification.

    See [Grouper](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/grouping/base/#vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper "vectorbtpro.base.grouping.base.Grouper").

**```wrap_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Custom wrapping function that takes the portfolio,
    object, and additional parameters.

**```wrap_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for wrapping the result.

    See [ArrayWrapper.wrap](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.wrap "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.wrap") and
    [ArrayWrapper.wrap_reduced](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/wrapping/#vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.wrap_reduced "vectorbtpro.base.wrapping.ArrayWrapper.wrap_reduced").

**```force_wrapping```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, forces wrapping and raises an error when wrapping is not feasible.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `wrap_func`.

__Returns__

`Any`
:   Wrapped object, or the original object if no wrapping is applied.

## in_outputs_merge_func | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/chunking.py#L61-L103)

```python
in_outputs_merge_func(
    results,
    chunk_meta,
    ann_args,
    mapper
)
```

Merge chunks of in-place output objects.

Concatenates 1-dimensional arrays, stacks columns of 2-dimensional arrays, and
merges record arrays using [merge_records](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/records/chunking/#vectorbtpro.records.chunking.merge_records "vectorbtpro.records.chunking.merge_records").
Other object types will raise an error.

__Args__

**```results```** :&ensp;`List[SimulationOutput]`
:   List of simulation output chunks.

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Iterable[ChunkMeta]`
:   Iterable containing metadata for each chunk.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```ann_args```** :&ensp;`AnnArgs`
:   Annotated arguments.

    See [annotate_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/parsing/#vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args "vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args").

**```mapper```** :&ensp;`GroupLensMapper`
:   Mapper for grouping and lens mapping.

__Returns__

`NamedTuple`
:   Instance of the same type as `results[0].in_outputs` with merged data.

## merge_sim_outs | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/chunking.py#L106-L175)

```python
merge_sim_outs(
    results,
    chunk_meta,
    ann_args,
    mapper,
    in_outputs_merge_func=<function in_outputs_merge_func>,
    **kwargs
)
```

Merge chunks of [SimulationOutput](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput") instances.

Merges various components including order and log records, cash deposits, cash earnings, call sequence,
in-place outputs, and simulation timing arrays. If [SimulationOutput.in_outputs](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput.in_outputs "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationOutput.in_outputs")
is provided, a merge function such as [in_outputs_merge_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/chunking/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.chunking.in_outputs_merge_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.chunking.in_outputs_merge_func") must be used.

__Args__

**```results```** :&ensp;`List[SimulationOutput]`
:   List of simulation output chunks.

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Iterable[ChunkMeta]`
:   Iterable containing metadata for each chunk.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```ann_args```** :&ensp;`AnnArgs`
:   Annotated arguments.

    See [annotate_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/parsing/#vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args "vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args").

**```mapper```** :&ensp;`GroupLensMapper`
:   Mapper for grouping and lens mapping.

**```in_outputs_merge_func```** :&ensp;`Callable`
:   Function to merge in-place output objects.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [in_outputs_merge_func](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/chunking/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.chunking.in_outputs_merge_func "vectorbtpro.portfolio.chunking.in_outputs_merge_func").

__Returns__

`SimulationOutput`
:   Merged simulation output instance.

## attach_shortcut_properties | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/decorators.py#L100-L174)

```python
attach_shortcut_properties(
    config
)
```

Class decorator to attach shortcut properties.

The decorated class must be a subclass of [Portfolio](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/base/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio "vectorbtpro.portfolio.base.Portfolio").

__Args__

**```config```** :&ensp;`Config`
:   Dictionary mapping target property names to their corresponding settings.

    Each settings dictionary may include:

    * `method_name`: Name of the source method. Defaults to the target name prefixed with "get_".

    * `use_in_outputs`: Boolean indicating whether the property can return an in-place output.

    * `method_kwargs`: Keyword arguments for the source method.

    * `decorator`: Decorator to apply. Defaults to [cached_property](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/decorators/#vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cached_property "vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cached_property")
        for object types 'records' and 'red_array', otherwise
        [cacheable_property](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/decorators/#vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cacheable_property "vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cacheable_property").

    * `docstring`: Docstring for the generated property.

    * Keyword arguments for wrapping, indexing, resampling, stacking, etc.

__Returns__

`ClassWrapper`
:   Decorator that attaches shortcut properties to the class.

# vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py)

Module for named tuples and enumerated types used in portfolio management.

## AccumulationMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L268-L269)

Accumulation mode enumeration.

```python
AccumulationModeT(
    Disabled=0,
    Both=1,
    AddOnly=2,
    RemoveOnly=3
)
```

Enables gradual adjustment of positions.

__Fields__

**```Disabled```**
:   Disables accumulation (also accepts False).

**```Both```**
:   Allows both increasing and decreasing the position (also accepts True).

**```AddOnly```**
:   Permits only adding to the position.

**```RemoveOnly```**
:   Permits only reducing the position.

!!! note
    Accumulation behaves differently for exits and opposite entries: exits reduce the current 
    position without initiating a reverse position, whereas opposite entries reduce the current 
    position by the same amount and, once fully closed, commence building the opposite position.

    The behavior for opposite entries can be modified using [OppositeEntryMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.OppositeEntryMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.OppositeEntryMode") and 
    for stop orders using [StopExitType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.StopExitType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.StopExitType").

## CallSeqType | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L214-L215)

Call sequence type enumeration.

```python
CallSeqTypeT(
    Default=0,
    Reversed=1,
    Random=2,
    Auto=3
)
```

__Fields__

**```Default```**
:   Calls are executed from left to right.

**```Reversed```**
:   Calls are executed from right to left.

**```Random```**
:   Calls are executed in a random order.

**```Auto```**
:   Calls are dynamically ordered based on order value.

## ConflictMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L305-L306)

Conflict mode enumeration.

```python
ConflictModeT(
    Ignore=0,
    Entry=1,
    Exit=2,
    Adjacent=3,
    Opposite=4
)
```

Determines the action when both entry and exit signals occur simultaneously.

__Fields__

**```Ignore```**
:   Ignore both signals.

**```Entry```**
:   Execute the entry signal.

**```Exit```**
:   Execute the exit signal.

**```Adjacent```**
:   Execute the signal adjacent to the current position 
    (applies only when already in a position; otherwise ignored).

**```Opposite```**
:   Execute the signal opposite to the current position 
    (applies only when already in a position; otherwise ignored).

## DeltaFormat | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L400-L401)

Delta format enumeration.

```python
DeltaFormatT(
    Absolute=0,
    Percent=1,
    Percent100=2,
    Target=3
)
```

Specifies the format in which a delta value is provided.

__Fields__

**```Absolute```**
:   Represents the absolute difference between the initial and target values.

**```Percent```**
:   Represents a percentage difference, where 0.1 indicates a 10% change applied to the initial value.

**```Percent100```**
:   Represents a percentage difference, where 0.1 indicates a 0.1% change applied to the initial value.

**```Target```**
:   Represents the target value.

## DirectionConflictMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L337-L338)

```python
DirectionConflictModeT(
    Ignore=0,
    Long=1,
    Short=2,
    Adjacent=3,
    Opposite=4
)
```

Determines the behavior when both long and short entry signals occur simultaneously.

__Fields__

**```Ignore```**
:   Ignore both entry signals.

**```Long```**
:   Execute the long entry signal.

**```Short```**
:   Execute the short entry signal.

**```Opposite```**
:   Execute the opposite entry signal.

    Takes effect only when in position; otherwise, it is ignored.

## InitCashMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L190-L191)

Initial cash mode enumeration.

```python
InitCashModeT(
    Auto=-1,
    AutoAlign=-2
)
```

__Fields__

**```Auto```**
:   Initial cash is treated as infinite during simulation, then set to the total cash spent.

**```AutoAlign```**
:   Initial cash is set uniformly to the total cash spent across all columns.

## LeverageMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L696-L697)

Leverage mode enumeration.

```python
LeverageModeT(
    Lazy=0,
    Eager=1,
    LazyMult=2,
    EagerMult=3
)
```

__Fields__

**```Lazy```**
:   Leverage is applied only when free cash is exhausted.

    Does not multiply size.

**```Eager```**
:   Leverage is applied to each order.

    Does not multiply size.

**```LazyMult```**
:   Leverage is applied only when free cash is exhausted.

    Multiplies size.

**```EagerMult```**
:   Leverage is applied to each order.

    Multiplies size.

## LimitOrderPrice | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L892-L893)

Limit order price enumeration.

```python
LimitOrderPriceT(
    Limit=-1,
    HardLimit=-2,
    AutoLimit=-3,
    Close=-4
)
```

Determines which price to use when executing a limit order.

__Fields__

**```Limit```**
:   Limit price. 

    If the target price is first reached at the opening, the open price is used.
    The same applies to the close price if OHLC is not available.

    This option is more optimistic.

**```HardLimit```**
:   Hard limit price, where the stop price is applied regardless of the open or close price trigger.

    This option is more conservative.

**```AutoLimit```**
:   Behaves like `Limit` if reversal is enabled, otherwise behaves like `HardLimit`.

**```Close```**
:   Close price.

!!! note
    Each flag is negative; if a positive value is provided, it is used directly as the price.

## OrderStatusInfo | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L787-L788)

Order status information enumeration.

```python
OrderStatusInfoT(
    SizeNaN=0,
    PriceNaN=1,
    ValPriceNaN=2,
    ValueNaN=3,
    ValueZeroNeg=4,
    SizeZero=5,
    NoCash=6,
    NoOpenPosition=7,
    MaxSizeExceeded=8,
    RandomEvent=9,
    CantCoverFees=10,
    MinSizeNotReached=11,
    PartialFill=12
)
```

__Fields__

## PendingConflictMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L240-L241)

Conflict mode enumeration for pending signals.

This setting determines the action when an executable signal occurs during the pending phase.

```python
PendingConflictModeT(
    KeepIgnore=0,
    KeepExecute=1,
    CancelIgnore=2,
    CancelExecute=3
)
```

__Fields__

**```KeepIgnore```**
:   Retain the pending signal while canceling the user-defined signal.

**```KeepExecute```**
:   Retain the pending signal and execute the user-defined signal.

**```CancelIgnore```**
:   Cancel the pending signal and ignore the user-defined signal.

**```CancelExecute```**
:   Cancel the pending signal and execute the user-defined signal.

## PriceType | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L126-L127)

Price type enumeration.

```python
PriceTypeT(
    Open=-np.inf,
    Close=np.inf,
    NextOpen=-1,
    NextClose=-2,
    NextValidOpen=-3,
    NextValidClose=-4
)
```

__Fields__

**```Open```**
:   Open price.

    Replaced by `-np.inf`.

**```Close```**
:   Close price.

    Replaced by `np.inf`.

**```NextOpen```**
:   Next open price.

    Replaced by `-np.inf` with `from_ago` set to 1.

**```NextClose```**
:   Next close price.

    Replaced by `np.inf` with `from_ago` set to 1.

**```NextValidOpen```**
:   Next valid (non-NA) open price.

    Replaced by `-np.inf` with `from_ago` set to the distance to the previous valid value.

**```NextValidClose```**
:   Next valid (non-NA) close price.

    Replaced by `np.inf` with `from_ago` set to the distance to the previous valid value.

## SizeType | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L622-L623)

Size type for trading operations enumeration.

```python
SizeTypeT(
    Amount=0,
    Value=1,
    Percent=2,
    Percent100=3,
    ValuePercent=4,
    ValuePercent100=5,
    TargetAmount=6,
    TargetValue=7,
    TargetPercent=8,
    TargetPercent100=9
)
```

__Fields__

**```Amount```**
:   Specifies the number of assets to trade.

**```Value```**
:   Specifies the monetary value of assets to trade. 

    It is converted to `SizeType.Amount` using [ExecState.val_price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.val_price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.val_price").

**```Percent```**
:   Specifies the percentage of available resources to use for trading, where 0.01 represents 1%.

    * When long buying, applies to [ExecState.free_cash](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.free_cash "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.free_cash")

    * When long selling, applies to [ExecState.position](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.position "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.position")

    * When short selling, applies to [ExecState.free_cash](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.free_cash "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.free_cash")

    * When short buying, applies to [ExecState.free_cash](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.free_cash "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.free_cash"), [ExecState.debt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.debt "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.debt"), and [ExecState.locked_cash](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.locked_cash "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.locked_cash")

    * When reversing, applies to the final position

    Takes into account leverage.

**```Percent100```**
:   Equivalent to `SizeType.Percent` with a scale where 1.0 represents 1%.

**```ValuePercent```**
:   Represents a percentage of the total value using [ExecState.value](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.value "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.value"). 

    Converted to `SizeType.Value`.

**```ValuePercent100```**
:   Equivalent to `SizeType.ValuePercent` with 1.0 representing 1%.

**```TargetAmount```**
:   Specifies the target number of assets (target position) using [ExecState.position](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.position "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.position"). 

    Converted to `SizeType.Amount`.

**```TargetValue```**
:   Specifies the target asset value using [ExecState.val_price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.val_price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.val_price"). 

    Converted to `SizeType.TargetAmount`.

**```TargetPercent```**
:   Specifies the target percentage of total value using [ExecState.value](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.value "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ExecState.value"). 

    Converted to `SizeType.TargetValue`.

**```TargetPercent100```**
:   Equivalent to `SizeType.TargetPercent` where 1.0 represents 1%.

## StopEntryPrice | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L493-L494)

## StopExitPrice | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L524-L525)

Stop exit price enumeration.

```python
StopExitPriceT(
    Stop=-1,
    HardStop=-2,
    Close=-3
)
```

Specifies the price to use when exiting a position upon a stop signal.

__Fields__

**```Stop```**
:   Uses the stop price. 

    If the target price is first reached by the open price, the open price is used.
    The same applies to the close price if OHLC is not available.

    This option is more conservative.

**```HardStop```**
:   Uses a hard stop price, applying the stop value regardless of whether the target price 
    is first hit by the open or close price.

    This option is more optimistic.

**```Close```**
:   Uses the close price.

!!! note
    Each flag is negative; if a positive value is provided, it is used directly as a price.

## StopExitType | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L562-L563)

```python
    ReverseReduce=3
)
```

Specifies the method for exiting the current position when a stop signal is triggered.

__Fields__

**```Close```**
:   Closes the current position.

**```CloseReduce```**
:   Closes or reduces the current position if accumulation is enabled.

**```Reverse```**
:   Reverses the current position.

**```ReverseReduce```**

## StopLadderMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L458-L459)

Stop ladder mode enumeration.

```python
StopLadderModeT(
    Disabled=0,
    Uniform=1,
    Weighted=2,
    AdaptUniform=3,
    AdaptWeighted=4,
    Dynamic=5
)
```

Specifies the configuration of the stop ladder mechanism.

__Fields__

**```Disabled```**
:   Disables the stop ladder (can also be provided as False).

**```Uniform```**
:   Enables the stop ladder with a uniform exit size (can also be provided as True).

**```Weighted```**
:   Enables the stop ladder with a stop-weighted exit size.

**```AdaptUniform```**
:   Enables the stop ladder with a uniform exit size that adapts to the current position.

**```AdaptWeighted```**
:   Enables the stop ladder with a stop-weighted exit size that adapts to the current position.

**```Dynamic```**
:   Enables the stop ladder without using stop arrays.

!!! note
    When disabled, ensure that stop arrays broadcast against the target shape.
    When enabled, ensure that rows in stop arrays represent steps in the ladder.

## StopUpdateMode | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L589-L590)

Stop update mode enumeration.

```python
StopUpdateModeT(
    Keep=0,
    Override=1,
    OverrideNaN=2
)
```

Specifies how to handle an existing stop when a new entry or accumulation occurs.

__Fields__

**```Keep```**
:   Retain the old stop.

**```Override```**
:   Replace the old stop if the new stop is not NaN.

**```OverrideNaN```**
:   Replace the old stop even if the new stop is NaN.

## TimeDeltaFormat | named tuple | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L426-L427)

Time delta format enumeration.

```python
TimeDeltaFormatT(
    Rows=0,
    Index=1
)
```

Specifies the format in which a time delta value is represented.

__Fields__

**```Rows```**
:   Row-based format where a value of 1 indicates that one simulation step (row) has passed.

    Does not require an index.

**```Index```**
:   Index-based format where a value of 1 indicates that one position in the index has passed. 

    If the index is datetime-like, 1 corresponds to one nanosecond; the index must be provided.

Trade status enumeration.

Named tuple representing the context for a group in a from-signals simulation.

Contains all fields from [FSSimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSimulationContext") with additional fields
`group`, `group_len`, `from_col`, and `to_col` representing the current group.

Passed to `pre_group_func_nb` and `post_group_func_nb`.


Named tuple representing the context after an order has been processed in a from-signals simulation.

Contains all fields from [FSSignalContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSignalContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSignalContext") along with previous balance fields and the order result.

Passed to `post_order_func_nb`.

## FSPreOrderSegmentContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2820-L2871)


Named tuple representing the context for a segment before processing orders in a from-signals simulation.

Contains all fields from [FSSegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSegmentContext") with an additional field `order_info` representing the order information.

Passed to `pre_order_func_nb`.

__Superclasses__

* `builtins.tuple`

## FSSegmentContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2679-L2729)


Named tuple representing the context for a segment in a from-signals simulation.

Contains all fields from [FSGroupContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSGroupContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSGroupContext") with an additional field `i` representing the row index.

Passed to `pre_segment_func_nb` and `post_segment_func_nb`.

* `builtins.tuple`

Named tuple representing the context of an element in a from-signals simulation.

Contains all fields from [FSSegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSegmentContext") with an additional field `col` representing the column.

Passed to `signal_func_nb` and `adjust_func_nb`.


Named tuple representing the context for a from-signals simulation.

This context includes OHLC data and additional internal simulation details computed at the start 
of the simulation. For accessing other information, such as order size, consider using templates.

Passed to `pre_sim_func_nb` and `post_sim_func_nb`.

## FlexOrderContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2237-L2288)

Named tuple representing the flexible order context.

It includes all fields from [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext") along with the current call index.

Passed to `flex_order_func_nb`.

## GroupContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L1720-L1768)

```python
GroupContext(
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    call_seq,
    init_cash,
    init_position,
    init_price,
    cash_deposits,
    cash_earnings,
    segment_mask,
    call_pre_segment,
    call_post_segment,
    index,
    freq,
    open,
    high,
    low,
    close,
    bm_close,
    ffill_val_price,
    update_value,
    fill_pos_info,
    track_value,
    order_records,
    order_counts,
    log_records,
    log_counts,
    in_outputs,
    last_cash,
    last_position,
    last_debt,
    last_locked_cash,
    last_free_cash,
    last_val_price,
    last_value,
    last_return,
    last_pos_info,
    sim_start,
    sim_end,
    group,
    group_len,
    from_col,
    to_col
)
```

Named tuple representing a group context.

A group is a set of adjacent columns that are related (e.g., by shared capital). 
In each row, columns in the same group form a single segment.

This tuple includes all fields from [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext") along with additional fields
describing the current group.

Used in `pre_group_func_nb` and `post_group_func_nb`.

__Examples__

Consider a configuration with a group of three columns, one of two columns, and one standalone column:

| group | group_len | from_col | to_col |
| ----- | --------- | -------- | ------ |
| 0     | 3         | 0        | 3      |
| 1     | 2         | 3        | 5      |
| 2     | 1         | 5        | 6      |

* `builtins.tuple`

## Order | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2314-L2332)

```python
Order(
    size=inf,
    price=inf,
    size_type=0,
    direction=2,
    fees=0.0,
    fixed_fees=0.0,
    slippage=0.0,
    min_size=nan,
    max_size=nan,
    size_granularity=nan,

    leverage=1.0,
    leverage_mode=0,
    reject_prob=0.0,
    price_area_vio_mode=0,

    log=False
```

Named tuple representing an order.

!!! note
    Due to issues with Numba default handling in named tuples, 
    use [order_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/core/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.order_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.order_nb") to create an order.

__Superclasses__

* `builtins.tuple`

### Order.allow_partial | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2330-L2330)

Indicates whether partial filling of the order is permitted.

If False, orders that cannot be fully filled will be rejected.

Note: This does not apply when [Order.size](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size") is `np.inf`.

### Order.cash_limit | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2325-L2325)

Max own cash the order is allowed to use.

### Order.direction | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2318-L2318)

See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

### Order.fees | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2319-L2319)

Fees as a percentage of the order value.

Negative values (e.g. -0.05) indicate earning 5% per trade instead of paying a fee.

!!! note
    0.01 represents 1%.

### Order.fixed_fees | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2320-L2320)

Fixed fee amount charged for this order.

As with [Order.fees](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.fees "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.fees"), it can be negative.

### Order.leverage | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2326-L2326)

Leverage factor.

### Order.leverage_mode | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2327-L2327)

### Order.log | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2332-L2332)

Remember to increase `max_log_records` if logging is enabled.

### Order.max_size | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2323-L2323)

Maximum allowable size for an order.

Depends on [Order.size_type](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size_type "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size_type"). Values exceeding this limit may be partially filled.

### Order.min_size | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2322-L2322)

Minimum allowable size for an order.

Depends on [Order.size_type](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size_type "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size_type"). Values below this threshold will be rejected.

### Order.price | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2316-L2316)

Price per unit.

The final price is adjusted for slippage.

* If set to `-np.inf`, it will be replaced by the current open price.

* If set to `np.inf`, it will be replaced by the current close price.

!!! note
    Ensure that timestamps fall between (and ideally do not include) the current open and close prices.

### Order.price_area_vio_mode | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2329-L2329)

See [PriceAreaVioMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode").

### Order.raise_reject | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2331-L2331)

Specifies whether an exception should be raised if the order is rejected.

If True, the simulation terminates upon order rejection.

### Order.reject_prob | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2328-L2328)

Probability of order rejection, used to simulate random rejection events.

This can help test the robustness of the order management system.

### Order.size | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2315-L2315)

Size in units.

Behavior depends on [Order.size_type](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size_type "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.size_type") and [Order.direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.direction").

For fixed sizes:

* Specify a numeric value to buy or sell a fixed amount or value.

* Use `np.inf` to buy using all available cash, or `-np.inf` to sell using all free cash.
    If [Order.direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.direction") is not `Direction.Both`, `-np.inf` will close the position.

* Use `np.nan` or 0 to skip.

For target sizes:

* Specify a number to buy or sell an amount relative to the current position or value.

* Use 0 to close the current position.

* Use `np.nan` to skip.

### Order.size_granularity | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2324-L2324)

Specifies the granularity of the order size.

For example, a granularity of 1.0 enforces integer-like quantities; 
placing an order for 12.5 shares will result in ordering exactly 12.0 shares.

!!! note
    The filled size is still represented as a floating-point number.

### Order.size_type | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2317-L2317)

See [SizeType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SizeType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SizeType").

### Order.slippage | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L2321-L2321)

Slippage expressed as a percentage of [Order.price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.price").

This represents a penalty applied to the order's price.

!!! note
    0.01 corresponds to 1%.

Named tuple representing the context of an order.

Includes all fields from [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext") along with additional fields that describe the current order state.

Passed to `order_func_nb`.

__Superclasses__

* `builtins.tuple`

## RowContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L1831-L1876)

```python
    target_shape,
    group_lens,

    call_seq,

    last_return,
    last_pos_info,
    sim_start,
    sim_end,
    i
)
```

Named tuple representing the context of a row.

A row corresponds to a bar during which segments are executed.

Includes all fields from [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext") plus additional fields specific to the current row.

Passed to `pre_row_func_nb` and `post_row_func_nb`.

* `builtins.tuple`

## SegmentContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L1903-L1954)

```python
SegmentContext(
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    call_seq,
    init_cash,
    init_position,
    init_price,
    cash_deposits,
    cash_earnings,
    segment_mask,
    call_pre_segment,
    call_post_segment,
    index,
    freq,
    open,
    high,
    low,
    close,
    bm_close,
    ffill_val_price,
    update_value,
    fill_pos_info,
    track_value,
    order_records,
    order_counts,
    log_records,
    log_counts,
    in_outputs,
    last_cash,
    last_position,
    last_debt,
    last_locked_cash,
    last_free_cash,
    last_val_price,
    last_value,
    last_return,
    last_pos_info,
    sim_start,
    sim_end,
    group,
    group_len,
    from_col,
    to_col,
    i,
    call_seq_now
)
```

Named tuple representing the context of a segment.

A segment is an intersection of groups and rows that defines the processing order of elements.

Includes all fields from [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext"), [GroupContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext"), and [RowContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext") plus additional
fields for the current segment.

Passed to `pre_segment_func_nb` and `post_segment_func_nb`.

__Superclasses__

* `builtins.tuple`

### SegmentContext.call_seq_now | field | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L1954-L1954)

Sequence of call indices within the current segment.

Shape: 
    `(group_len,)`

Each value indicates the position of the column in the group to call next. 
Processing always proceeds from left to right.

You can override `call_seq_now` using `pre_segment_func_nb`.

__Examples__

`[2, 0, 1]` calls column 2 first, then column 0, and finally column 1.

## SimulationContext | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/enums.py#L1210-L1253)

```python
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    call_seq,
    init_cash,
    init_position,
    init_price,

    cash_earnings,
    segment_mask,
    call_pre_segment,
    call_post_segment,
```
