## align_init_cash_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/analysis.py#L1151-L1226)

```python
align_init_cash_nb(
    init_cash_raw,
    free_cash_flow,
    cash_deposits=0.0,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None
)
```

Align initial cash based on the maximum negative free cash flow per column or group.

Evaluates the cumulative free cash flow by summing free cash flow and cash deposits
over the simulation range for each column. The aligned initial cash is set to cover the
maximum negative cash requirement. If `init_cash_raw` equals auto-align mode, all columns
are adjusted to the maximum required cash across columns.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```init_cash_raw```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Raw initial cash value or mode indicator for auto alignment.

**```free_cash_flow```** :&ensp;`Array2d`
:   Array of free cash flow values.

**```cash_deposits```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   Cash deposits or withdrawals at the beginning of each bar.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   Start position of the simulation range (inclusive).

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   End position of the simulation range (exclusive).

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

__Returns__

`Array1d`
:   Aligned initial cash values for each column.

Calculates the total transacted asset amount at each bar based on the order records.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   Start position of the simulation range (inclusive).

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   End position of the simulation range (exclusive).

__Returns__

:   Flag indicating whether to use free cash flow.

:   Cash earnings or losses at the end of each bar.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

## buy_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/core.py#L739-L917)

```python
buy_nb(
    account_state,
    size,
    price,
    direction=2,
    fees=0.0,
    fixed_fees=0.0,
    slippage=0.0,
    min_size=nan,
    max_size=nan,
    size_granularity=nan,
    cash_limit=nan,
    leverage=1.0,
    leverage_mode=0,
    price_area_vio_mode=0,
    allow_partial=True,
    percent=nan,
    price_area=PriceArea(open=nan, high=nan, low=nan, close=nan),
    is_closing_price=False
)
```

Perform a buy operation on an account by determining the appropriate long or short strategy
based on the current state and provided parameters.

__Args__

**```account_state```** :&ensp;`AccountState`
:   Current state of the trading account.

    See [AccountState](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState").

**```size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Order size.

**```price```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Execution price for the order.

**```direction```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Order direction.

    See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

**```fees```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Fraction of the order value charged as fee.

**```fixed_fees```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Fixed fee amount charged per order.

**```slippage```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Slippage percentage to adjust the execution price.

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum allowed order size.

**```max_size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Maximum allowed order size.

**```size_granularity```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Granularity factor for order size (e.g., 1 for whole shares)

**```cash_limit```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Max own cash the order is allowed to use.

**```leverage```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Leverage factor.

**```leverage_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Leverage mode.

    See [LeverageMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.LeverageMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.LeverageMode").

**```price_area_vio_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Mode for handling price area violations.

    See [PriceAreaVioMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode").

**```allow_partial```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to allow partial order fulfillment.

**```percent```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Scaling factor to restrict the allowed order size.

**```price_area```** :&ensp;`PriceArea`
:   Price area constraint.

    See [PriceArea](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea").

**```is_closing_price```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating if the price is a close price.

__Returns__

`Tuple[OrderResult, AccountState]`
:   Tuple containing the order execution result and
    the updated account state.

## check_limit_hit_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/core.py#L2974-L3040)

```python
check_limit_hit_nb(
    open,
    high,
    low,
    close,
    price,
    size,
    direction=2,
    limit_delta=nan,
    delta_format=1,
    limit_reverse=False,
    can_use_ohlc=True,
    check_open=True,
    hard_limit=True
)
```

Resolve the limit price using [resolve_limit_price_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/core/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.resolve_limit_price_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.resolve_limit_price_nb") and determine if the limit was hit
using [check_price_hit_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/core/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.check_price_hit_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.check_price_hit_nb").

__Args__

**```open```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Open price.

**```high```** :&ensp;`float`
:   High price of the period.

**```low```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Low price of the period.

**```close```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Close price.

**```price```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Reference price used for calculating the limit.

**```size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Order size (must be non-zero).

**```direction```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Order direction.

    See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

**```limit_delta```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Delta value used to adjust the limit price.

**```delta_format```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Format for delta comparisons.

    See [DeltaFormat](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.DeltaFormat "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.DeltaFormat").

**```limit_reverse```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to reverse the limit condition.

**```can_use_ohlc```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether OHLC data is safe to use for the evaluation.

**```check_open```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Determines whether the open price should be considered.

**```hard_limit```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Enforces a hard limit without fallback to the open price if True,
    or close price when `can_use_ohlc` is False.

__Returns__

`Tuple[float, bool, bool]`
:   Tuple containing:

    * Effective limit price; NaN if the limit price was not hit.

    * True if the limit price was hit before or on open, otherwise False.

    * True if the limit price was hit on close, otherwise False.

:   If True, check whether the target price is hit from above.

**```can_use_ohlc```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether OHLC data is safe to use for the evaluation.

**```check_open```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Determines whether the open price should be considered.

**```hard_price```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, enforces the target price when hit by the open price,
    or close price when `can_use_ohlc` is False.

__Returns__

`Tuple[float, bool, bool]`
:   Tuple containing:

    * Effective price; NaN if the price was not hit.

    * True if the price was hit before or on open, otherwise False.

    * True if the price was hit on close, otherwise False.

## prepare_records_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/core.py#L2191-L2224)

```python
    target_shape,
    max_order_records=None,
    max_log_records=0
)
```

Prepare order and log records arrays.

__Args__

**```target_shape```** :&ensp;`Shape`
:   Base dimensions (rows, columns).

**```max_order_records```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`

    Defaults to the number of rows in the broadcasted shape. Set to 0 to disable,
    lower to reduce memory usage, or higher if multiple orders per timestamp are expected.

    Set to the number of rows in the broadcasted shape if logging is enabled. Set lower to
    reduce memory usage, or higher if multiple logs per timestamp are expected.

    * `order_records`: Array for order records (dtype [order_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.order_dt "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.order_dt")).

    * `log_records`: Array for log records (dtype [log_dt](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.log_dt "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.log_dt")).

## resolve_dyn_limit_price_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/core.py#L3325-L3344)

Resolve the dynamic limit price.

Determines a bounded limit price using the valuation price as the lower bound and
the order price as the upper bound.

**```price```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Order price used as the upper bound.

:   Proposed limit price value; if infinite, selects a bound based on its sign.

:   Resolved limit price.

## sell_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/core.py#L920-L1101)

```python
sell_nb(
    account_state,
    size,
    price,
    direction=2,
    fees=0.0,
    fixed_fees=0.0,
    slippage=0.0,
    min_size=nan,
    max_size=nan,
    size_granularity=nan,
    cash_limit=nan,
    leverage=1.0,
    leverage_mode=0,
    price_area_vio_mode=0,
    allow_partial=True,
    percent=nan,
    price_area=PriceArea(open=nan, high=nan, low=nan, close=nan),
    is_closing_price=False
)
```

Execute a sell order based on the current account state and specified parameters.

Depending on the account state and trade direction, this function delegates the sell
order to either [long_sell_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/core/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.long_sell_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.long_sell_nb") or [short_sell_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/core/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.short_sell_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.core.short_sell_nb"). For positions spanning both long and
short, it processes the long portion first and, if fully filled, proceeds with a short sell
for the remaining size.

__Args__

**```account_state```** :&ensp;`AccountState`
:   Current state of the trading account.

    See [AccountState](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState").

**```size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Order size.

**```price```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Order price.

**```direction```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Order direction.

    See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

**```fees```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Fraction of the order value charged as fee.

**```fixed_fees```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Fixed fee amount charged per order.

**```slippage```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Slippage percentage to adjust the execution price.

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum allowed order size.

**```max_size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Maximum allowed order size.

**```size_granularity```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Granularity factor for order size (e.g., 1 for whole shares)

**```cash_limit```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Max own cash the order is allowed to use.

**```leverage```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Leverage factor.

**```leverage_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Leverage mode.

    See [LeverageMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.LeverageMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.LeverageMode").

**```price_area_vio_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Mode for handling price area violations.

    See [PriceAreaVioMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode").

**```allow_partial```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to allow partial order fulfillment.

**```percent```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Scaling factor to restrict the allowed order size.

**```price_area```** :&ensp;`PriceArea`
:   Price area constraint.

    See [PriceArea](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea").

**```is_closing_price```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating if the price is a close price.

__Returns__

`Tuple[OrderResult, AccountState]`
:   Tuple containing the order result and the updated account state.

## short_buy_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/core.py#L593-L736)

```python
short_buy_nb(
    account_state,
    size,
    price,
    fees=0.0,
    fixed_fees=0.0,
    slippage=0.0,
    min_size=nan,
    max_size=nan,
    size_granularity=nan,
    cash_limit=nan,
    price_area_vio_mode=0,
    allow_partial=True,
    percent=nan,
    price_area=PriceArea(open=nan, high=nan, low=nan, close=nan),
    is_closing_price=False
)
```

Decrease or close a short position.

This function processes an order to reduce or cover a short position. It verifies that an open
position exists, checks for sufficient cash, and adjusts the order size based on constraints
such as maximum size, granularity, and percentage limits. The function calculates the required
fees and cash, and returns the order result along with an updated account state.

__Args__

**```account_state```** :&ensp;`AccountState`
:   Current state of the trading account.

    See [AccountState](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState").

**```size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Requested order size for covering the short position.

**```price```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Execution price for the order.

**```fees```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Fraction of the order value charged as fee.

**```fixed_fees```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Fixed fee amount charged per order.

**```slippage```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Slippage percentage to adjust the execution price.

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Minimum allowed order size.

**```max_size```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Maximum allowed order size.

**```size_granularity```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Granularity factor for order size (e.g., 1 for whole shares)

**```cash_limit```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Max own cash the order is allowed to use.

**```price_area_vio_mode```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Mode for handling price area violations.

    See [PriceAreaVioMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceAreaVioMode").

**```allow_partial```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to allow partial order fulfillment.

**```percent```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Scaling factor to restrict the allowed order size.

**```price_area```** :&ensp;`PriceArea`
:   Price area constraint.

    See [PriceArea](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PriceArea").

**```is_closing_price```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating if the price is a close price.

__Returns__

`Tuple[OrderResult, AccountState]`
:   Tuple containing the executed order result and
    the updated account state.

Custom flexible order processing function that creates an order with default parameters.

Constructs an order for a flexible order context by selecting values from the provided arrays using
a column determined by the current call sequence. If no valid call index exists, a no-op order is returned.

:   Array indicating the order direction.

    See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

    See [LeverageMode](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.LeverageMode "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.LeverageMode").

## from_flex_order_func_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_order_func.py#L3029-L4171)

```python
from_flex_order_func_nb(
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    init_cash=100.0,
    init_position=0.0,
    init_price=nan,
    cash_deposits=0.0,
    cash_earnings=0.0,
    segment_mask=True,
    call_pre_segment=False,
    call_post_segment=False,
    pre_sim_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_sim_args=(),
    post_sim_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_sim_args=(),
    pre_group_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_group_args=(),
    post_group_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_group_args=(),
    pre_segment_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_segment_args=(),
    post_segment_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_segment_args=(),
    flex_order_func_nb=no_flex_order_func_nb,
    flex_order_args=(),
    post_order_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_order_args=(),
    index=None,
    freq=None,
    open=nan,
    high=nan,
    low=nan,
    close=nan,
    bm_close=nan,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,
    ffill_val_price=True,
    update_value=False,
    fill_pos_info=True,
    track_value=True,
    max_order_records=None,
    max_log_records=0,
    in_outputs=None
)
```

Same as [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb"), but with no predefined call sequence.

In contrast to [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb"), the `post_order_func_nb` in this function is a segment-level
order function that returns both a column index and an order, and is repeatedly called until a break
condition is met. This design enables multiple orders to be issued within a single element in
an arbitrary order.

The order function must accept a [FlexOrderContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FlexOrderContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FlexOrderContext"), an unpacked
tuple output from `pre_segment_func_nb`, and additional positional arguments from `flex_order_args`.
It should return a tuple of (column, order), where returning a column index of -1 signals to
exit the order loop.

!!! note
    Since multiple orders can be generated per element, an "order_records index out of range"
    exception may occur. In such cases, increase `max_order_records` manually to avoid
    performance degradation.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Call hierarchy__

```plaintext

1. pre_sim_out = pre_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_args)

    2. pre_group_out = pre_group_func_nb(GroupContext, *pre_sim_out, *pre_group_args)
        if call_pre_segment or segment_mask:

            3. pre_segment_out = pre_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_group_out, *pre_segment_args)
        while col != -1:
            if segment_mask:

                4. col, order = flex_order_func_nb(FlexOrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *flex_order_args)

                5. post_order_func_nb(PostOrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_order_args)
        if call_post_segment or segment_mask:

            6. post_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_segment_args)

    7. post_group_func_nb(GroupContext, *pre_group_out, *post_group_args)

8. post_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_out, *post_sim_args)
```

Let's illustrate a similar example as in [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb"), but adapted for this function:

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_flex_order_func_nb.svg){: loading=lazy style="width:800px;" }

**```pre_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreSimFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before the simulation.

    This function is used for creating global arrays and setting the seed.

**```post_group_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostGroupFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a group.

    Accepts [GroupContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_sim_func_nb`, and `*post_group_args`, returning nothing.

**```post_group_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_group_func_nb`.

**```pre_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreSegmentFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a segment
    if `segment_mask` or `call_pre_segment` is True.

    Accepts [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_group_func_nb`, and `*pre_segment_args`, and returns a tuple that is passed to
    `flex_order_func_nb`, `post_order_func_nb`, and `post_segment_func_nb`.

    This is the appropriate place to adjust the call sequence or set the valuation price.
    Group re-valuation and updates of open position stats occur immediately after this function
    executes, regardless of whether it is called.

    !!! note
        To change the call sequence of a segment, modify
        [SegmentContext.call_seq_now](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext.call_seq_now "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext.call_seq_now") in-place.
        Avoid creating new arrays to prevent performance degradation.
        Assigning a new context is not supported.

    !!! note
        You can override elements of `last_val_price` to influence group valuation.
        See [SimulationContext.last_val_price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.last_val_price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.last_val_price").

:   Positional arguments for `pre_segment_func_nb`.

    Accepts [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_segment_func_nb`, and `*post_segment_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_segment_func_nb`.

__Examples__

Same example as in [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb"):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> @njit
... def pre_sim_func_nb(c):
...     # Create temporary arrays and pass them down the stack
...     print('before simulation')
...     order_value_out = np.empty(c.target_shape[1], dtype=float_)
...     call_seq_out = np.empty(c.target_shape[1], dtype=int_)
...     return (order_value_out, call_seq_out)

>>> @njit
... def pre_group_func_nb(c, order_value_out, call_seq_out):
...     print('\tbefore group', c.group)
...     return (order_value_out, call_seq_out)

>>> @njit
... def pre_segment_func_nb(c, order_value_out, call_seq_out, size, price, size_type, direction):
...     print('\t\tbefore segment', c.i)
...     for col in range(c.from_col, c.to_col):
...         # Here we use order price for group valuation
...         c.last_val_price[col] = vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, price)
...
...     # Same as for from_order_func_nb, but since we don't have a predefined c.call_seq_now anymore,
...     # we need to store our new call sequence somewhere else
...     call_seq_out[:] = np.arange(c.group_len)
...     vbt.pf_nb.sort_call_seq_out_nb(
...         c,
...         size,
...         size_type,
...         direction,
...         order_value_out[c.from_col:c.to_col],
...         call_seq_out[c.from_col:c.to_col]
...     )
...
...     # Forward the sorted call sequence
...     return (call_seq_out,)

>>> @njit
... def flex_order_func_nb(c, call_seq_out, size, price, size_type, direction, fees, fixed_fees, slippage):
...     if c.call_idx < c.group_len:
...         col = c.from_col + call_seq_out[c.call_idx]
...         print('\t\t\tcreating order', c.call_idx, 'at column', col)
...         # # Create and returns an order
...         return col, vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(
...             size=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, size),
...             price=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, price),
...             size_type=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, size_type),
...             direction=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, direction),
...             fees=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, fees),
...             fixed_fees=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, fixed_fees),
...             slippage=vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, slippage)
...         )
...     # All columns already processed -> break the loop
...     print('\t\t\tbreaking out of the loop')
...     return -1, vbt.pf_nb.order_nothing_nb()

>>> @njit
... def post_order_func_nb(c, call_seq_out):
...     print('\t\t\t\torder status:', c.order_result.status)
...     return None

>>> @njit
... def post_segment_func_nb(c, call_seq_out):
...     print('\t\tafter segment', c.i)
...     return None

>>> @njit
... def post_group_func_nb(c, order_value_out, call_seq_out):
...     print('\tafter group', c.group)
...     return None

>>> @njit
... def post_sim_func_nb(c, order_value_out, call_seq_out):
...     print('after simulation')
...     return None

>>> target_shape = (5, 3)
>>> np.random.seed(42)
>>> group_lens = np.array([3])  # one group of three columns
>>> cash_sharing = True
>>> segment_mask = np.array([True, False, True, False, True])[:, None]
>>> price = close = np.random.uniform(1, 10, size=target_shape)
>>> size = np.array([[1 / target_shape[1]]])  # custom flexible arrays must be 2-dim
>>> size_type = np.array([[vbt.pf_enums.SizeType.TargetPercent]])
>>> direction = np.array([[vbt.pf_enums.Direction.LongOnly]])
>>> fees = np.array([[0.001]])
>>> fixed_fees = np.array([[1.]])
>>> slippage = np.array([[0.001]])

>>> sim_out = vbt.pf_nb.from_flex_order_func_nb(
...     target_shape,
...     group_lens,
...     cash_sharing,
...     segment_mask=segment_mask,
...     pre_sim_func_nb=pre_sim_func_nb,
...     post_sim_func_nb=post_sim_func_nb,
...     pre_group_func_nb=pre_group_func_nb,
...     post_group_func_nb=post_group_func_nb,
...     pre_segment_func_nb=pre_segment_func_nb,
...     pre_segment_args=(size, price, size_type, direction),
...     post_segment_func_nb=post_segment_func_nb,
...     flex_order_func_nb=flex_order_func_nb,
...     flex_order_args=(size, price, size_type, direction, fees, fixed_fees, slippage),
...     post_order_func_nb=post_order_func_nb
... )
before simulation
    before group 0
        before segment 0
            creating order 0 at column 0
                order status: 0
            creating order 1 at column 1
                order status: 0
            creating order 2 at column 2
                order status: 0
            breaking out of the loop
        after segment 0
        before segment 2
            creating order 0 at column 1
                order status: 0
            creating order 1 at column 2
                order status: 0
            creating order 2 at column 0
                order status: 0
            breaking out of the loop
        after segment 2
        before segment 4
            creating order 0 at column 0
                order status: 0
            creating order 1 at column 2
                order status: 0
            creating order 2 at column 1
                order status: 0
            breaking out of the loop
        after segment 4
    after group 0
after simulation
```

## from_flex_order_func_rw_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_order_func.py#L4201-L5218)

```python
from_flex_order_func_rw_nb(
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    init_cash=100.0,
    init_position=0.0,
    init_price=nan,
    cash_deposits=0.0,
    cash_earnings=0.0,
    segment_mask=True,
    call_pre_segment=False,
    call_post_segment=False,
    pre_sim_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_sim_args=(),
    post_sim_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_sim_args=(),
    pre_row_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_row_args=(),
    post_row_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_row_args=(),
    pre_segment_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_segment_args=(),
    post_segment_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_segment_args=(),
    flex_order_func_nb=no_flex_order_func_nb,
    flex_order_args=(),
    post_order_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_order_args=(),
    index=None,
    freq=None,
    open=nan,
    high=nan,
    low=nan,
    close=nan,
    bm_close=nan,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,
    ffill_val_price=True,
    update_value=False,
    fill_pos_info=True,
    track_value=True,
    max_order_records=None,
    max_log_records=0,
    in_outputs=None
)
```

Same as [from_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb"), but iterates in row-major order with rows changing fastest
and columns/groups changing slowest.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Call hierarchy__

```plaintext

1. pre_sim_out = pre_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_args)

    2. pre_row_out = pre_row_func_nb(RowContext, *pre_sim_out, *pre_row_args)
        if call_pre_segment or segment_mask:

            3. pre_segment_out = pre_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_row_out, *pre_segment_args)
        while col != -1:
            if segment_mask:

                4. col, order = flex_order_func_nb(FlexOrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *flex_order_args)

                5. post_order_func_nb(PostOrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_order_args)
        if call_post_segment or segment_mask:

            6. post_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_segment_args)

    7. post_row_func_nb(RowContext, *pre_row_out, *post_row_args)

8. post_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_out, *post_sim_args)
```

Let's illustrate the same example as in [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb") but adapted for this function:

```pycon
>>> @njit
... def pre_row_func_nb(c, order_value_out, call_seq_out):
...     print('\tbefore row', c.i)
...     return (order_value_out, call_seq_out)

>>> @njit
... def post_row_func_nb(c, order_value_out, call_seq_out):
...     print('\tafter row', c.i)
...     return None

>>> sim_out = vbt.pf_nb.from_flex_order_func_rw_nb(
...     target_shape,
...     group_lens,
...     cash_sharing,
```

## from_order_func_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_order_func.py#L574-L1785)

```python
from_order_func_nb(
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    call_seq=None,
    init_cash=100.0,
    init_position=0.0,
    init_price=nan,
    cash_deposits=0.0,
    cash_earnings=0.0,
    segment_mask=True,
    call_pre_segment=False,
    call_post_segment=False,
    pre_sim_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_sim_args=(),
    post_sim_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_sim_args=(),
    pre_group_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_group_args=(),
    post_group_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_group_args=(),
    pre_segment_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_segment_args=(),
    post_segment_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_segment_args=(),
    order_func_nb=no_order_func_nb,
    order_args=(),
    post_order_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_order_args=(),
    index=None,
    freq=None,
    open=nan,
    high=nan,
    low=nan,
    close=nan,
    bm_close=nan,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,
    ffill_val_price=True,
    update_value=False,
    fill_pos_info=True,
    track_value=True,
    max_order_records=None,
    max_log_records=0,
    in_outputs=None
)
```

Fill order and log records by iterating over a target shape and executing a
sequence of user-defined functions.

Starting with an initial cash balance (`init_cash`), this function iterates over
each group and each column in `target_shape`. For every data point, it generates an
order using `order_func_nb` and attempts to process it. Upon a successful order execution,
the simulation state (including cash, positions, and valuation) is updated. The simulation
output is returned as a `SimulationOutput`.

Unlike [from_order_func_rw_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_rw_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_rw_nb"), order processing is performed in column-major order
(i.e. processing the entire column or group across all rows before moving to the next).
See [Row- and column-major order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Row-_and_column-major_order).

!!! note
    Indexing of 2D arrays in vectorbtpro follows the Pandas convention: `a[i, col]`.

!!! warning
    You can only safely access data from columns left of the current group and rows above the
    current row within the same group. Other data points may have not been processed yet.
    Accessing unprocessed data may not trigger any errors or warnings but yield arbitrary values
    (see [np.empty](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.empty.html)).

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Call hierarchy__

Simulation is carried out by iterating over an imaginary frame with dimensions representing
time (rows) and assets/features (columns). Each element of this frame is a potential order
generated by an order function.

There are two processing patterns:

* Column-major (used by [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb")): Processes all rows in a column/group
    before moving to the next.

* Row-major (used by [from_order_func_rw_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_rw_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_rw_nb")): Processes all columns in a row
    before moving to the next row.

This choice affects the data available during order generation.

The frame is subdivided into blocks (columns, groups, rows, segments, elements). Columns can be
grouped into groups that may or may not share the same capital. Regardless of capital sharing,
each collection of elements within a group and a bar is called a segment, which simply
defines a single context (such as shared capital) for one or multiple orders. Each segment
can also define a custom sequence (a so-called call sequence) in which orders are executed.

Each block has its own context and pre/post-processing functions. Pre-processing functions
return a tuple (possibly empty) that is passed down, while post-processing functions can be
used to write custom arrays (e.g., returns).

```plaintext

1. pre_sim_out = pre_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_args)

    2. pre_group_out = pre_group_func_nb(GroupContext, *pre_sim_out, *pre_group_args)
        if call_pre_segment or segment_mask:

            3. pre_segment_out = pre_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_group_out, *pre_segment_args)
        if segment_mask:

            4. order = order_func_nb(OrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *order_args)

            5. post_order_func_nb(PostOrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_order_args)
        if call_post_segment or segment_mask:

            6. post_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_segment_args)

    7. post_group_func_nb(GroupContext, *pre_group_out, *post_group_args)

8. post_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_out, *post_sim_args)
```

Let's demonstrate a frame with one group of two columns and one group of one column, and the
following call sequence:

```plaintext
array([[0, 1, 0],
        [1, 0, 0]])
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_nb.svg){: loading=lazy style="width:800px;" }

**```pre_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreSimFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before the simulation.

    This function is used for creating global arrays and setting the seed.

    Accepts [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext") and `*pre_sim_args`,
    and returns a tuple that is passed to `pre_group_func_nb` and `post_sim_func_nb`.

**```pre_sim_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_sim_func_nb`.

**```post_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostSimFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after the simulation.

    Accepts [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_sim_func_nb`, and `*post_sim_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_sim_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_sim_func_nb`.

**```pre_group_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreGroupFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a group.

    Accepts [GroupContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_sim_func_nb`, and `*pre_group_args`, and returns a tuple that is passed to
    `pre_segment_func_nb` and `post_group_func_nb`.

**```pre_group_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_group_func_nb`.

**```post_group_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostGroupFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a group.

    Accepts [GroupContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.GroupContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_sim_func_nb`, and `*post_group_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_group_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_group_func_nb`.

**```pre_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreSegmentFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a segment
    if `segment_mask` or `call_pre_segment` is True.

    Accepts [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_group_func_nb`, and `*pre_segment_args`, and returns a tuple that is passed to
    `order_func_nb`, `post_order_func_nb`, and `post_segment_func_nb`.

    This is the appropriate place to adjust the call sequence or set the valuation price.
    Group re-valuation and updates of open position stats occur immediately after this function
    executes, regardless of whether it is called.

    !!! note
        To change the call sequence of a segment, modify
        [SegmentContext.call_seq_now](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext.call_seq_now "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext.call_seq_now") in-place.
        Avoid creating new arrays to prevent performance degradation.
        Assigning a new context is not supported.

    !!! note
        You can override elements of `last_val_price` to influence group valuation.
        See [SimulationContext.last_val_price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.last_val_price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.last_val_price").

**```pre_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_segment_func_nb`.

**```post_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostSegmentFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a segment
    if `segment_mask` or `call_post_segment` is True.

    Handles the addition of `cash_earnings`, final group re-valuation, and the final update
    of open position stats.

    Accepts [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_segment_func_nb`, and `*post_segment_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_segment_func_nb`.

**```order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`OrderFunc`
:   Callback function to be called to generate an order.

    Used for generating or skipping an order.

    Accepts [OrderContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.OrderContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.OrderContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_segment_func_nb`, and `*order_args`, and returns [Order](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order").

    !!! note
        If the returned order is rejected, a new order cannot be issued. Ensure that the order
        passes (e.g., by using [try_order_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.try_order_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.try_order_nb")). For greater flexibility, use [from_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb").

**```order_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `order_func_nb`.

**```post_order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostOrderFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after processing an order.

    Accepts [PostOrderContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PostOrderContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.PostOrderContext"), the unpacked output
    from `pre_segment_func_nb`, and `*post_order_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_order_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_order_func_nb`.

**```index```** :&ensp;`Optional[Array1d]`
:   See [SimulationContext.index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.index "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.index").

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   See [SimulationContext.freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.freq "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.freq").

**```open```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   See [SimulationContext.open](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.open "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.open").

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```high```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   See [SimulationContext.high](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.high "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.high").

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```low```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   See [SimulationContext.low](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.low "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.low").

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```close```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   See [SimulationContext.close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.close "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.close").

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```bm_close```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   See [SimulationContext.bm_close](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.bm_close "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.bm_close").

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

**```sim_start```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`

    Provided as a scalar or per group.

**```ffill_val_price```** :&ensp;`bool`

__Returns__

`SimulationOutput`
:   Simulation output containing order records, log records, and
    other simulation results.

__Examples__

Example below demonstrates simulating a portfolio of three assets sharing $100,
rebalanced every second tick, with all processing performed in Numba:

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *

>>> @njit
... def pre_sim_func_nb(c):
...     print('before simulation')
...     # Create a temporary array and pass it down the stack
...     order_value_out = np.empty(c.target_shape[1], dtype=float_)
...     return (order_value_out,)

>>> @njit
... def pre_group_func_nb(c, order_value_out):
...     print('\tbefore group', c.group)
...     # Forward down the stack (you can omit pre_group_func_nb entirely)
...     return (order_value_out,)

>>> @njit
... def pre_segment_func_nb(c, order_value_out, size, price, size_type, direction):
...     print('\t\tbefore segment', c.i)
...     for col in range(c.from_col, c.to_col):
...         # Here we use order price for group valuation
...         c.last_val_price[col] = vbt.pf_nb.select_from_col_nb(c, col, price)
...
...     # Reorder call sequence of this segment such that selling orders come first and buying last
...     # Rearranges c.call_seq_now based on order value (size, size_type, direction, and val_price)
...     # Utilizes flexible indexing using select_from_col_nb (as we did above)
...     vbt.pf_nb.sort_call_seq_nb(
...         c,
...         size,
...         size_type,
...         direction,
...         order_value_out[c.from_col:c.to_col]
...     )
...     # Forward nothing
...     return ()

>>> @njit
... def order_func_nb(c, size, price, size_type, direction, fees, fixed_fees, slippage):
...     print('\t\t\tcreating order', c.call_idx, 'at column', c.col)
...     # Create and returns an order
...     return vbt.pf_nb.order_nb(
...         size=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, size),
...         price=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, price),
...         size_type=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, size_type),
...         direction=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, direction),
...         fees=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, fees),
...         fixed_fees=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, fixed_fees),
...         slippage=vbt.pf_nb.select_nb(c, slippage)
...     )

>>> @njit
... def post_order_func_nb(c):
...     print('\t\t\t\torder status:', c.order_result.status)
...     return None

>>> @njit
... def post_segment_func_nb(c):
...     print('\t\tafter segment', c.i)
...     return None

>>> @njit
... def post_group_func_nb(c, order_value_out):
...     print('\tafter group', c.group)
...     return None

>>> @njit
... def post_sim_func_nb(c, order_value_out):
...     print('after simulation')
...     return None

>>> target_shape = (5, 3)
>>> np.random.seed(42)
>>> group_lens = np.array([3])  # one group of three columns
>>> cash_sharing = True
>>> segment_mask = np.array([True, False, True, False, True])[:, None]
>>> price = close = np.random.uniform(1, 10, size=target_shape)
>>> size = np.array([[1 / target_shape[1]]])  # custom flexible arrays must be 2-dim
>>> size_type = np.array([[vbt.pf_enums.SizeType.TargetPercent]])
>>> direction = np.array([[vbt.pf_enums.Direction.LongOnly]])
>>> fees = np.array([[0.001]])
>>> fixed_fees = np.array([[1.]])
>>> slippage = np.array([[0.001]])

>>> sim_out = vbt.pf_nb.from_order_func_nb(
...     target_shape,
...     group_lens,
...     cash_sharing,
...     segment_mask=segment_mask,
...     pre_sim_func_nb=pre_sim_func_nb,
...     post_sim_func_nb=post_sim_func_nb,
...     pre_group_func_nb=pre_group_func_nb,
...     post_group_func_nb=post_group_func_nb,
...     pre_segment_func_nb=pre_segment_func_nb,
...     pre_segment_args=(size, price, size_type, direction),
...     post_segment_func_nb=post_segment_func_nb,
...     order_func_nb=order_func_nb,
...     order_args=(size, price, size_type, direction, fees, fixed_fees, slippage),
...     post_order_func_nb=post_order_func_nb
... )
before simulation
    before group 0
        before segment 0
            creating order 0 at column 0
                order status: 0
            creating order 1 at column 1
                order status: 0
            creating order 2 at column 2
                order status: 0
        after segment 0
        before segment 2
            creating order 0 at column 1
                order status: 0
            creating order 1 at column 2
                order status: 0
            creating order 2 at column 0
                order status: 0
        after segment 2
        before segment 4
            creating order 0 at column 0
                order status: 0
            creating order 1 at column 2
                order status: 0
            creating order 2 at column 1
                order status: 0
        after segment 4
    after group 0
after simulation

>>> pd.DataFrame.from_records(sim_out.order_records)
    id  col  idx       size     price      fees  side
0   0    0    0   7.626262  4.375232  1.033367     0
1   1    0    2   5.210115  1.524275  1.007942     0
2   2    0    4   7.899568  8.483492  1.067016     1
3   0    1    0   3.488053  9.565985  1.033367     0
4   1    1    2   0.920352  8.786790  1.008087     1
5   2    1    4  10.713236  2.913963  1.031218     0
6   0    2    0   3.972040  7.595533  1.030170     0
7   1    2    2   0.448747  6.403625  1.002874     1
8   2    2    4  12.378281  2.639061  1.032667     0

>>> col_map = vbt.rec_nb.col_map_nb(sim_out.order_records['col'], target_shape[1])
>>> asset_flow = vbt.pf_nb.asset_flow_nb(target_shape, sim_out.order_records, col_map)
>>> assets = vbt.pf_nb.assets_nb(asset_flow)
>>> asset_value = vbt.pf_nb.asset_value_nb(close, assets)
>>> vbt.Scatter(data=asset_value).fig.show()
```

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_nb_example.dark.svg#only-dark){: .iimg loading=lazy }

Note that the last order in a group with cash sharing is always disadvantaged
because it receives slightly fewer funds due to costs not accounted for during valuation.

## from_order_func_rw_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_order_func.py#L1864-L2952)

```python
from_order_func_rw_nb(
    target_shape,
    group_lens,
    cash_sharing,
    call_seq=None,
    init_cash=100.0,
    init_position=0.0,
    init_price=nan,
    cash_deposits=0.0,
    cash_earnings=0.0,
    segment_mask=True,
    call_pre_segment=False,
    call_post_segment=False,
    pre_sim_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_sim_args=(),
    post_sim_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_sim_args=(),
    pre_row_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_row_args=(),
    post_row_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_row_args=(),
    pre_segment_func_nb=no_pre_func_nb,
    pre_segment_args=(),
    post_segment_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_segment_args=(),
    order_func_nb=no_order_func_nb,
    order_args=(),
    post_order_func_nb=no_post_func_nb,
    post_order_args=(),
    index=None,
    freq=None,
    open=nan,
    high=nan,
    low=nan,
    close=nan,
    bm_close=nan,
    sim_start=None,
    sim_end=None,
    ffill_val_price=True,
    update_value=False,
    fill_pos_info=True,
    track_value=True,
    max_order_records=None,
    max_log_records=0,
    in_outputs=None
)
```

Same as [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb"), but iterates in row-major order.

Row-major order processes each row (i.e., all groups/columns) entirely before moving to the next row.

The primary difference from [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb") is that it exposes `pre_row_func_nb` instead
of `pre_group_func_nb`. The `pre_row_func_nb` function is executed for each entire row and must
accept a [RowContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext").

!!! note
    The `pre_row_func_nb` function is only invoked if there is at least one active segment in the row.
    Similarly, `pre_segment_func_nb` and `order_func_nb` are only called if their corresponding segment
    is active. To ensure `pre_row_func_nb` is invoked when its primary task is to manage segment
    activation, all segments should be activated by default.

!!! warning
    You can only safely access data points that are to the left of the current group and
    rows that are above the current row.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Call hierarchy__

```plaintext

1. pre_sim_out = pre_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_args)

    2. pre_row_out = pre_row_func_nb(RowContext, *pre_sim_out, *pre_row_args)
        if call_pre_segment or segment_mask:

            3. pre_segment_out = pre_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_row_out, *pre_segment_args)
        if segment_mask:

            4. order = order_func_nb(OrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *order_args)

            5. post_order_func_nb(PostOrderContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_order_args)
        if call_post_segment or segment_mask:

            6. post_segment_func_nb(SegmentContext, *pre_segment_out, *post_segment_args)

    7. post_row_func_nb(RowContext, *pre_row_out, *post_row_args)

8. post_sim_func_nb(SimulationContext, *pre_sim_out, *post_sim_args)
```

Let's illustrate the same example as in [from_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_order_func_nb") but adapted for this function:

![](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/assets/images/api/from_order_func_rw_nb.svg){: loading=lazy style="width:800px;" }

__Args__

**```group_lens```** :&ensp;`GroupLens`

**```cash_sharing```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   See [SimulationContext.cash_sharing](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.cash_sharing "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.cash_sharing").

**```call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Array2d]`

**```init_cash```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`

**```init_position```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`

**```init_price```** :&ensp;`FlexArray1dLike`
:   See [SimulationContext.init_price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.init_price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.init_price").

    Provided as a scalar or per column.

**```cash_deposits```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column or group with cash sharing, or element.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, group, or element.

:   See [SimulationContext.call_pre_segment](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.call_pre_segment "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.call_pre_segment").

**```pre_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreSimFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before the simulation.

    This function is used for creating global arrays and setting the seed.

    Accepts [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext") and `*pre_sim_args`,
    and returns a tuple that is passed to `pre_row_func_nb` and `post_sim_func_nb`.

**```pre_sim_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_sim_func_nb`.

**```post_sim_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostSimFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after the simulation.

    Accepts [SimulationContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_sim_func_nb`, and `*post_sim_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_sim_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_sim_func_nb`.

**```pre_row_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreRowFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a row.

    Accepts [RowContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_sim_func_nb`, and `*pre_row_args`, and returns a tuple that is passed to
    `pre_segment_func_nb` and `post_row_func_nb`.

**```pre_row_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_row_func_nb`.

**```post_row_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostRowFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a row.

    Accepts [RowContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.RowContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_row_func_nb`, and `*post_row_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_row_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_row_func_nb`.

**```pre_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PreSegmentFunc`
:   Callback function to be called before processing a segment
    if `segment_mask` or `call_pre_segment` is True.

    Accepts [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_row_func_nb`, and `*pre_segment_args`, and returns a tuple that is passed to
    `order_func_nb`, `post_order_func_nb`, and `post_segment_func_nb`.

    This is the appropriate place to adjust the call sequence or set the valuation price.
    Group re-valuation and updates of open position stats occur immediately after this function
    executes, regardless of whether it is called.

    !!! note
        To change the call sequence of a segment, modify
        [SegmentContext.call_seq_now](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext.call_seq_now "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext.call_seq_now") in-place.
        Avoid creating new arrays to prevent performance degradation.
        Assigning a new context is not supported.

    !!! note
        You can override elements of `last_val_price` to influence group valuation.
        See [SimulationContext.last_val_price](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.last_val_price "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SimulationContext.last_val_price").

**```pre_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `pre_segment_func_nb`.

**```post_segment_func_nb```** :&ensp;`PostSegmentFunc`
:   Callback function to be called after processing a segment
    if `segment_mask` or `call_post_segment` is True.

    Handles the addition of `cash_earnings`, final group re-valuation, and the final update
    of open position stats.

    Accepts [SegmentContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.SegmentContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_segment_func_nb`, and `*post_segment_args`, and returns nothing.

**```post_segment_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `post_segment_func_nb`.

**```order_func_nb```** :&ensp;`OrderFunc`
:   Callback function to be called to generate an order.

    Used for generating or skipping an order.

    Accepts [OrderContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.OrderContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.OrderContext"), the unpacked output from
    `pre_segment_func_nb`, and `*order_args`, and returns [Order](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order").

    !!! note
        If the returned order is rejected, a new order cannot be issued. Ensure that the order
        passes (e.g., by using [try_order_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.try_order_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.try_order_nb")). For greater flexibility, use [from_flex_order_func_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/nb/from_order_func/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb "vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_order_func.from_flex_order_func_nb").

**```order_args```** :&ensp;`Args`

## set_val_price_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_order_func.py#L5224-L5255)

```python
set_val_price_nb(
    c,
    val_price,
    price
)
```

Override valuation price in a segment context.

Updates the valuation price in the context using the provided valuation and price arrays.
When a valuation price is positive infinity, the corresponding market price is used.
If that price is also positive infinity, the function falls back to the close or open price.
For a negative infinity valuation price, the last valuation price is retained.

__Args__

**```c```** :&ensp;`SegmentContext`
:   Segment context.

**```val_price```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   Array of valuation prices with special handling for infinity.

**```price```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   Array of current market prices.

__Returns__

`None`
:   Function modifies the context in place.

__Args__

**```c```** :&ensp;`SegmentContext`

:   Array of order sizes.

Generate simulation orders for each element in a column-major order using flexible broadcasting.

This function processes market data and portfolio inputs to create simulation orders and
update simulation state arrays.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

:   Base dimensions (rows, columns).

    Does not apply when the order size is `np.inf`.

:   Indicator whether to raise errors on order rejection.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

    See [Order.raise_reject](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.raise_reject "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.raise_reject").

:   Logging flag.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

    See [Order.log](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.log "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Order.log").

**```val_price```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   Valuation price.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

    See [ValPriceType](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ValPriceType "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.ValPriceType").

    * Any `-np.inf` element is replaced by the latest valuation price
        (using `open` or a previously known value if `ffill_val_price` is True).

    * Any `np.inf` element is replaced by the current order price.

**```from_ago```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2dLike`
:   Lookback offset for price selection.

    Provided as a scalar, or per row, column, or element.

    Negative values are converted to positive to avoid look-ahead bias.

:   Start position of the simulation range (inclusive).

    Provided as a scalar or per group.

**```sim_end```** :&ensp;`Optional[FlexArray1dLike]`
:   End position of the simulation range (exclusive).

    Provided as a scalar or per group.

**```call_seq```** :&ensp;`Optional[Array2d]`
:   Sequence dictating the order in which columns are
    processed per row and group.

**```auto_call_seq```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to automatically sort the call sequence.

**```ffill_val_price```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to forward-fill valuation price.

**```update_value```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to update portfolio value with each order.

**```save_state```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to record the account state.

    See [AccountState](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.AccountState").

**```save_value```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to record the portfolio value.

**```save_returns```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag to record the portfolio returns.

**```skip_empty```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to skip processing when order data is empty.

**```max_order_records```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of order records expected per column.

    Defaults to the number of rows in the broadcasted shape. Set to 0 to disable,
    lower to reduce memory usage, or higher if multiple orders per timestamp are expected.

**```max_log_records```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of log records expected per column.

    Set to the number of rows in the broadcasted shape if logging is enabled. Set lower to
    reduce memory usage, or higher if multiple logs per timestamp are expected.

__Returns__

`SimulationOutput`
:   Simulation output containing order and log records, cash deposits,
    earnings, and other aggregated metrics.

__Examples__

Buy and hold using all cash and close price (default):

```pycon
>>> from vectorbtpro import *
>>> from vectorbtpro.records.nb import col_map_nb
>>> from vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb import from_orders_nb, asset_flow_nb

>>> close = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])[:, None]
>>> sim_out = from_orders_nb(
...     target_shape=close.shape,
...     group_lens=np.array([1]),
...     call_seq=np.full(close.shape, 0),
...     close=close
... )
>>> col_map = col_map_nb(sim_out.order_records['col'], close.shape[1])
>>> asset_flow = asset_flow_nb(close.shape, sim_out.order_records, col_map)
>>> asset_flow
array([[100.],
        [  0.],
        [  0.],
        [  0.],
        [  0.]])
```

# vectorbtpro.portfolio.nb.from_signals | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_signals.py)

Module providing Numba-compiled functions for portfolio simulation based on signals.

## dir_signal_func_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_signals.py#L7811-L7866)

```python
dir_signal_func_nb(
    c,
    entries,
    exits,
    direction,
    from_ago,
    adjust_func_nb=no_adjust_func_nb,
    adjust_args=()
)
```

Generate direction-aware signals by combining entry, exit, and direction arrays.

This function produces a set of boolean signals by taking the signals from the `entries` and
`exits` arrays and routing them based on the corresponding direction found in the `direction` array.
The mapping is as follows:

* For `Direction.LongOnly`: outputs (entry, exit, False, False).

* For `Direction.ShortOnly`: outputs (False, False, entry, exit).

* For other directions: outputs (entry, False, exit, False).

Before computing the signals, the function calls the adjustment function to update the signal context.

__Args__

**```c```** :&ensp;`FSSignalContext`
:   Signal context.

**```entries```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   2D array of boolean entry signals.

**```exits```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   2D array of boolean exit signals.

**```direction```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   Array indicating the order direction.

    See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

**```from_ago```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   2D array used to adjust the time index for signal lookup.

**```adjust_func_nb```** :&ensp;`FSAdjustFunc`
:   Callback function to be called to adjust the context before signal generation.

    Accepts [FSSignalContext](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSignalContext "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.FSSignalContext") and `*adjust_args`, and returns nothing.

**```adjust_args```** :&ensp;`Args`
:   Positional arguments for `adjust_func_nb`.

__Returns__

`Tuple[bool, bool, bool, bool]`
:   Tuple containing booleans representing:

    * long entry signal,

    * long exit signal,

    * short entry signal,

    * short exit signal.

## dir_to_ls_signals_nb | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/portfolio/nb/from_signals.py#L7646-L7713)

```python
dir_to_ls_signals_nb(
    target_shape,
    entries,
    exits,
    direction
)
```

Convert direction-unaware signals into direction-aware signals.

This function converts separate entry and exit signal arrays along with a direction array
into four boolean arrays representing long entries, long exits, short entries, and short exits.
For each signal, if the given direction is `Direction.LongOnly`, the entry and exit signals contribute
only to the long arrays; if the direction is `Direction.ShortOnly`, they contribute to the short arrays;
otherwise, they are allocated as a long entry and a short exit.

!!! tip
    This function is parallelizable.

__Args__

**```target_shape```** :&ensp;`Shape`
:   Base dimensions (rows, columns).

**```entries```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   2D array of boolean entry signals.

**```exits```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   2D array of boolean exit signals.

**```direction```** :&ensp;`FlexArray2d`
:   Array indicating the order direction.

    See [Direction](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/portfolio/enums/#vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction "vectorbtpro.portfolio.enums.Direction").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Array2d, Array2d, Array2d, Array2d]`
:   Tuple containing:

    * long entries,

    * long exits,

    * short entries,

    * short exits.
