## Chunker | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L1293-L2326)

```python
Chunker(
    size=None,
    min_size=None,
    n_chunks=None,
    chunk_len=None,
    chunk_meta=None,
    prepend_chunk_meta=None,
    skip_single_chunk=None,
    arg_take_spec=None,
    template_context=None,
    merge_func=None,
    merge_kwargs=None,
    return_raw_chunks=None,
    silence_warnings=None,
    forward_kwargs_as=None,
    execute_kwargs=None,
    disable=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class responsible for chunking arguments of a function and running the function.

Generates chunk metadata, splits function arguments into chunks, executes chunks,
and optionally merges results.

It performs the following steps:

1. Generates chunk metadata by passing `n_chunks`, `size`, `min_size`, `chunk_len`, and
    `chunk_meta` to [Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args").

2. Splits arguments and keyword arguments by passing chunk metadata, `arg_take_spec`,
    and `template_context` to [Chunker.iter_tasks](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.iter_tasks "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.iter_tasks"), which yields one chunk at a time.

3. Executes all chunks by passing `**execute_kwargs` to [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

4. Optionally, post-processes and merges the results by passing them and `**merge_kwargs` to `merge_func`.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [chunking](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.chunking "vectorbtpro._settings.chunking").

__Args__

**```size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Chunk size used for metadata generation.

    See [Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args").

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of elements to split.

    See [Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args").

**```n_chunks```** :&ensp;`Optional[SizeLike]`
:   Desired number of chunks used in metadata generation.

    See [Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args").

**```chunk_len```** :&ensp;`Optional[SizeLike]`
:   Length of each chunk used in metadata generation.

    See [Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args").

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Optional[ChunkMetaLike]`
:   Custom chunk metadata for argument chunking.

    See [Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args").

**```prepend_chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Determines whether to prepend a [ChunkMeta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ChunkMeta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ChunkMeta") instance to the arguments.

    If set to None, prepending occurs automatically when the first argument is named `chunk_meta`.

**```skip_single_chunk```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Specifies whether to bypass chunking and execute the function
    directly when only one chunk is present.

**```arg_take_spec```** :&ensp;`Optional[ArgTakeSpecLike]`
:   Specification for selecting function arguments during chunking.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```merge_func```** :&ensp;`MergeFuncLike`
:   Function to merge the results.

    See [MergeFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/merging/#vectorbtpro.utils.merging.MergeFunc "vectorbtpro.utils.merging.MergeFunc").

**```merge_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `merge_func`.

**```return_raw_chunks```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Determines whether to return raw chunk data instead
    of post-processed results.

**```silence_warnings```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to suppress warning messages.

**```forward_kwargs_as```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Mapping for renaming keyword arguments when forwarding them.

    Variables from the context of [Chunker.run](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.run "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.run") may be included.

**```execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for the execution handler.

    See [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute").

**```disable```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to disable chunking.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured").

### Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L1576-L1642)

```python
Chunker.get_chunk_meta_from_args(
    ann_args,
    size=None,
    min_size=None,
    n_chunks=None,
    chunk_len=None,
    chunk_meta=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate chunk metadata from annotated arguments.

__Args__

**```ann_args```** :&ensp;`AnnArgs`
:   Annotated arguments.

    See [annotate_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/parsing/#vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args "vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args").

**```size```** :&ensp;`Optional[SizeLike]`
:   Chunk size used for metadata generation.

    It can be an integer, an instance of [Sizer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Sizer "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Sizer"), or a callable that receives the annotated
    arguments and returns a value.

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of elements to split.

**```n_chunks```** :&ensp;`Optional[SizeLike]`
:   Desired number of chunks.

    It can be provided as an integer, a string, an instance of [Sizer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Sizer "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Sizer"), or a callable that
    accepts annotated arguments and keyword arguments.

**```chunk_len```** :&ensp;`Optional[SizeLike]`
:   Length of each chunk.

    It can be provided as an integer, a string, an instance of [Sizer](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Sizer "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Sizer"), or a callable that
    receives the annotated arguments and returns a value.

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Optional[ChunkMetaLike]`
:   Custom chunk metadata.

    It can be an iterable of [ChunkMeta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ChunkMeta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ChunkMeta") instances, a [ChunkMeta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ChunkMeta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.ChunkMeta") generator, or a callable
    returning chunk metadata.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for the metadata generation process.

__Returns__

`Iterable[ChunkMeta]`
:   Iterable of chunk metadata.

### Chunker.iter_tasks | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L1811-L1877)

```python
Chunker.iter_tasks(
    func,
    ann_args,
    chunk_meta,
    arg_take_spec=None,
    template_context=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Split annotated arguments into chunks and yield each chunk as a task.

__Args__

**```func```** :&ensp;`Callable`
:   Callable to execute as a task.

**```ann_args```** :&ensp;`AnnArgs`
:   Annotated arguments.

    See [annotate_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/parsing/#vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args "vectorbtpro.utils.parsing.annotate_args").

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Iterable[ChunkMeta]`
:   Iterable containing metadata for each chunk.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```arg_take_spec```** :&ensp;`Optional[tp.ArgTakeSpecLike]`
:   Specification for chunk-taking.

    It can be a mapping, a sequence (which will be converted into a mapping),
    a callable, or a `CustomTemplate`.

    !!! note
        If a callable, it must accept the same arguments as [Chunker.take_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.take_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.take_from_args")
        except for `arg_take_spec`.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Chunker.take_from_args](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.take_from_args "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.Chunker.take_from_args") or to
    `arg_take_spec` if it is callable.

__Yields__

`Task`
:   Each task containing a chunk of arguments.

:   Input argument.

:   Specification for taking chunks.

    If None or a [NotChunked](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.NotChunked "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.NotChunked") instance, the original argument is returned.

## ContainerTaker | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L817-L864)

```python
ContainerTaker(
```

Class for taking elements from a container using other chunk takers.

### CountSizer.get_obj_size | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L183-L200)

```python
CountSizer.get_obj_size(
    obj,
    single_type=None
)
```

Compute size from a count.

If `single_type` is provided and the object matches it, returns 1;
otherwise, returns the count itself.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Object.

**```single_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[type]`
:   Type of value that is considered single.

__Returns__

`int`
:   Computed size of the object.

### LenSizer.get_obj_size | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L209-L224)

```python
LenSizer.get_obj_size(
    obj,
    single_type=None
)
```

Compute size as the length of a sequence, returning 1 if the object matches
`single_type`; otherwise, return its length.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Object.

**```single_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[type]`
:   Type of value that is considered single.

__Returns__

`int`
:   Computed size of the object.

### SequenceTaker.adapt_cont_take_spec | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L873-L891)

```python
SequenceTaker.adapt_cont_take_spec(
    obj
)
```

Adapt the container take specification for the given sequence.

If the last element is an ellipsis, replace it by repeating the preceding specification
to match the sequence length.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`Sequence`
:   Sequence object.

__Returns__

`ContainerTakeSpec`
:   Adapted container take specification.

### ShapeSizer.get_obj_size | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/chunking.py#L234-L263)

```python
ShapeSizer.get_obj_size(
    obj,
    axis,
    single_type=None
)
```

Compute size along a given axis from a shape-like object.

If `single_type` is provided and the object matches it, returns 1.
Converts an integer input to a tuple, defaults to axis 0 if unspecified for
single-dimensional objects, and returns 0 if the axis is out of bounds.

__Args__

**```obj```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Object.

**```axis```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Axis of the object.

**```single_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[type]`
:   Type of value that is considered single.

__Returns__

`int`
:   Computed size of the object's axis.

# vectorbtpro.utils.colors | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/colors.py)

Module providing utilities for color manipulation, conversion, and adjustment.

## adjust_lightness | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/colors.py#L218-L247)

```python
adjust_lightness(
    color,
    amount=0.7
)
```

Return an RGB color string with adjusted lightness.

__Args__

**```color```** :&ensp;`Any`
:   Color represented as a Matplotlib color string,
    hex string (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA), or RGB/RGBA tuple.

**```amount```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Factor to adjust the lightness.

    Values less than 1 darken the color, while values greater than 1 lighten it.

__Returns__

`str`
:   Adjusted color in `rgb(r,g,b)` format.

## adjust_opacity | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/colors.py#L190-L215)

# vectorbtpro.utils.config | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py)

Module providing utility functions for configuration management.

## ext_settings_paths_config | HybridConfig | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L1285-L1286)

Configuration for currently active extensional settings paths.

Stores tuples of class names and their associated settings paths by unique identifiers.

```python
HybridConfig()
```

## spec_settings_paths_config | HybridConfig | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L1337-L1338)

Configuration for currently active specialized settings paths.

Stores dictionaries of settings paths keyed by unique identifiers. 

In each dictionary, each key represents a path that may point to one or more other paths. 
For instance, a relationship `knowledge` -> `pages` will also consider `pages` settings when 
`knowledge` settings are requested.

```python
HybridConfig()
```

## unsetkey | literal | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L410-L414)

Sentinel value indicating that a key should be removed.

It can still be overridden by another dictionary.

## convert_to_dict | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L83-L112)

```python
convert_to_dict(
    dct,
    nested=True
)
```

Convert a configuration object to a dictionary.

!!! note
    When the input is an instance of [AtomicConfig](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.AtomicConfig "vectorbtpro.utils.config.AtomicConfig"), it is converted to an [atomic_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.atomic_dict "vectorbtpro.utils.config.atomic_dict").

__Args__

**```dct```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Configuration input to convert.

**```nested```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, recursively convert nested dictionaries.

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Dictionary representing the configuration.

## copy_dict | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L210-L250)

```python
copy_dict(
    dct,
    copy_mode='shallow',
    nested=True
)
```

Copy a dictionary based on the specified copy mode.

__Args__

**```dct```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Input configuration dictionary.

**```copy_mode```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Copying mode.

    Supported modes are:

    * 'none': No copy is performed.

    * 'shallow': Only the dictionary structure is copied.

    * 'hybrid': Keys are copied and values are shallow copied using `copy.copy`.

    * 'deep': Deep copy is performed using `copy.deepcopy`.

**```nested```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, recursively copy nested dictionaries.

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Copy of the input dictionary according to the specified mode.

## merge_dicts | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L443-L531)

```python
merge_dicts(
    *dicts,
    to_dict=True,
    copy_mode='shallow',
    nested=None,
    same_keys=False
)
```

Merge multiple dictionaries into one.

Merge provided dictionaries with optional conversion and copying, and optionally perform
recursive merging of nested dictionaries.

__Args__

**```*dicts```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Dictionaries to merge.

**```to_dict```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to convert each dictionary using [convert_to_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.convert_to_dict "vectorbtpro.utils.config.convert_to_dict") before merging.

**```copy_mode```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Copying mode.

    See [copy_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.copy_dict "vectorbtpro.utils.config.copy_dict").

**```nested```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Whether to recursively merge nested dictionaries.

    If None, the function determines automatically if any dictionary is nested.

**```same_keys```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to merge only overlapping keys.

__Returns__

`dict`
:   Merged dictionary.

## update_dict | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L253-L299)

```python
update_dict(
    x,
    y,
    nested=True,
    force=False,
    same_keys=False
)
```

Update a dictionary with keys and values from another dictionary.

!!! note
    When updating a nested configuration (an instance of [Configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured")), if the corresponding
    value in `y` is a dictionary, the method [Configured.replace](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured.replace "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured.replace") is invoked. Additionally,
    if the child dictionary is not atomic, only its values are copied, not its metadata.

__Args__

**```x```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Target dictionary to update.

**```y```** :&ensp;`DictLike`
:   Source dictionary with values to update.

**```nested```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, recursively update nested dictionaries.

**```force```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, override blocking flags when updating.

**```same_keys```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, only update keys that already exist in the target dictionary.

__Returns__

`None`
:   Dictionary is updated in place.

## Config | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L561-L1194)

```python
Config(
    *args,
    options_=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Configuration class that extends a pickleable dictionary with enhanced configuration features
including nested updates, freezing, and resetting.

__Options__

**```copy_kwargs```** :&ensp;`dict`
:   Keyword arguments used by [copy_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.copy_dict "vectorbtpro.utils.config.copy_dict") when copying the main
    dictionary and `reset_dct`.

    Copy mode defaults to 'none'.

**```reset_dct```** :&ensp;`dict`
:   Fallback dictionary used for resetting.

    If None, the main dictionary is copied using `reset_dct_copy_kwargs`.

    Defaults to None.

    !!! note
        When `readonly` is True, defaults to the main dictionary if set to None.

**```reset_dct_copy_kwargs```** :&ensp;`dict`
:   Keyword arguments that override those in `copy_kwargs`
    for creating `reset_dct`.

    Copy mode defaults to 'none' if `readonly` is True, otherwise 'hybrid'.

**```pickle_reset_dct```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Determines whether `reset_dct` is pickled.

    Defaults to False.

**```frozen_keys```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Denies updates to configuration keys when True.

    Defaults to False.

**```readonly```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Denies updates to both keys and values when True.

    Defaults to False.

**```nested```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Applies operations such as copying, updating, and merging recursively to
    each child dictionary when True.

    Disable this to treat each child dictionary as a single value.

    Defaults to True.

**```convert_children```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, type]`
:   Converts child dictionaries of type [child_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.child_dict "vectorbtpro.utils.config.child_dict") to
    configurations with the same settings if True or if set to a [Config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Config "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Config") subclass.

    This triggers a waterfall conversion across all child dictionaries.
    Existing configurations are not converted. Requires `nested` to be True.

    Defaults to False.

**```as_attrs```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Enables accessing dictionary keys via dot notation when True.

    This provides autocompletion at runtime but raises an error in the event of naming conflicts.
    To allow nested dictionaries to be accessed via dot notation, wrap them with [child_dict](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.child_dict "vectorbtpro.utils.config.child_dict")
    and ensure both `convert_children` and `nested` are True.

    Defaults to True if `frozen_keys` or `readonly` is True, otherwise False.

**```override_keys```** :&ensp;`Set[str]`
:   Specifies keys that can override attribute names when `as_attrs` is True.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `options` in [config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.config "vectorbtpro._settings.config").

    If another configuration is provided, its properties will be copied, but they can be overridden
    by arguments passed during initialization.

!!! note
    All arguments are applied only once during initialization.

__Args__

**```*args```**
:   Positional arguments for `dict`.

**```options_```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration options.

    See details below.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `dict`.

## Configured | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L2048-L2367)

```python
Configured(
    **config
)
```

Class representing a configured object.

All subclasses of [Configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured") are initialized using [Config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Config "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Config"), which facilitates
pickling and configuration merging.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.configured "vectorbtpro._settings.configured").

!!! warning
    If any attribute is overwritten that is not listed in `Configured._writeable_attrs`,
    or if any [Configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured") argument depends on global defaults, those values will
    not be copied. Pass them explicitly to ensure the saved, loaded, or copied instance
    remains resilient to changes in globals.

__Args__

**```**config```**
:   Keyword arguments for initialization configuration.

Create a new instance with a modified configuration.

    writable attributes (or their copies, depending on `copy_mode_`) rather than a direct
    copy of the current instance.

:   Whether to copy writable attributes.

:   New instance with the updated configuration.

### HasSettings.resolve_setting | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/config.py#L1836-L1891)

## auto_detect_freq | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1824-L1841)

```python
auto_detect_freq(
    index
)
```

Determine the frequency of a datetime index based on consecutive differences.

If the minimal interval occurs in more than half of the transitions, returns that interval;
otherwise, returns None.

__Args__

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Pandas datetime index.

__Returns__

`Optional[PandasFrequency]`
:   Detected frequency or None.

## date_range | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1601-L1688)

```python
date_range(
    start=None,
    end=None,
    *,
    periods=None,
    freq=None,
    tz=None,
    inclusive='left',
    timestamp_kwargs=None,
    freq_kwargs=None,
    timezone_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Generate a DatetimeIndex similar to `pd.date_range` with preprocessed parameters.

Preprocesses the following:

* Converts `start` and `end` using [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

* Converts `freq` using [to_freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_freq "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_freq").

* Converts `tz` using [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

Applies default values:

* If both `start` and `periods` are None, sets `start` to the Unix epoch start.

* If both `end` and `periods` are None, sets `end` to the current datetime.

* If `periods` is provided but both `start` and `end` are None, sets `start` to the Unix epoch start.

__Args__

**```start```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   Start of the date range.

**```end```** :&ensp;`Optional[DatetimeLike]`
:   End of the date range.

**```periods```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of periods to generate.

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Frequency representation (string, offset, or timedelta).

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

**```inclusive```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Whether to include the start and/or end date in the range.

**```timestamp_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [to_timestamp](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timestamp").

**```freq_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [to_freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_freq "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_freq").

**```timezone_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for [to_timezone](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.to_timezone").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.date_range`.

__Returns__

`DatetimeIndex`
:   Generated datetime index.

## get_dt_index_gaps | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1957-L2011)

```python
get_dt_index_gaps(
    index,
    freq=None,
    skip_index=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Identify gaps in a datetime index.

The function determines gaps in a datetime index and returns two indexes:

* Start indexes (inclusive) where gaps begin.

* End indexes (exclusive) where gaps end.

Keyword arguments are passed to [prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.prepare_dt_index").

__Args__

**```index```** :&ensp;`IndexLike`
:   Index or index-like object with datetime values.

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Frequency representation (string, offset, or timedelta).

**```skip_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Index of datetime values to skip.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [prepare_dt_index](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.prepare_dt_index "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.prepare_dt_index").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Index, Index]`
:   Tuple containing the start and end indexes of the detected gaps.

## get_min_td_component | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1369-L1405)

```python
get_min_td_component(
    td
)
```

Return the index of the smallest non-zero component in a Pandas Timedelta.

The component mapping is:

* days: 0

* hours: 1

* minutes: 2

* seconds: 3

* milliseconds: 4

* microseconds: 5

* nanoseconds: 6

Returns -1 if all components are zero.

__Args__

**```td```** :&ensp;`PandasTimedelta`
:   Pandas Timedelta object.

__Returns__

`int`
:   Index of the smallest non-zero component, or -1.

## infer_index_freq | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1887-L1954)

```python
infer_index_freq(
    index,
    freq=None,
    allow_offset=True,
    allow_numeric=True,
    freq_from_n=None
)
```

Infer or convert the frequency for a datetime index.

If `freq` is None, the frequency is inferred using [parse_index_freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.parse_index_freq "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.parse_index_freq"). If a string is provided:

* If the string is "auto", the frequency is detected with [auto_detect_freq](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.auto_detect_freq "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.auto_detect_freq").

* If the string starts with "index_", the corresponding method (obtained after stripping the prefix)
    is applied to the differences between consecutive index values.

If `freq_from_n` is an integer (positive or negative), the index is limited to the first or last
N elements respectively.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [datetime](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.datetime "vectorbtpro._settings.datetime").

__Args__

**```index```** :&ensp;`Index`
:   Pandas datetime index.

**```freq```** :&ensp;`Optional[FrequencyLike]`
:   Frequency representation (string, offset, or timedelta).

**```allow_offset```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to allow returning an offset.

**```allow_numeric```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to permit numeric frequency values.

**```freq_from_n```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Limit for inferring frequency from a subset of the index.

__Returns__

`Union[None, int, float, PandasFrequency]`
:   Inferred or converted frequency.

## prepare_dt_index | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1691-L1780)

```python
prepare_dt_index(
    index,
    parse_index=None,
    parse_with_dateparser=None,
    dateparser_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Convert `index` to a DatetimeIndex if possible.

If `index` has an object dtype and `parse_index` is enabled, it attempts parsing with `pd.to_datetime`.
When `parse_with_dateparser` is True, a fallback using `dateparser.parse` is applied.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [datetime](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.datetime "vectorbtpro._settings.datetime").

__Args__

**```index```** :&ensp;`IndexLike`
:   Input index to convert.

**```parse_index```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to convert the index to a datetime index with `pd.to_datetime`.

**```parse_with_dateparser```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to enable parsing with the dateparser library.

**```dateparser_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `dateparser.parse`.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.to_datetime`.

__Returns__

`Index`
:   Converted index, which will be a DatetimeIndex if conversion succeeded.

## prepare_offset_str | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L198-L391)

```python
prepare_offset_str(
    offset_str,
    allow_space=False
)
```

Prepare a normalized frequency offset string.

Splits the input on commas, semicolons, and, if allowed, whitespace, then normalizes each frequency
part to a standardized notation. Returns the normalized parts as a space-separated string.

__Args__

**```offset_str```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Frequency offset string to normalize.

    Use commas, semicolons, or spaces (if allowed) to separate multiple units.

**```allow_space```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Allows splitting by whitespace in addition to commas and semicolons if True.

__Returns__

`str`
:   Space-separated string of normalized frequency parts.

## readable_datetime | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1408-L1490)

## split_freq_str | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L133-L195)

```python
split_freq_str(
    freq_str,
    sharp_mapping=None,
    fuzzy_mapping=None
)
```

Split a human-readable frequency string into a multiplier and a standardized frequency unit.

The input string should contain an optional numeric multiplier followed by a frequency unit.
The function strips any whitespace and extracts this information using a regular expression.
It then attempts to map the provided unit to a standardized representation using the following order:

* Custom case-sensitive mapping (`sharp_mapping`) if provided.

* Internal sharp frequency mapping ([sharp_freq_str_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.sharp_freq_str_config "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.sharp_freq_str_config")).

* Custom case-insensitive mapping (`fuzzy_mapping`) if provided.

* Internal fuzzy frequency mapping ([fuzzy_freq_str_config](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.fuzzy_freq_str_config "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_.fuzzy_freq_str_config")).

If no mapping is found or if the unit is unrecognized, the original unit is retained.
The resulting tuple can be used to construct time offsets or timedelta objects.

__Args__

**```freq_str```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Frequency string in the format "<multiplier><unit>".

**```sharp_mapping```** :&ensp;`MappingLike`
:   Custom case-sensitive mapping for frequency units.

**```fuzzy_mapping```** :&ensp;`MappingLike`
:   Custom case-insensitive mapping for frequency units.

__Returns__

`Optional[Tuple[int, str]]`
:   Tuple containing the multiplier and the standardized frequency unit,
    or None if the input does not match the expected format.

## to_timestamp | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1148-L1254)

```python
to_timestamp(
    dt='now',
    parse_with_dateparser=None,
    dateparser_kwargs=None,
    unit='ns',
    tz=None,
    to_fixed_offset=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Parse the given datetime input as a `pd.Timestamp`.

If `dt` is a string, parsing is attempted with Pandas and with dateparser if
`parse_with_dateparser` is True. For numerical inputs, `dt` is interpreted using the specified `unit`.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [datetime](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.datetime "vectorbtpro._settings.datetime").

__Args__

**```dt```** :&ensp;`DatetimeLike`
:   Datetime input to parse.

    Can be a string, number, or datetime-like object.

**```parse_with_dateparser```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to enable parsing with the dateparser library.

**```dateparser_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `dateparser.parse`.

**```unit```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Unit of time for numerical timestamps.

**```tz```** :&ensp;`TimezoneLike`
:   Timezone specification (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York").

**```to_fixed_offset```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to convert the timezone to a fixed offset.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for `pd.Timestamp`.

__Returns__

`Timestamp`
:   Parsed and timezone-adjusted timestamp.

## to_timezone | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_.py#L1082-L1145)

# vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_nb | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/datetime_nb.py)

Datetime component status enumeration.

Status codes returned by [within_fixed_dtc_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_nb/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_nb.within_fixed_dtc_nb "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_nb.within_fixed_dtc_nb") and [within_periodic_dtc_nb](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/datetime_nb/#vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_nb.within_periodic_dtc_nb "vectorbtpro.utils.datetime_nb.within_periodic_dtc_nb").

```python
DTCST(
    SU=-3,
    EU=-2,
    U=-1,
    O=0,
    I=1
)
```

__Fields__

**```SU```**
:   Start matched; remaining components are unspecified.

**```EU```**
:   End matched; remaining components are unspecified.

**```U```**
:   Unknown status.

**```O```**
:   Outside.

**```I```**
:   Inside.

# vectorbtpro.utils.decorators | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/decorators.py)

Module providing class and function decorators.

## cacheable | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/decorators.py#L385-L462)

```python
cacheable(
    *args,
    use_cache=False,
    whitelist=False,
    max_size=None,
    ignore_args=None,
    **options
)
```

Decorate a function to enable caching functionality.

See notes on [cacheable_property](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/decorators/#vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cacheable_property "vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cacheable_property").

!!! note
    To decorate an instance method, use [cacheable_method](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/decorators/#vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cacheable_method "vectorbtpro.utils.decorators.cacheable_method").

!!! info
    For default settings, see [caching](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.caching "vectorbtpro._settings.caching").

__Args__

**```func```** :&ensp;`Callable`
:   Function to be decorated.

**```use_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to use caching.

**```whitelist```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to whitelist the function.

**```max_size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum size of the cache.

**```ignore_args```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[AnnArgQuery]]`
:   Arguments to ignore for caching.

**```**options```**
:   Configuration options for the function.

__Returns__

`Union[Callable, cacheable_function]`
:   Decorated function with caching enabled.

# vectorbtpro.utils.enum_ | module | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/enum_.py)

Module providing utilities for mapping between enum fields and values.

In vectorbtpro, enums are implemented as named tuple instances to facilitate their use with Numba.
Enum values start at 0, and a value of -1 indicates an undefined enum.

## map_enum_fields | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/enum_.py#L25-L46)

```python
    field,
    enum,
    enum_unkval=-1,

)
```

## JupyterKernel | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/eval_.py#L153-L418)

```python
JupyterKernel(
    startup_timeout=60,
    nocolor=True,
    **manager_kwargs
)
```

Lightweight wrapper class around an IPython kernel process.

__Args__

**```startup_timeout```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Seconds to wait for the kernel to become ready.

**```nocolor```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to disable color output.

**```**manager_kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for the kernel manager.

__Examples__

```pycon
>>> with vbt.JupyterKernel() as kernel:
...     output = kernel.execute("print('Hello, world!')")
...     print(output)
Hello, world!

...     output = kernel.execute("a = 2 + 2")
...     print(output)

...     output = kernel.execute("a")
...     print(output)
4
...     output = kernel.execute("1 / 0")
...     print(output)
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
...     kernel.execute("1 / 0", raise_on_error=True)
Traceback (most recent call last):
...
KernelExecutionError: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
```

### JupyterKernel.collect_output | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/eval_.py#L252-L306)

```python
JupyterKernel.collect_output(
    parent_msg_id,
    msg_timeout,
    raise_on_error=False
)
```

Aggregate all messages produced by a single kernel execution.

__Args__

**```parent_msg_id```** :&ensp;`str`
:   `msg_id` returned by `jupyter_client.KernelClient.execute`.

    Only messages whose `parent_header.msg_id` matches this ID are collected.

**```msg_timeout```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Seconds to wait between `IOPub` messages.

    None waits indefinitely.

**```raise_on_error```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to raise an error if the kernel execution fails.

__Returns__

`str`
:   Newline-joined string containing stdout/stderr, `repr` representations, and tracebacks.

    Rich MIME outputs are represented by placeholder stubs such as `<image/png: bytes>`
    so that all content is surfaced as text.

### JupyterKernel.execute | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/eval_.py#L308-L361)

```python
JupyterKernel.execute(
    code,
    silent=False,
    exec_timeout=None,
    interrupt_grace=5.0,
    msg_timeout=None,
    raise_on_error=False
)
```

Run Python code inside the managed kernel.

__Args__

**```code```** :&ensp;`str`
:   Python source to execute.

**```silent```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, the kernel will not increment its execution counter.

    This does not affect captured output.

**```exec_timeout```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Seconds to wait for the code execution to complete.

    None means no timeout.

**```interrupt_grace```** :&ensp;`float`
:   Seconds to wait for the kernel to gracefully interrupt the execution.

**```msg_timeout```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Seconds to wait between `IOPub` messages.

    None waits indefinitely.

**```raise_on_error```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Whether to raise an error if the kernel execution fails.

__Returns__

`str`
:   Combined textual output from the cell, including prints, returned `repr` values,
    and full tracebacks on error.

## execute | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L3178-L3251)

```python
execute(
    tasks,
    size=None,
    keys=None,
    executor=None,
    replace_executor=None,
    merge_to_engine_config=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Execute functions and their arguments using [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor").

Executes the provided tasks by initializing or reusing an executor.
Keyword arguments that are not expected by [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") or `engine_config`
may be merged into `engine_config` if `merge_to_engine_config` is True.

If an executor instance is supplied and `replace_executor` is True, creates a new
[Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") instance by updating non-None parameters.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

__Args__

**```tasks```** :&ensp;`TasksLike`
:   Tasks (i.e., functions with their arguments) to execute.

**```size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Number of tasks to run concurrently.

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Identifiers corresponding to each task.

**```executor```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[Executor]]`
:   [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") class or instance used for executing iterations.

    If None, a default executor is selected from the configuration.

**```replace_executor```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to create a new [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") instance by replacing non-None
    arguments when additional options are provided.

**```merge_to_engine_config```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether keyword arguments not
    matching [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") keys should be merged into its `engine_config`.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") or merged into `engine_config`.

__Returns__

`MergeableResults`
:   Merged results from executing the tasks.

## filter_out_no_results | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L161-L199)

```python
filter_out_no_results(
    objs,
    keys=_Missing.MISSING,
    raise_error=True
)
```

Filter out [NoResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult") sentinel values from a collection of objects and adjust associated keys.

__Args__

**```objs```** :&ensp;`Iterable[Any]`
:   Sequence of objects to filter.

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[Index]`
:   Sequence of keys corresponding to the objects.

**```raise_error```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, raise a [NoResultsException](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResultsException "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResultsException") when no valid objects remain after filtering.

__Returns__

`Union[List[Any], Tuple[List[Any], Optional[Index]]]`
:       If `keys` is provided, returns a tuple of the filtered objects and the corresponding filtered keys.
    Otherwise, returns the list of filtered objects.

## iterated | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L3313-L3480)

```python
iterated(
    *args,
    over_arg=None,
    executor=None,
    replace_executor=None,
    merge_to_engine_config=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Return a decorator that executes a function iteratively using an [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor").

This decorator creates a new function with the same signature as the original.

The decorated function is executed iteratively for each element in an iterable determined
by a specified argument. If `over_arg` is None, the first positional argument is used as the iterable.

The executor options can be adjusted via the `options` attribute of the wrapper or by providing
keyword arguments prefixed with an underscore. Explicit iteration keys and size can be provided
as `_keys` and `_size` when the range-like object is an iterator.

Keyword arguments not matching [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") keys are merged into its `engine_config` if
`merge_to_engine_config` is True; otherwise, they are passed directly to [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor").

If an executor instance is provided and `replace_executor` is True, a new [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") instance
is created with non-None parameters replaced.

If the decorated function returns [NoResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult"), the current iteration is skipped and its index
is removed from the final result.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

__Args__

**```func```** :&ensp;`Callable`
:   Function to be decorated.

**```over_arg```** :&ensp;`Optional[AnnArgQuery]`
:   Query specifying which argument to iterate over.

    If None, the first positional argument is used.

**```executor```** :&ensp;`Optional[MaybeType[Executor]]`
:   [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") class or instance used for executing iterations.

    If None, a default executor is selected from the configuration.

**```replace_executor```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to create a new [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") instance by replacing non-None
    arguments when additional options are provided.

**```merge_to_engine_config```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether keyword arguments not
    matching [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") keys should be merged into its `engine_config`.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor") or the decorated function.

__Returns__

`Callable`
:   Wrapper function that executes the original function iteratively.

## parse_iterable_and_keys | function | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L3254-L3310)

```python
parse_iterable_and_keys(
    iterable_like,
    keys=None
)
```

Parse the iterable and keys from the provided objects.

Converts an iterable-like object into a standard iterable and derives associated keys if needed.
If an integer is provided, it is interpreted as a range. For dictionaries, Pandas Index, or
Pandas Series, keys are derived from their inherent structure. Otherwise, if the iterable is a
sequence and keys are not provided, keys are extracted using [index_from_values](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/indexes/#vectorbtpro.base.indexes.index_from_values "vectorbtpro.base.indexes.index_from_values")
to avoid unnecessary materialization.

__Args__

**```iterable_like```** :&ensp;`Union[int, Iterable]`
:   Integer representing a total count or an iterable of values.

    If an integer is provided, it is interpreted as a range.

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Keys-like object used to index the iterable.

    If not provided and the iterable is a dictionary, Pandas Index, or Pandas Series,
    the keys are derived from the object.

    Otherwise, if the iterable is a sequence, keys are extracted using
    [index_from_values](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/base/indexes/#vectorbtpro.base.indexes.index_from_values "vectorbtpro.base.indexes.index_from_values").

__Returns__

`Tuple[Iterable, Optional[Index]]`
:   Tuple containing the iterable values and the
    derived or provided keys.

:   Result of executing the function.

```python
ExecutionEngine.execute(
    tasks,
    size=None,
    keys=None
)
```

Execute a collection of tasks.

!!! abstract
    This method should be overridden in a subclass.

__Args__

**```tasks```** :&ensp;`TasksLike`
:   Tasks (i.e., functions with their arguments) to execute.

**```size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Hint for the number of tasks, useful if `tasks` is a generator.

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Keys associated with each task.

__Returns__

`ExecResults`
:   Results of executing the tasks.

## Executor | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L1182-L3175)

```python
Executor(
    engine=None,
    engine_config=None,
    min_size=None,
    n_chunks=None,
    chunk_len=None,
    chunk_meta=None,
    distribute=None,
    warmup=None,
    in_chunk_order=None,
    cache_chunks=None,
    chunk_cache_dir=None,
    chunk_cache_save_kwargs=None,
    chunk_cache_load_kwargs=None,
    pre_clear_chunk_cache=None,
    post_clear_chunk_cache=None,
    release_chunk_cache=None,
    chunk_clear_cache=None,
    chunk_collect_garbage=None,
    chunk_delay=None,
    pre_execute_func=None,
    pre_execute_kwargs=None,
    pre_chunk_func=None,
    pre_chunk_kwargs=None,
    post_chunk_func=None,
    post_chunk_kwargs=None,
    post_execute_func=None,
    post_execute_kwargs=None,
    post_execute_on_sorted=None,
    filter_results=None,
    raise_no_results=None,
    merge_func=None,
    merge_kwargs=None,
    template_context=None,
    show_progress=None,
    pbar_kwargs=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for executing functions using configurable execution engines and flexible task distribution.

The supported values for `engine` include:

* Name of the engine: Specifies the engine by name (see supported engines).

* Subclass of [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine"): Instantiated with `engine_config`.

* Instance of [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine"): Uses its [execute](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.execute") method with `size`.

* Callable: Invoked with `tasks`, `size` (if provided), and `engine_config`.

Execution supports chunking. If `chunk_meta` is provided, tasks are executed per chunk.
Otherwise, if either `n_chunks` or `chunk_len` is set, they are passed to
[iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta") to generate `chunk_meta`. Global defaults for
`n_chunks` and `chunk_len` can be configured in engine-specific settings; they may also be set to
"auto" to match the number of cores.

For task distribution:

* When `distribute` is "tasks", tasks within each chunk are distributed. If `tasks` is an iterable
    and `chunk_meta` indices are sorted, iteration occurs directly over `tasks`; otherwise, iteration
    occurs over `chunk_meta`. If `in_chunk_order` is True, results follow the order in `chunk_meta`;
    otherwise, they follow the order in `tasks`.

* When `distribute` is "chunks", chunks are distributed, and tasks within each chunk are executed
    serially via [Executor.execute_serially](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor.execute_serially "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor.execute_serially"). Each chunk is compressed so that each unique function and
    its arguments are serialized only once.

If `tasks` is a custom template, it is substituted once `chunk_meta` is established using
`template_context`. All resolved functions and arguments are then passed to the executor.

Optional callbacks:

* `pre_chunk_func`: Called before processing a chunk. If it returns a non-None value, that value is
    appended to the results and the chunk is not executed. This behavior facilitates caching.

* `post_chunk_func`: Called after processing a chunk. Should return either None to keep previous
    results or new execution results. Templates in `pre_chunk_kwargs` and `post_chunk_kwargs` are
    substituted and passed as keyword arguments.

!!! note
    Both callbacks are effective only when `distribute` is "tasks" and chunking is enabled.

Additional context includes:

* `chunk_idx`: Current chunk index.

* `call_indices`: List of call indices in the chunk.

* `chunk_cache`: Call results from caching (for `pre_chunk_func`).

* `call_results`: Execution results (for `post_chunk_func`).

* `chunk_executed`: Indicates if the chunk was executed (for `post_chunk_func`).

Optional overall execution callbacks:

* `pre_execute_func`: Called before processing all tasks. Must return None.
    Receives, among others, the number of chunks (`n_chunks`) in its context.

* `post_execute_func`: Called after processing all tasks. Should return either None to retain default
    results or new results. Its context includes the number of chunks (`n_chunks`) and the flattened
    list of results (`results`). If `post_execute_on_sorted` is True, this callback is executed after
    sorting the call indices.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

__Args__

**```engine```** :&ensp;`Optional[ExecutionEngineLike]`
:   Execution engine.

**```engine_config```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Configuration for the execution engine.

**```min_size```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Minimum number of elements to split.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```n_chunks```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, str]`
:   Specification for the number of chunks.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```chunk_len```** :&ensp;`Union[None, int, str]`
:   Specification for the length of each chunk.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```chunk_meta```** :&ensp;`Optional[Iterable[ChunkMeta]]`
:   Iterable containing metadata for each chunk.

    See [iter_chunk_meta](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/chunking/#vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta "vectorbtpro.utils.chunking.iter_chunk_meta").

**```distribute```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Distribution mode.

    * "tasks": Distributes tasks within each chunk.

    * "chunks": Distributes chunks.

**```warmup```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to execute the first task
    as a warmup before distribution.

    This is useful for engines that require a warmup run to optimize performance.

**```in_chunk_order```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag that determines whether results are returned
    in the order specified by `chunk_meta`.

    Otherwise, results follow the order of `tasks`.

**```cache_chunks```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether chunks should be cached.

**```chunk_cache_dir```** :&ensp;`Optional[PathLike]`
:   Directory for storing chunk cache files.

**```chunk_cache_save_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for saving chunk cache.

    See [save](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pickling/#vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.save "vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.save").

**```chunk_cache_load_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for loading chunk cache.

    See [load](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pickling/#vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.load "vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.load").

**```pre_clear_chunk_cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating if the chunk cache directory should
    be removed before execution.

**```post_clear_chunk_cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating if the chunk cache directory should
    be removed after execution.

**```release_chunk_cache```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag that replaces the chunk cache with dummy objects
    after execution and loads the full cache after all chunks complete.

**```chunk_clear_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Specifies whether the global cache should
    be cleared after each chunk or every n chunks.

**```chunk_collect_garbage```** :&ensp;`Union[None, bool, int]`
:   Specifies whether garbage collection should
    be performed after each chunk or every n chunks.

**```chunk_delay```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Delay in seconds after processing each chunk.

**```pre_execute_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to be called before executing all tasks.

**```pre_execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `pre_execute_func`.

**```pre_chunk_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to be called before executing each chunk.

    If the callable returns a value other than None, its return value is appended to
    the results and the chunk is skipped.

**```pre_chunk_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `pre_chunk_func`.

**```post_chunk_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to be called after executing each chunk.

    If it returns None, the existing chunk results are retained; otherwise, its return
    value replaces them.

**```post_chunk_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `post_chunk_func`.

**```post_execute_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to be called after executing all tasks.

    If it returns None, the default results are preserved; otherwise, its return value replaces them.

**```post_execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `post_execute_func`.

**```post_execute_on_sorted```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether `post_execute_func` should
    be invoked after sorting call indices.

**```filter_results```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to filter
    [NoResult](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResult") results after execution.

**```raise_no_results```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to raise a
    [NoResultsException](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResultsException "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.NoResultsException") exception if no results remain.

    This flag applies only when `filter_results` is True and is forwarded to the merging
    function if pre-configured.

**```merge_func```** :&ensp;`MergeFuncLike`
:   Function to merge the results.

    See [MergeFunc](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/merging/#vectorbtpro.utils.merging.MergeFunc "vectorbtpro.utils.merging.MergeFunc").

**```merge_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `merge_func`.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

    If `engine` accepts `show_progress` and the key is absent in `engine_config`,
    it is forwarded to the engine.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the progress bar.

    See [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [Configured](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/config/#vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured "vectorbtpro.utils.config.Configured").

### Executor.call_post_chunk_func | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L2368-L2468)

```python
Executor.call_post_chunk_func(
    chunk_idx,
    call_indices,
    call_results,
    cache_chunks=False,
    chunk_cache_dir=None,
    chunk_cache_save_kwargs=None,
    release_chunk_cache=False,
    chunk_clear_cache=False,
    chunk_collect_garbage=False,
    chunk_delay=None,
    post_chunk_func=None,
    post_chunk_kwargs=None,
    chunk_executed=True,
    template_context=None
)
```

Call post-chunk function from [Executor](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.Executor"), managing cache saving, resource cleanup,
and optional post-processing.

__Args__

**```chunk_idx```** :&ensp;`int`
:   Index of the current chunk.

**```call_indices```** :&ensp;`List[int]`
:   Indices corresponding to the calls within the chunk.

**```call_results```** :&ensp;`ExecResults`
:   Results obtained from executing the chunk.

**```cache_chunks```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether chunk caching is enabled.

**```chunk_cache_dir```** :&ensp;`Optional[PathLike]`
:   Directory for saving or loading cached chunks;
    required if caching is enabled.

**```chunk_cache_save_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for saving chunk cache.

    See [save](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pickling/#vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.save "vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.save").

**```release_chunk_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, release the chunk cache by substituting dummy data after saving.

**```chunk_clear_cache```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, int]`
:   Determines whether to clear the cache immediately or
    after a specified number of chunks.

**```chunk_collect_garbage```** :&ensp;`Union[bool, int]`
:   Determines whether to collect garbage immediately
    or after a specified number of chunks.

**```chunk_delay```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Delay in seconds after processing the chunk.

**```post_chunk_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to be called after executing each chunk.

    If it returns None, the existing chunk results are retained; otherwise, its return
    value replaces them.

**```post_chunk_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `post_chunk_func`.

**```chunk_executed```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Indicates if the chunk was executed.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

__Returns__

`ExecResults`
:   Updated call results after post-chunk processing.

### Executor.call_post_execute_func | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L2470-L2542)

and optionally post-processing overall execution results.

__Args__

**```results```** :&ensp;`ExecResults`
:   Initial execution results.

**```cache_chunks```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether chunk caching is enabled.

**```chunk_cache_dir```** :&ensp;`Optional[PathLike]`
:   Directory for cached chunks; required if caching is enabled.

**```chunk_cache_load_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for loading chunk cache.

    See [load](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pickling/#vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.load "vectorbtpro.utils.pickling.load").

**```post_clear_chunk_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, clear the chunk cache directory after loading cached results.

**```release_chunk_cache```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   If True, release cached chunk data by replacing with dummy values.

**```post_execute_func```** :&ensp;`Optional[Callable]`
:   Function to be called after executing all tasks.

    If it returns None, the default results are preserved; otherwise, its return value replaces them.

**```post_execute_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `post_execute_func`.

**```template_context```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Additional context for template substitution.

__Returns__

`Optional[ExecResults]`
:   Post-processed execution results if modified; otherwise,
    the aggregated results.

### Executor.execute_serially | static method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L2170-L2190)

```python
Executor.execute_serially(
    tasks,
    id_objs
)
```

Execute tasks sequentially.

Iterates over each task, resolves functions and their arguments using `id_objs`,
and returns a list of results.

__Args__

**```tasks```** :&ensp;`TasksLike`
:   Tasks (i.e., functions with their arguments) to execute.

**```id_objs```** :&ensp;`Dict[int, Any]`
:   Dictionary mapping IDs to objects.

### Executor.resolve_engine | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L2058-L2168)

```python
Executor.resolve_engine(
    engine,
    show_progress=None,
    pbar_kwargs=None,
    **engine_config
)
```

Resolve the engine based on the provided configuration and return the engine along with its name.

This method determines the execution engine from various types including:

* String representing the engine name.

* Subclass or an instance of [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine").

* Callable that processes tasks.

It applies additional configuration such as `show_progress` and `pbar_kwargs` if supported
by the engine. If the engine is a subclass of [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine"), it is instantiated with
the given `engine_config`. If the engine is an instance, it is replaced with updated configuration.
For callables, the engine name is inferred from available settings.

!!! info
    For default settings, see [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

__Args__

**```engine```** :&ensp;`ExecutionEngineLike`
:   Engine specification which can be a string,
    subclass, instance, or callable.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the progress bar.

    See [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```**engine_config```**
:   Additional engine configuration parameters.

__Returns__

`Tuple[Union[ExecutionEngine, Callable], Optional[str]]`
:   Tuple containing
    the resolved engine and its name.

### Executor.run | method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L2606-L3175)

```python
Executor.run(
    tasks,
    size=None,
    keys=None
)
```

Execute tasks with optional chunking, caching, and merging.

Executes a collection of tasks, handling warmup calls, custom chunking, and caching as configured.
Execution may involve filtering of results and subsequent merging using a specified merge function.

__Args__

:   Tasks (i.e., functions with their arguments) to execute.

**```keys```** :&ensp;`Optional[IndexLike]`
:   Index or keys associated with the tasks.

__Returns__

`Union[ExecResults, MergeResult]`
:   Execution results, possibly merged using the provided
    merging function.

## PathosEngine | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L573-L767)

```python
PathosEngine(
    pool_type=None,
    init_kwargs=None,
    timeout=None,
    check_delay=None,
    show_progress=None,
    pbar_kwargs=None,
    hide_inner_progress=None,
    join_pool=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for executing functions using `pathos`.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `engines.pathos` in [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

__Args__

**```pool_type```** :&ensp;`Optional[str]`
:   Pool type used for parallel execution.

**```init_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments used for initializing the pool.

**```timeout```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of seconds to wait.

**```check_delay```** :&ensp;`Optional[float]`
:   Delay in seconds between successive task status checks.

**```show_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to display the progress bar.

**```pbar_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for configuring the progress bar.

    See [ProgressBar](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/pbar/#vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar "vectorbtpro.utils.pbar.ProgressBar").

**```hide_inner_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to hide progress bars
    within individual threads.

**```join_pool```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether the pool should be joined after execution.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine").

## ProcessPoolEngine | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L473-L554)

```python
ProcessPoolEngine(
    init_kwargs=None,
    timeout=None,
    hide_inner_progress=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for executing functions using `ProcessPoolExecutor` from `concurrent.futures`.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `engines.processpool` in [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

__Args__

**```init_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `ProcessPoolExecutor`.

**```timeout```** :&ensp;`Optional[int]`
:   Maximum number of seconds to wait.

**```hide_inner_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to hide progress bars
    within individual threads.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine").

## RayEngine | class | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L932-L1163)

```python
RayEngine(
    restart=None,
    reuse_refs=None,
    del_refs=None,
    shutdown=None,
    init_kwargs=None,
    remote_kwargs=None,
    hide_inner_progress=None,
    **kwargs
)
```

Class for executing functions in parallel using Ray.

!!! info
    For default settings, see `engines.ray` in [execution](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/_settings/#vectorbtpro._settings.execution "vectorbtpro._settings.execution").

!!! note
    Ray spawns multiple processes rather than threads, so each argument and keyword argument must
    first be stored in an object store to be shared. Ensure that the computation with `func` takes
    sufficient time compared to the overhead of copying; otherwise, little to no speedup will be achieved.

__Args__

**```restart```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag to determine if the Ray runtime should be terminated and reinitialized.

**```reuse_refs```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating if function and object references should be reused
    such that each unique object is stored only once.

**```del_refs```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating if result object references should be explicitly deleted.

**```shutdown```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating if the Ray runtime should be shut down upon job completion.

**```init_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `ray.init`.

**```remote_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `ray.remote`.

**```hide_inner_progress```** :&ensp;`Optional[bool]`
:   Flag indicating whether to hide progress bars
    within individual threads.

**```**kwargs```**
:   Keyword arguments for [ExecutionEngine](https://vectorbt.pro/pvt_74d2a4ff/api/utils/execution/#vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine "vectorbtpro.utils.execution.ExecutionEngine").

### RayEngine.get_ray_refs | class method | [source](https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt.pro/blob/b08e819029eb56e38352bae72e703d3681d6400c/vectorbtpro/utils/execution.py#L1053-L1129)

```python
RayEngine.get_ray_refs(
    tasks,
    reuse_refs=True,
    remote_kwargs=None
)
```

Obtain Ray remote function references by storing arguments in the object store and
applying `ray.remote` on functions.

__Args__

**```tasks```** :&ensp;`TasksLike`
:   Tasks (i.e., functions with their arguments) to execute.

**```reuse_refs```** :&ensp;`bool`
:   Flag indicating whether to reuse references for unique objects.

**```remote_kwargs```** :&ensp;`KwargsLike`
:   Keyword arguments for `ray.remote`.

__Returns__

`List[Tuple[RemoteFunction, Tuple[ObjectRef, ...], Dict[str, ObjectRef]]]`
:       List of tuples, each containing a remote function reference, a tuple of object references
    for positional arguments, and a dictionary mapping keyword argument names to object references.
